text.title: 世界的碰撞……
text.objectives: Slay Chancellor Bloodleaf and Corok the Mighty and recover Illidan's Command.
text.description: 在征服之路的南端，有一处商队的大棚车营地。在那里，我发现一个巨人在和一个血精灵使者密会。你大概也已经注意到，这一带有许多体型较小的巨人出没。这事情绝对不简单，士兵。$B$B我要你杀入征服之路，到密会的现场去破坏他们的谈判，再看看能否搜寻到什么线索和信息。完成任务后，使用信号枪给我们驭风者发出信号。
text.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
text.completion: So they are attempting to gain the favor of the giants, eh? I have a plan that promises to sever this unholy union.
text.completed: Use the Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal a Kor'kron Wind Rider.$B$BSpeak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

english.title: When Worlds Collide...
english.objectives: Slay Chancellor Bloodleaf and Corok the Mighty and recover Illidan's Command.
english.description: At the southern end of the Path of Conquest, near a stationary caravan, I discovered what looked like a meeting between a giant and a blood elf chancellor. You've probably already noticed the smaller giants on the path as well. Something is just not right about all of this, grunt.$B$BI want you to fight your way to this meeting and break up the party. Recover whatever you can from the scene and then call for one of us with the flare gun.
english.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
english.completion: So they are attempting to gain the favor of the giants, eh? I have a plan that promises to sever this unholy union.
english.completed: Use the Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal a Kor'kron Wind Rider.$B$BSpeak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

text.title: 登陆场：灾难
text.objectives: 前往登陆场：灾难，向普雷西报到。
text.description: 现在我们可以进入燃烧军团位于登陆场：灾难的基地了，所以我们要设法摧毁整个基地。只有歼灭影月谷这一地区内的全部燃烧军团部队，才能确蛮锤要塞的安全。$B$B我已经派出了一支先遣部队前往登陆场，帮助你清除燃烧军团的残余势力。你现在立刻返回军团要塞，进入绿色水晶下的传送装置。普雷西会在登陆场：灾难等你。
text.completion: Pleased to meet you, $n. Name's Plexi. I won't bore you with formalities. We both know why we're here. Now, let's get to work.

english.title: Invasion Point: Cataclysm
english.objectives: Report to Plexi at Invasion Point: Cataclysm.
english.description: Now that we have access to the Legion's base at Invasion Point: Cataclysm, we need to figure out a way to shut down their operations there. Wildhammer Stronghold won't be safe until the Legion's presence is erased from Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BI've sent an advance party up to the invasion point to help you formulate a plan to destroy the Legion's supplies. Go back to Legion Hold and step into the teleporter with the green crystals above it. Plexi will meet you at your destination.
english.completion: Pleased to meet you, $n. Name's Plexi. I won't bore you with formalities. We both know why we're here. Now, let's get to work.

text.title: 登陆场：灾难
text.objectives: Report to Nakansi at Invasion Point: Cataclysm.
text.description: Now that we have access to the Legion's base at Invasion Point: Cataclysm, we need to figure out a way to shut down their operations there. Shadowmoon Village won't be safe until the Legion's presence is erased from the valley.$B$BI've sent an advance party up to the invasion point to help you formulate a plan to destroy the Legion's supplies. Go back to Legion Hold and step into the teleporter with the green crystals above it. Nakansi will meet you at your destination.
text.completion: You must be the $r Blood Guard Gulmok told me to expect. I have a plan in mind, but I'll need your help to complete the preparations.

english.title: Invasion Point: Cataclysm
english.objectives: Report to Nakansi at Invasion Point: Cataclysm.
english.description: Now that we have access to the Legion's base at Invasion Point: Cataclysm, we need to figure out a way to shut down their operations there. Shadowmoon Village won't be safe until the Legion's presence is erased from the valley.$B$BI've sent an advance party up to the invasion point to help you formulate a plan to destroy the Legion's supplies. Go back to Legion Hold and step into the teleporter with the green crystals above it. Nakansi will meet you at your destination.
english.completion: You must be the $r Blood Guard Gulmok told me to expect. I have a plan in mind, but I'll need your help to complete the preparations.

text.title: 伊利达雷徽章
text.objectives: Collect 10 Illidari Tabards.
text.description: 现在我们驭风者部队必须返回影月村，马上开始准备发动下一轮的进攻。而你，我命令你在这边收集一些日蚀血精灵身上的徽章。$B$B收集到足够的徽章之后，你可以使用库卡隆信号枪召唤来一名驭风者。$R，接下来你就要当间谍了！
text.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
text.completion: Ah-ha! These will do quite nicely.
text.completed: Use the Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal a Kor'kron Wind Rider.$B$BSpeak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

english.title: Tabards of the Illidari
english.objectives: Collect 10 Illidari Tabards.
english.description: The wind riders must return to Shadowmoon Village to prepare for the next phase of our assault. What I need from you now are the tabards that these blood elves wear.$B$BWhen you have collected enough tabards, call for a wind rider using the Kor'kron flare gun. Prepare yourself for a bit of espionage, $r!
english.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
english.completion: Ah-ha! These will do quite nicely.
english.completed: Use the Kor'kron Flare Gun to signal a Kor'kron Wind Rider.$B$BSpeak with Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Kor'kron Flare Gun and require a replacement.

text.title: 散播敌意……
text.objectives: 伪装成伊利达雷血精灵，杀死5个疯狂的巨人，然后向影月谷内影月村的奥巴洛恩大王复命，并将库卡隆信号枪一并交还给他。
text.description: 附魔材料全是研究员提欧鲁斯准备的，我所要做的不过是将伊利达雷徽章浸入这些混合物中。好，完成了，这件徽章现在已经融合了伊利达雷的精华。$B$B带上这件魔化伊利达雷徽章，前往位于日蚀岗哨西南方的日蚀平原。你一进入平原后就立即换上它，伪装成伊利丹的手下，之后，利用这伪装杀死那些在平原上游荡的疯狂的巨人。这样一来，他们必定会认为血精灵缺乏与其结盟的诚意！
text.progress: You have returned!
text.completion: Well, well, well... If it isn't the grunt I sent out into the field. You're back and in one piece. I knew you wouldn't let me down, soldier. You've stopped a major Illidari advance and, in doing so, earned yourself a little reward.
text.completed: Return to Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.objective1: Crazed Colossus slain while in disguise

english.title: Dissension Amongst the Ranks...
english.objectives: Slay 5 Crazed Colossus while in disguise as an Illidari blood elf and return to Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley. He will also want his Kor'kron Flare Gun returned.
english.description: Researcher Tiorus was kind enough to put this concoction together for the final strike. I merely pour it upon this tabard that you have provided for me and the item is imbued with the essence of the Illidari filth.$B$BTake the enchanted tabard and travel to the Eclipsion Fields, southwest of Eclipse Point. Once there, use the tabard to transform into an agent of Illidan. While in disguise, slay the crazed colossi that wander the field. They will think it an attack by the Eclipsion and sever all ties!
english.progress: You have returned!
english.completion: Well, well, well... If it isn't the grunt I sent out into the field. You're back and in one piece. I knew you wouldn't let me down, soldier. You've stopped a major Illidari advance and, in doing so, earned yourself a little reward.
english.completed: Return to Overlord Or'barokh at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.objective1: Crazed Colossus slain while in disguise

text.title: 灰烬中的小鬼
text.objectives: 古树莫斯伍德要求你杀死8只灼烧小鬼，然后回去向他复命。
text.description: 在这里的东北方有一处高地，那里被我古老家乡燃烧之后留下的厚厚的尘埃覆盖着。那曾是一片郁郁葱葱、枝繁叶茂的大森林，但是却被燃烧军团派遣小鬼烧光了，无数的生灵死于非命。尽管这件事已经过去了好几个世纪，但我复仇的信念却一直没有消逝过。那些小鬼的数量繁多，这让我们收复失地的工作进展艰难，但若是你去的话，一定会让它们感到恐惧的。$B$B你愿意帮助我吗？
text.progress: Soon I will sleep the deep sleep of the forest. Before I dig my roots deep and close these old eyes forever I hope to know that those wretched imps suffered and perished.
text.completion: There are so many that we could never kill them all, but you have given me hope. Perhaps I shall try harder for the next few centuries to revive my beloved wood.
text.completed: Return to Mosswood the Ancient at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Little Embers
english.objectives: Mosswood the Ancient wants you to kill 8 Scorch Imps and then return to him in Ruuan Weald.
english.description: Northeast of here, on the plateau above us lies the burnt ashes of my ancient home. A great wood flourished there before the Burning Legion sent their imps to burn us away. So many died that even centuries later my tired old heart hungers for revenge. There are too many of them for us to ever reclaim the land, but you could make them afraid.$B$BSurely you will help me?
english.progress: Soon I will sleep the deep sleep of the forest. Before I dig my roots deep and close these old eyes forever I hope to know that those wretched imps suffered and perished.
english.completion: There are so many that we could never kill them all, but you have given me hope. Perhaps I shall try harder for the next few centuries to revive my beloved wood.
english.completed: Return to Mosswood the Ancient at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 灰烬中的新生
text.objectives: 古树莫斯伍德要求你前往焦火荒野，将铁根种子植入那里三堆不同的肥沃的火山灰中，然后回到卢安荒野向他复命。
text.description: 一直沿着路向东走，越过山顶后再折向北方，你就会到达我那失落已久的家乡。$B$B那里曾是一片美丽而宁静的大森林，它的名字我已经记不清了。但是在几百年前，燃烧军团召唤出了无数的小鬼和其它火元素生物进攻了那里。于是，我的家园毁灭了，宗族的成员四散奔逃，只有我还留在这里。$B$B现在，我这里有一些铁根种子，它们当中蕴涵着强大的魔法力量，可以在肥沃的火山灰里健康成长。替我将它们种植在那里吧，我会以一些古老的财宝回报你的。
text.progress: Is it done?  Did you return some life to my ancient home?
text.completion: You destroyed many of those foul little creatures.  I can rest easier in that knowledge.
text.completed: Return to Mosswood the Ancient at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: From the Ashes
english.objectives: Mosswood the Ancient wants you to journey to Skald and plant Ironroot Seeds in three different mounds of Fertile Volcanic Soil and then return to him in Ruuan Weald.
english.description: If you follow the road east and up the side of the mountain, then turn north, you will come to my long lost home.$b$bOnce there was a wood there. Its name is forgotten. Long ago the Burning Legion summoned scorched imps and other creatures of flame. My home was destroyed and my people fled. Now only I remain. $B$BI have saved some ironroot seeds that could be planted in fertile volcanic soil. Their magic is strong. Do this for me and I will share with you the treasures of a forgotten age.
english.progress: Is it done?  Did you return some life to my ancient home?
english.completion: You destroyed many of those foul little creatures.  I can rest easier in that knowledge.
english.completed: Return to Mosswood the Ancient at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 征服之路
text.objectives: Travel to the Path of Conquest in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.description: $N，我从狮鹫骑士们那边得知，日蚀血精灵正在谋划一次大规模的行动。他们目前已经开始在东南方的征服之路一带聚集兵力。$B$B我要你前往日蚀岗哨附近的征服之路侦察敌情。判断清楚局势后，使用这支信号枪。一名蛮锤狮鹫骑士会在看到信号之后去接应你。将你探得的情报告诉他，而他也会给你下一步的指示。
text.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
text.completion: Indeed, these troublesome whelps are up to something insidious. We must investigate further...
text.completed: Use the Wildhammer Flare Gun to signal a Wildhammer Gryphon Rider.$B$BSpeak with Thane Yoregar at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Wildhammer Flare Gun and require a replacement.

english.title: The Path of Conquest
english.objectives: Travel to the Path of Conquest in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: My gryphon riders have come back with a bit of news! The Eclipsion blood elves are planning something big. They've begun forming their armies at the Path of Conquest, located east of here - adjacent to Eclipse Point.$B$BI want you to travel to the Path of Conquest and assess the situation. Once you've done so, use this flare gun to signal a gryphon rider. One will swoop down from the sky to meet you. Tell 'em what you've discovered and they'll give you the next set of orders.
english.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
english.completion: Indeed, these troublesome whelps are up to something insidious. We must investigate further...
english.completed: Use the Wildhammer Flare Gun to signal a Wildhammer Gryphon Rider.$B$BSpeak with Thane Yoregar at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Wildhammer Flare Gun and require a replacement.

text.title: 扫清道路
text.objectives: Slay 20 Eclipsion Soldiers, 10 Eclipsion Cavaliers, and 5 Sons of Corok.
text.description: $R，我们必须得继续深入调查。我和另一些狮鹫骑士将进入征服之路的上空。真希望我们能查探到更详细的敌情。不过，请你为我们清理前面路上的障碍，当然，最重要的是，确保我们不被血精灵的弓箭给射下来！$B$B在你成功削减他们的数量之后，使用蛮锤信号枪，给我们的狮鹫骑士编队发出信号。
text.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
text.completion: You won't believe this, soldier!
text.completed: Use the Wildhammer Flare Gun to signal a Wildhammer Gryphon Rider.$B$BSpeak with Thane Yoregar at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Wildhammer Flare Gun and require a replacement.

english.title: Breaching the Path
english.objectives: Slay 20 Eclipsion Soldiers, 10 Eclipsion Cavaliers, and 5 Sons of Corok.
english.description: We're going to need more time, $r. I'm going to fly further ahead with some of the other gryphon riders. Hopefully, we can gather some more information. What I need from you now is to clear a path and more importantly, keep their arrows pointed away from us!$B$BCall for a gryphon rider with the Wildhammer flare gun once you have thinned their numbers.
english.progress: What have you to report, soldier?
english.completion: You won't believe this, soldier!
english.completed: Use the Wildhammer Flare Gun to signal a Wildhammer Gryphon Rider.$B$BSpeak with Thane Yoregar at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley should you lose your Wildhammer Flare Gun and require a replacement.

text.title: 阿斯迦的图腾
text.objectives: 将斯克瑟隆作战图腾交给熔岩平原的帕沙恩。
text.description: 你从指挥官的日记中读到的故事是真的。当初，就在古尔丹集结兽人大军准备入侵艾泽拉斯世界时，我的族人们勇敢地提出抗议，想要阻止这场灾难。古尔丹获悉了这一切，便施放强大的法术摧毁了我们氏族的营地，扭曲了族人们的灵魂。$B$B必须在黑暗教团的家伙释放出更可怕的邪灵前阻止他们！前往北方的斯克瑟隆废墟寻找阿斯迦，取回他随身携带的图腾。这样，我们就能制止黑暗教团的计划了。
text.progress: Have you recovered the totem from Asghar?
text.completion: Good. This old totem hasn't lost its power over the years, but it alone is not enough to stop the dark conclave.
text.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Asghar's Totem
english.objectives: Bring the Sketh'lon War Totem to Parshah in the Magma Fields.
english.description: What you read in the commander's journal is true. While the orcish Horde massed under Gul'dan, my people sought to defend ourselves from the threat by striking against him. Gul'dan learned of their intentions and cast a mighty spell that destroyed our camps and twisted the spirits of my brothers.$B$BThey must be stopped before they unleash a greater evil. In the Sketh'lon Wreckage to the north, seek out Asghar and bring me the totem he carries. With it, we can begin to thwart the dark conclave's plans.
english.progress: Have you recovered the totem from Asghar?
english.completion: Good. This old totem hasn't lost its power over the years, but it alone is not enough to stop the dark conclave.
english.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 莉安丝魔棒
text.objectives: 从日蚀岗哨的血精灵身上夺得莉安丝的钥匙，用它打开莉安丝的保险箱并取出莉安丝魔棒。然后向熔岩平原的帕沙恩复命。
text.description: 斯克瑟隆作战图腾尚不足以与黑暗教团的邪恶魔法抗衡。$B$B我们可将图腾和其它拥有强大力量的物品组合起来，制作成一根聚能法杖。虽然已经无法将族人们从堕落的深渊中拯救出来，可我们至少能阻止他们越陷越深。$B$B首先我需要莉安丝魔棒，它在东南方日蚀岗哨的血精灵们手中。它被放置在废墟顶层的营帐中，周围有重兵把守。千万小心，$N。
text.progress: Did you manage to get the rod?
text.completion: Well done. Such a treasure deserves better than to be shut away in a dark chest. We shall see it used for a worthy purpose.
text.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Rod of Lianthe
english.objectives: Obtain Lianthe's Key from any of the blood elves at Eclipse Point and use it to open Lianthe's Strongbox and claim the Rod of Lianthe. Return the rod to Parshah in the Magma Fields.
english.description: The totem alone is not strong enough to counteract the sinister magics of the dark conclave.$B$BWe can combine it with other objects of power, forming a staff to focus the energies. We cannot rescue my brethren from the depths of their depravity, but we can stop them.$B$BOne of the items I need for the staff is the Rod of Lianthe, held by the blood elves at Eclipse Point to the southeast. It is kept in a pavilion on the top tier of the ruins and will be heavily guarded. Use caution, $N.
english.progress: Did you manage to get the rod?
english.completion: Well done. Such a treasure deserves better than to be shut away in a dark chest. We shall see it used for a worthy purpose.
english.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 猎人之道
text.objectives: Speak with Huntress Kella Nightbow at LOCATION.
text.description: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.$B$BYou must see Huntress Kella Nightbow at LOCATION. She can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

english.title: The Hunter's Path
english.objectives: Speak with Huntress Kella Nightbow at LOCATION.
english.description: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.$B$BYou must see Huntress Kella Nightbow at LOCATION. She can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

text.title: 斯克瑟隆羽毛
text.objectives: 收集8片斯克瑟隆羽毛，然后向熔岩平原的帕沙恩复命。
text.description: 制作法杖还缺一样东西。我们必须将法杖的力量调整成可以针对黑暗教团精神力量的属性。$B$B收集散落在斯克瑟隆营地周围的羽毛来制作法杖。那个营地位于这里以南，蛮锤要塞以东。$B$B古尔丹强大的力量彻底摧毁了族人们的肉身，只剩下他们的灵魂在世间游荡，可事情远没有终结。鸦人还汲取了残留的魔法力量，他们那邪恶的仪式不断吞噬着族人们的灵魂。
text.progress: Have you gathered the feathers for the staff?
text.completion: It would've been better if they had died that day, but nothing is ever that simple. That Gul'dan's magic would turn them into the kind of threat they tried to stop is a particularly cruel twist of fate.
text.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Sketh'lon Feathers
english.objectives: Gather 8 Sketh'lon Feathers and bring them to Parshah in the Magma Fields.
english.description: There is one last element missing from the staff. We must direct the staff's power toward the Dark Conclave spirits.$B$BWe can do that by gathering feathers scattered on the ground at the Sketh'lon Base Camp and using them in the staff. The base camp is to the south, east of Wildhammer Stronghold.$B$BGul'dan's magic utterly destroyed my brethren, leaving only their spirits, but it did not stop there. The magic fed on the spell the arakkoa were preparing, forging a sinister force that engulfed the spirits.
english.progress: Have you gathered the feathers for the staff?
english.completion: It would've been better if they had died that day, but nothing is ever that simple. That Gul'dan's magic would turn them into the kind of threat they tried to stop is a particularly cruel twist of fate.
english.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 火红岗哨之战
text.objectives: 击败驻守在火红岗哨的伊利丹的部队！$B$B获胜后向沙塔斯城的阿达尔复命。
text.description: 他们很可能正在征服之路附近搜寻你的下落。$R，快逃命去吧！$B$B别管我了，我已经不行了……这帮家伙……我已经听见他们的脚步声了。现在就走！否则肯定来不及了！快逃走吧！如果你选择留下来，就必须奋战到底！$B$B若是你能在战斗中活下来，请一定要将此地的情形转告给沙塔斯城的阿达尔。
text.progress: <A'dal greets you.>
text.completion: This Crimson Sigil will be investigated. They pose a threat to all life on Draenor. I foresee a day when their dark master has to answer for his crimes. Perhaps it will be you who brings him to justice, hero.
text.completed: Return to A'dal at Shattrath City in Terokkar Forest.

english.title: Battle of the Crimson Watch
english.objectives: Battle the forces of Illidan at Crimson Watch and survive!$B$BReturn to A'dal at Shattrath City should you emerge the victor.
english.description: They are probably searching for you on the Path of Conquest as we speak. You must make your escape, $r!$B$BLeave me, I'm done for... They... I think I hear them coming. It's now or never! Get out! If you choose to stay, you will have to fight!$B$BIf you fight and somehow manage to survive, take what you have learned here and deliver that knowledge to A'dal in Shattrath City.
english.progress: <A'dal greets you.>
english.completion: This Crimson Sigil will be investigated. They pose a threat to all life on Draenor. I foresee a day when their dark master has to answer for his crimes. Perhaps it will be you who brings him to justice, hero.
english.completed: Return to A'dal at Shattrath City in Terokkar Forest.

text.title: 为杖头充能
text.objectives: Travel to the Altar of Damnation, and use the Unfinished Headpiece while standing near Gul'dan. When the headpiece is energized, return to Parshah in the Magma Fields.
text.description: 法杖就快做好了！$B$B这片被诅咒的土地上依然涌动着古尔丹残存的力量，我们需要将这种力量灌入未完成的杖头。东边的魔能熔池附近有一座诅咒祭坛，就在死亡熔炉南面。$B$B那儿禁锢着古尔丹的残骸碎片。如果携带未完成的杖头进入祭坛，某些实体可能会对此做出回应，你可别惊慌失措。此行危险重重，请千万小心。
text.progress: Have you returned with the imbued headpiece?
text.completion: This holds the power that we'll need to disrupt the dark conclave's efforts in the Sketh'lon Base Camp.
text.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Imbuing the Headpiece
english.objectives: Travel to the Altar of Damnation, and use the Unfinished Headpiece while standing near Gul'dan. When the headpiece is energized, return to Parshah in the Magma Fields.
english.description: The staff is nearly finished!$B$BAll that remains is to imbue the headpiece with power flowing from the echoes of Gul'dan in this accursed place. To the east, near the Fel Pits and south of the Deathforge, is the Altar of Damnation.$B$BThere, fragments of Gul'dan's past are trapped. When you carry the unfinished headpiece of the staff into the area around the altar, don't be surprised if some of the entities react to it. You will be carrying a dangerous object with strong connections to the cataclysm.
english.progress: Have you returned with the imbued headpiece?
english.completion: This holds the power that we'll need to disrupt the dark conclave's efforts in the Sketh'lon Base Camp.
english.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 萨博迈恩男爵
text.objectives: 与刀锋山鲜血之环的萨博迈恩男爵谈一谈。
text.description: 我的计划是在食人魔营地投毒，然后杀掉统治他们的戈隆。$B$B我曾在刀锋山遇见过一位名叫萨博迈恩男爵的炼金大师，我们可以试着说服他帮忙。$B$B穿过雷神要塞北边的峡谷，去鲜血之环找他吧。听听萨博迈恩开出的价码，就由你来决定是否要跟他达成协议。
text.completion: Hello, $r. I am Baron Sablemane. A friend of Rexxar's is a friend of mine.

english.title: Baron Sablemane
english.objectives: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: Here is my plan. We will poison the ogres and then destroy their gronn master.$b$bDuring my travels in these mountains, I met a man named Baron Sablemane. He is a master of the alchemical arts, and may be convinced to assist us.$b$bYou will find him at the Circle of Blood, down in the canyon to the north of here. Whatever price he requires, I will leave it to your discretion to accept.
english.completion: Hello, $r. I am Baron Sablemane. A friend of Rexxar's is a friend of mine.

text.title: 踏平血槌营地
text.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodmaul Maulers and 5 Bloodmaul Warlocks.
text.description: <托查克凑到你耳边，压低了嗓门。>$B$B$N，有你这样的勇士帮助我们对抗食人魔真是荣幸。我相信雷克萨已经制定了周密的计划，但是我还想请你帮个忙，在你返回雷神要塞前能不能去血槌营地杀些食人魔？$B$B这样会收到事半功倍的效果。$B$B沿着雷神要塞北边的坡道一直走，在坡道尽头往西穿越巨龙之末，然后往北穿越沸土峡谷和刃喉谷就到了。
text.progress: Have you destroyed the Bloodmaul Camp yet?
text.completion: You continue to impress me, $n.  Every time one of those stinking ogres is felled, we come one step closer to ridding ourselves of an unworthy foe.
text.completed: Return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Crush the Bloodmaul Camp
english.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodmaul Maulers and 5 Bloodmaul Warlocks.
english.description: <Tor'chunk leans in close to whisper.>$B$B$N, you've done us more than proud in the fight against the ogres so far.  And while I have every confidence in what Rexxar has planned, I would still ask that you crush the ogres at Bloodmaul Camp before returning.$B$BThat way we'll be doubly certain of the outcome.$B$BTo get there, head north down the ramp out of Thunderlord.  Then, at the base of the ramp, head west across Dragons' End and north through the Churning Gulch and Daggermaw Canyon.
english.progress: Have you destroyed the Bloodmaul Camp yet?
english.completion: You continue to impress me, $n.  Every time one of those stinking ogres is felled, we come one step closer to ridding ourselves of an unworthy foe.
english.completed: Return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 有陷阱！
text.objectives: Deliver the Dragonfire Trap to Rexxar at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: There's is no cause of fury greater in this world than that of Gruul and his sons. They slaughtered my people - my children - and now I will have revenge.$B$BI have fashioned a trap from dragon fire, and if you're clever enough, you can use it to kill even a gronn.$B$BJust hurry, take the trap to Rexxar. My thirst for revenge must be quenched.
text.progress: Did you recover whatever was in that gronn's sack for Sablemane? What has he given us?
text.completion: Hmm, a trap fashioned from the essence of dragon fire? I wonder how Sablemane comes by such rarified substances? It does not matter. What does matter is that we are going to use it to slay a son of Gruul.

english.title: It's a Trap!
english.objectives: Deliver the Dragonfire Trap to Rexxar at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: There's is no cause of fury greater in this world than that of Gruul and his sons. They slaughtered my people - my children - and now I will have revenge.$B$BI have fashioned a trap from dragon fire, and if you're clever enough, you can use it to kill even a gronn.$B$BJust hurry, take the trap to Rexxar. text.title: 砾石营地的食人魔
text.objectives: Slay 5 Boulder'mok Brutes and 3 Boulder'mok Shaman, and then return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: I know that Rexxar has plans for you to head to Boulder'mok.  I have something that I want you to do while you are there.$B$BWe must take any chance we can get to strike down the ogres of these mountains, or they will overrun us, and all that we have bled and died for will be for nothing!$B$BBoulder'mok lies far to the northwest.  Travel north to Ruuan Weald, and from there head west through the tunnel and past the Raven's Wood.$B$B$N, I want you to kill the Bladespire ogres of Boulder'mok.  Wipe them out!
text.progress: We have come a long way in a short time, you and I. I dare say that you are the most capable ogre hunter that I have ever known.$B$BI trust then that you will deal with the Boulder'mok ogres soon?
text.completion: Ah, I wish that I could have been there with you.  Let me tell you something, $n: never accept any duty that keeps you from the glory of battle! Hah!  After all of the ogre killing that you've done, are there any still left in these mountains for me?!
text.completed: Return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Slaughter at Boulder'mok
english.objectives: Slay 5 Boulder'mok Brutes and 3 Boulder'mok Shaman, and then return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: I know that Rexxar has plans for you to head to Boulder'mok.  I have something that I want you to do while you are there.$B$BWe must take any chance we can get to strike down the ogres of these mountains, or they will overrun us, and all that we have bled and died for will be for nothing!$B$BBoulder'mok lies far to the northwest.  Travel north to Ruuan Weald, and from there head west through the tunnel and past the Raven's Wood.$B$B$N, I want you to kill the Bladespire ogres of Boulder'mok.  Wipe them out!
english.progress: We have come a long way in a short time, you and I. I dare say that you are the most capable ogre hunter that I have ever known.$B$BI trust then that you will deal with the Boulder'mok ogres soon?
english.completion: Ah, I wish that I could have been there with you.  Let me tell you something, $n: never accept any duty that keeps you from the glory of battle! Hah!  After all of the ogre killing that you've done, are there any still left in these mountains for me?!
english.completed: Return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]<txt><nyi>The Dragons of Dragons' End
text.objectives: Rexxar has asked you to speak to him about riding &&& out to Dragons' End to recover a Black Dragon Corpse.  Return to him at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains when you have it.
text.description: We must do something that will infuriate Goc if we're to face him.$B$BAnd now that you've freed &&&, I think I know just what will do!$B$BWhen you are ready, let me know, and I will ask &&& to fly you out to one of the dragon corpses impaled upon the rocks at Dragons' End.$B$BRecover the corpse and bring it back to me here so that we can create something that is sure to bring Goc out of hiding!
text.completed: Return to Rexxar at Bladespire Grounds in Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.completed: Return to Rexxar at Bladespire Grounds in Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: Return to Talionia
text.objectives: Speak with Talionia in Silvermoon City.
text.description: One of your masters, Talionia, in Silvermoon City has sent a summons for you, $n.  I'm certain it is time you learned to summon and control a more powerful demon, so I suggest you see her at once.  I understand Talionia is found in The Sanctum, a cozy little den of evil found along Murder Row.
text.completion: So the world traveler returns...$B$BI hope my sarcasm is evident, $N, for you have inconvenienced me greatly by forcing me to send out a summons. Consider that you are but a felguard's hair away from incineration, and they don't have any hair.$B$BPay attention closely, this is not a lesson you'll get twice.

text.title: Return to Carendin Halgar
text.objectives: Speak with Carendin Halgar in Undercity.
text.description: Ah, so there you are, $n.$b$bCarendin Halgar has sent out word for you to come see him in the Magic Quarter of Undercity.  He is not known for his patience, so I would not wait long.
text.completion: Yes, I can see it in your eye sockets. You are eager to learn more.$B$BVery well, this is a lesson we'll both enjoy.

english.objectives: Speak with Carendin Halgar in Undercity.
english.description: Ah, so there you are, $n.$b$bCarendin Halgar has sent out word for you to come see him in the Magic Quarter of Undercity.  He is not known for his patience, so I would not wait long.
english.completion: Yes, I can see it in your eye sockets. You are eager to learn more.$B$BVery well, this is a lesson we'll both enjoy.

text.title: Return to Gan'rul Bloodeye
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛和甘鲁尔·血眼谈一谈。
text.description: You are a long way from home, $r.  Perhaps it is time you returned to learn from your master, Gan'rul Bloodeye.  His knowledge is known to all of our craft, even those of us here.$b$bGan'rul dwells in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
text.completion: It is the forbidden knowledge you hunger for, is it? I can give you that...

english.title: Return to Gan'rul Bloodeye
english.objectives: Speak with Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
english.description: You are a long way from home, $r.  Perhaps it is time you returned to learn from your master, Gan'rul Bloodeye.  His knowledge is known to all of our craft, even those of us here.$b$bGan'rul dwells in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
english.completion: It is the forbidden knowledge you hunger for, is it? I can give you that...

text.title: Welcoming the Wolf Spirit
text.objectives: Use the Ceremonial Incense near the candles in Malukaz's hut and observe the ceremony. When the ceremony is complete, speak with Malukaz again.
text.description: I've nearly completed the vestments that I'll wear during the ceremony. As I add the finishing touches, I'd like you to set this incense by the candles near the runestone to my left.$B$BI believe it will help us to attract the wolf spirit's attention, since it was made in the days of the orcish clans. I can almost imagine my ancestors using it in a ceremony paying tribute to the wolf spirit after a successful hunt.$B$BOnce you've placed the incense, I'll begin the ceremony.
text.progress: Reestablishing ties with the wolf spirit is just the beginning of my journey, not the end.
text.completion: This is incredible! I set out on this journey unsure of whether the wolf spirit would answer our summons and now it feels as though he's always been here. Perhaps he was, $n. Perhaps he was waiting for the orcs to realize what their choices had wrought.
text.completed: Return to Malukaz at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.
text.objective1: Help Malukaz Summon the Wolf Spirit

text.title: 燃烧吧，塞斯高！
text.objectives: 从血环苦工手中夺得火炬，利用塞斯高的熔炉点燃火炬，并将它们扔进塞斯高的建筑物中。
text.description: 血环氏族背离了兽人高贵的传统！只有誓死与玛诺洛斯的嗜血诅咒抗争过的勇士才算得上真正的兽人。我们鄙视那些邪恶的表亲，瞧瞧他们软弱低贱的模样……堕落的兽人应该被烧死！$B$B进入东边血环兽人的据点塞斯高，烧毁他们的建筑物。从血环苦工手中夺得火炬，利用塞斯高的熔炉点燃火炬并将它们扔进兽人的房舍、兽栏和兵营。焚毁塞斯高，然后再回来找我！$B$B为了部落！
text.progress: Zeth'Gor must burn, $N! Speak with me again when your task is complete.
text.completion: Hah!  I could see the smoke and flames of Zeth'Gor from here!  May the Bleeding Hollow fiends burn to ash and drift far from the sight of any true orc! Thank you, $n.  You helped burn away an afront to every orc's spirit.
text.completed: Return to Captain Darkhowl at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Zeth'Gor Must Burn!
english.objectives: Kill Bleeding Hollow Peons for their torches, ignite them at Zeth'Gor's forge then throw the burning torches at Zeth'Gor Buildings.
english.description: The Bleeding Hollow clan have betrayed their noble heritage!  We, the orcs who fought and died to save ourselves from the fel taint of Mannoroth, look upon our vile cousins and see only weakness and ignobility... and for that, they must burn!$B$BEnter Zeth'Gor, their bastion to the east, and burn their buildings.  Kill peons for their torches, ignite them at their forge, and hurl the burning torches at their hovels, their stable and their barracks.  Burn them all, and then return to me!$B$BFor the Horde!
english.progress: Zeth'Gor must burn, $N! Speak with me again when your task is complete.
english.completion: Hah!  I could see the smoke and flames of Zeth'Gor from here!  May the Bleeding Hollow fiends burn to ash and drift far from the sight of any true orc! Thank you, $n.  You helped burn away an afront to every orc's spirit.
english.completed: Return to Captain Darkhowl at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 瓦萨雷克的日记：战争的前奏
text.objectives: 前往火红岗哨寻找玛库斯·奥拉林，他是沙塔尔的高级将领。$B$B你可以在一间水晶监狱中找到他。
text.description: 日志中记载了伊利丹军队近期的动向，还提到了瓦萨雷克率兵驻守征服之路的原因。原来这家伙亲手俘虏了一名沙塔尔高级将领。$B$B目前，这位将军被关押在位于征服之路南端的火红岗哨。一个名叫火色魔印的神秘组织负责看守囚犯。你若是想要调查此事，最好叫上你的朋友一同前往。
text.progress: Wha... What are you doing here?
text.completion: You slew their conqueror? Then we haven't much time... The Crimson Sigil is a group comprised of Illidan's elite minions. They are at the top of the chain of command for all Illidari forces outside of the Black Temple. These soldiers communicate directly with the Betrayer here, carrying out his orders without question. They are the fiends that will undoubtedly lead an assault on this world, trampling under foot all that would stand in their way.

english.title: The Journal of Val'zareq: Portends of War
english.objectives: Locate Marcus Auralion, High General of the Sha'tar, at Crimson Watch.$B$BLook for him inside a crystalline prison.
english.description: This journal documents the recent activities of Illidan's armies. It also explains why Val'zareq was parading around the Path of Conquest. He was personally responsible for the capture of a high general of the Sha'tar.$B$BThis general is being held at a post known as Crimson Watch, located at the southern end of the Path of Conquest. A mysterious faction, calling itself the Crimson Sigil, is charged with his incarceration. If you choose to investigate, it would be wise to bring allies.
english.progress: Wha... What are you doing here?
english.completion: You slew their conqueror? Then we haven't much time... The Crimson Sigil is a group comprised of Illidan's elite minions. They are at the top of the chain of command for all Illidari forces outside of the Black Temple. These soldiers communicate directly with the Betrayer here, carrying out his orders without question. They are the fiends that will undoubtedly lead an assault on this world, trampling under foot all that would stand in their way.

text.title: 碎手盗贼
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛的申苏尔谈一谈。
text.description: $N，这世界上还有许多我们尚未掌握的秘密。奥格瑞玛的碎手氏族可以帮助你学会这些秘密的其中之一：制造毒药。做他们要求你做的事情，首先获得他们的信任吧。$B$B想去奥格瑞玛的话，你必须使用银月城的传送装置抵达幽暗城。然后走出幽暗城外，找到附近的一处飞艇空港。从那里就可以直接飞到奥格瑞玛了。到了那边后，去暗影裂谷中找到申苏尔吧。
text.completion: So, you want to work for the Shattered Hand? Seems like we're getting someone new every day.$B$BPay close attention and I'll explain what you have to do.

english.title: Rogues of the Shattered Hand
english.objectives: Speak with Shenthul in Orgrimmar.
english.description: $N, there are secrets in the world that we do not yet possess.  The Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar can lead you to one of these secrets: the method for brewing deadly poisons.  Do as they ask and you will gain their trust.$b$bTo reach Orgrimmar, take the portal in Silvermoon City to Undercity.  Then, travel outside the city and find the nearby tower where the goblin Zepplins pick up their passengers.  From there, fly to the city of Orgrimmar where you can find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow.
english.completion: So, you want to work for the Shattered Hand? Seems like we're getting someone new every day.$B$BPay close attention and I'll explain what you have to do.

text.title: 多古克
text.objectives: Slay Dorgok at Bloodmaul Camp.
text.description: 我在常青林见过你好几次，一直想跟你商量件事。$B$B我接到好几份报告，称血槌食人魔准备对希尔瓦纳和卢安荒野发动攻击。我们还不知道是谁在背后捣鬼，不过先下手为强，必须将他们的计划扼杀在摇篮中！$B$B食人魔的作战基地血槌营地就在卢安荒野的西北方，去干掉他们的首领多古克！
text.progress: I cannot express strongly enough how important it is that you kill Dorgok as quickly as possible.
text.completion: With Dorgok dead, the Bloodmaul ogres are without leadership, and should be in disarray until another leader arises from within their ranks. Thank you, $c, I think we can breathe a little easier now.
text.completed: Return to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: A Date with Dorgok
english.objectives: Slay Dorgok at Bloodmaul Camp.
english.description: Good, I've seen you around and I've been meaning to speak to you about a matter of some importance.$B$BThere are reports coming in that for some reason the Bloodmaul ogres are planning an offensive against Sylvanaar and Ruuan Weald.  We don't know who or what is pushing them to do this, but I intend to nip their plan in the bud!$B$BBloodmaul Camp is where the attacks are to be staged from.  Head northwest down the ramp out of the Ruuan Weald and you will find it.  I want you to kill their leader, Dorgok!
english.progress: I cannot express strongly enough how important it is that you kill Dorgok as quickly as possible.
english.completion: With Dorgok dead, the Bloodmaul ogres are without leadership, and should be in disarray until another leader arises from within their ranks. Thank you, $c, I think we can breathe a little easier now.
english.completed: Return to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 踏平血槌营地！
text.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodmaul Maulers and 5 Bloodmaul Warlocks.
text.description: 听说你狠狠地打击了食人魔的嚣张气焰，大家都为此感到自豪。现在我要你再次拿起武器，踏平血槌营地！$B$B沿着卢安荒野西北方的坡谷一直走就是血槌营地了。$B$B$C，祝你好运！
text.progress: Have you destroyed the Bloodmaul Camp yet?
text.completion: I am impressed, $n.  Your reputation seems to be well-deserved. Every time one of the ogres is felled, we come one step closer to ridding ourselves of a danger that has no intention of leaving us in peace.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Fairweather at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Crush the Bloodmaul Camp!
english.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodmaul Maulers and 5 Bloodmaul Warlocks.
english.description: I've heard that you've done us more than proud in the fight against the ogres thus far.  Now, I would ask that you face them again.  I want you to crush the ogres at Bloodmaul Camp!$B$BTo get down there, head northwest down the ramp out of the Ruuan Weald.  You'll find them at the base of the ramp.$B$BGood luck, $c!
english.progress: Have you destroyed the Bloodmaul Camp yet?
english.completion: I am impressed, $n.  Your reputation seems to be well-deserved. Every time one of the ogres is felled, we come one step closer to ridding ourselves of a danger that has no intention of leaving us in peace.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Fairweather at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 戈隆的信物
text.objectives: 将高格鲁姆的信物交给刀锋山常青林的指挥官海弗斯·石墙。
text.description: 一尊小雕像从多古克掌中滑落。雕像上的人物竟然与某个戈隆惊人地相似。$B$B指挥官海弗斯·石墙一定会对此感兴趣的！沿着东面的坡谷进入卢安荒野，去常青林找他吧。
text.progress: Hello, lad, what news do you bring?
text.completion: Oh, now that's pretty.  Looks a lot like those gronn that are always bossing the Bladespire ogres around. Odd that you should find it in the hands of one of the Bloodmaul leaders.

english.title: Favor of the Gronn
english.objectives: Deliver Gorgrom's Favor to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: A token in the form of a small statuette falls from Dorgok's dead clutch.  It bears a striking resemblance to one of the gronn.$B$BSurely, Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Ruuan Weald, up the ramp to the east, would be interested in this!
english.progress: Hello, lad, what news do you bring?
english.completion: Oh, now that's pretty.  Looks a lot like those gronn that are always bossing the Bladespire ogres around. Odd that you should find it in the hands of one of the Bloodmaul leaders.

text.title: 拜访男爵
text.objectives: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: 这真是个坏消息。原来是食龙者高格鲁姆暗地里指使血槌食人魔滋扰希尔瓦纳！$B$B刀塔食人魔已经搅得我们不得安宁了，我想不通他为什么还要操纵血槌食人魔来对付希尔瓦纳。要想与戈隆抗衡，单凭我们的力量是不够的。$B$B我认识一位名叫萨博迈恩男爵的能人，他精通各种奇异的魔法。去鲜血之环找他吧，沿着坡道往南走，穿过东南方的峡谷就到了。$B$B向萨博迈恩男爵寻求帮助，请他替我们制作对付戈隆的陷阱。
text.completion: Ah, an envoy from the vaunted Alliance.  Tell me, lackey, why is it that you are here, begging me for this thing, instead of your illustrious commander? Could it be that he is afraid of me?  It says something about you that you are not, but I haven't quite decided yet what that is.

english.title: Pay the Baron a Visit
english.objectives: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: This is bad news.  Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater is behind the recent Bloodmaul plans against Sylvanaar!$B$BWhy he's manipulating them, and not just using the Bladespire, I don't know.  But if we're to deal with a gronn, we're going to need help.$B$BI know a man who is wise in the ways of all sorts of exotic magics.  Baron Sablemane is his name, and you can find him at the Circle of Blood, back down the ramp to the northwest, and then southwest through the canyon.$B$BAsk him to fashion us a trap for the gronn.
english.completion: Ah, an envoy from the vaunted Alliance.  Tell me, lackey, why is it that you are here, begging me for this thing, instead of your illustrious commander? Could it be that he is afraid of me?  It says something about you that you are not, but I haven't quite decided yet what that is.

text.title: 进入沸土峡谷
text.objectives: Collect 7 Crust Burster Venom Glands.
text.description: 嗯，我会帮你制作龙火陷阱，但是你得用别的东西来交换。$B$B鲜血之环附近居住着一个戈隆，他手中有我想要的东西。但是你不能直接面对他，至少现在还不是时候。$B$B我打算利用硬壳穿地虫的毒囊配制某种催眠粉。$B$B硬壳穿地虫就分布在西南方的沸土峡谷，把它们的毒囊带回来给我，动作快点！
text.progress: You have all of the venom glands?  If not, begone and waste no more of my time until you do!
text.completion: Very well.  A simple, if mundane, task has been completed.  Now, hand me the glands and I will perform the difficult part.
text.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Into the Churning Gulch
english.objectives: Collect 7 Crust Burster Venom Glands.
english.description: Very well, I'll create this trap, but first I want something in return.$B$BThere happens to be a nearby gronn that is in possession of an item that I want, but you can't face him, not yet anyway.$B$BSo, you and I are going to fashion a sleeping powder from the poison of the nearby crust bursters.$B$BYou'll find them in the Churning Gulch to the southwest.  Bring me a number of their glands, and be quick about it!
english.progress: You have all of the venom glands?  If not, begone and waste no more of my time until you do!
english.completion: Very well.  A simple, if mundane, task has been completed.  Now, hand me the glands and I will perform the difficult part.
english.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 晚安，戈隆
text.objectives: Collect Grulloc's Sack.
text.description: 我真是个天才。催眠粉已经配制好了，利用它去对付那个名叫格鲁洛克的戈隆吧。我说过，这家伙手中有我想要的东西。$B$B前往鲜血之环另一侧，巨龙之末东部边缘的诅咒洞窟寻找他的踪迹。$B$B如果我是你的话，一拿到格鲁洛克的包裹，我就会立即离开。催眠粉的有效时间不会持续太长的。
text.progress: You are before me again, $c.  This must mean that you've procured the sack out from underneath Grulloc's nose.
text.completion: Very well, you have upheld your end of the bargain.  And now, I will gift your Commander Stonewall with the trap.
text.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Goodnight, Gronn
english.objectives: Collect Grulloc's Sack.
english.description: I've outdone myself again.  I've fashioned a sleeping powder for you to use on Grulloc, the gronn I spoke of who is guarding what I want.$B$BGrulloc keeps himself at the Cursed Hollow, an area at the eastern edge of Dragons' End on the other side of the Circle of Blood.$B$BIf I were you, I wouldn't tarry long once you have his sack.  The effects of the dust won't last long.
english.progress: You are before me again, $c.  This must mean that you've procured the sack out from underneath Grulloc's nose.
english.completion: Very well, you have upheld your end of the bargain.  And now, I will gift your Commander Stonewall with the trap.
english.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 有陷阱！
text.objectives: 将龙火陷阱交给刀锋山常青林的指挥官海弗斯·石墙。
text.description: 我对格鲁尔之子和他们的父亲简直恨之入骨！他们残忍地杀害了我的族人，连毫无抵抗力的孩子都没有放过，我要复仇！$B$B这是龙火制成的陷阱，如果你够聪明的话，应该能利用它杀死戈隆。$B$B我知道你有自己的计划，不过我不在乎你杀死的是哪一个。把龙火陷阱交给指挥官海弗斯·石墙吧。$B$B平息我心中的怒火！
text.progress: Did the baron fashion us a trap?  One powerful enough to kill a gronn?
text.completion: Hmm, a trap fashioned from the essence of dragon flame?  I wonder how Sablemane comes by such rarified substances? It does not matter.  What does matter is that we are going to use it to slay a son of Gruul!

english.title: It's a Trap!
english.objectives: Deliver the Dragonfire Trap to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: There's nothing more that I hate in this world than the sons of Gruul and their father!  They slaughtered my people, and my children, and now I will have a taste of revenge!$B$BI have fashioned a trap from some dragon fire, and if you're clever enough, you might just be able to use it to kill a gronn.$B$BI'm sure that you have a particular gronn in mind; it matters not to me which one you kill.  Just hurry, take the trap to your Commander Stonewall.$B$BMy thirst for revenge must be quenched!
english.progress: Did the baron fashion us a trap?  One powerful enough to kill a gronn?
english.completion: Hmm, a trap fashioned from the essence of dragon flame?  I wonder how Sablemane comes by such rarified substances? It does not matter.  What does matter is that we are going to use it to slay a son of Gruul!

text.title: 食龙者高格鲁姆
text.objectives: Collect 3 Grisly Totems from Boulder'mok ogres. Then, use Sablemane's Trap at Gorgrom's Altar to summon and kill Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater.$b$bWhen Gorgrom is dead, place the 3 Grisly Totems near his corpse.
text.description: 必须让食人魔明白，我们不是好惹的。得给他们点颜色看看。$B$B杀入砾石营地，取得食人魔的徽记。$B$B在高格鲁姆的祭坛处布下陷阱，诱使高格鲁姆落入圈套。利用陷阱杀死高格鲁姆后，将可怕的图腾插在他的尸体旁。那些食人魔就会知道，如果他们胆敢再次来犯的话，高格鲁姆和那些死去的同伴就是他们的下场。
text.progress: Has the message been delivered?
text.completion: Well done, $n. Well done! I suspect we will hear little more from the ogres and their master.
text.completed: Return to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater
english.objectives: Collect 3 Grisly Totems from Boulder'mok ogres. Then, use Sablemane's Trap at Gorgrom's Altar to summon and kill Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater.$b$bWhen Gorgrom is dead, place the 3 Grisly Totems near his corpse.
english.description: We must show the ogres that we are not to be trifled with. We must send a message.$b$bTravel to Boulder'mok and kill the ogres there. Make sure you keep their heads.$b$bThen go to Gorgrom's altar and place the trap there for him. Gorgrom will appear, and you must lure him into the trap. When he is dead, mount your grisly totems near his corpse, so that the ogres may look at their fallen master and their fallen brothers, and know the price for seeking to destroy us.
english.progress: Has the message been delivered?
english.completion: Well done, $n. Well done! I suspect we will hear little more from the ogres and their master.
english.completed: Return to Commander Haephus Stonewall at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 砾石营地的食人魔
text.objectives: Slaughter 5 Boulder'mok Brutes and 3 Boulder'mok Shaman.
text.description: 我知道你要前往砾石营地执行任务，恰好有件事可以交给你顺路去办。$B$B我们必须把握一切机会，击毙盘踞在刀锋山的食人魔，否则他们就会攻入常青林，摧毁我们用生命换来的土地！往西南方走，越过大桥和隧道，乌鸦林以西就是砾石营地了。$B$B$N，我要你去杀死砾石营地的刀塔食人魔。
text.progress: I dare say that you are the most capable ogre hunter that I have ever known.$B$BI trust then that you will deal with the Boulder'mok ogres soon?
text.completion: Ah, I wish that I could have been there with you.  Let me tell you something, $n: never accept any duty that keeps you from the glory of the battlefield! Hah!  After all of the ogre killing that you've done, are there any still left in these mountains for me?!
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Fairweather at Evergrove in then Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Slaughter at Boulder'mok
english.objectives: Slaughter 5 Boulder'mok Brutes and 3 Boulder'mok Shaman.
english.description: I know that we have plans for you to head to Boulder'mok. I have something that I want you to do while you are there.$B$BWe must take any chance we can get to strike down the ogres of these mountains, or they will overrun us, and all that we have bled and died for will be for nothing!$B$BBoulder'mok lies to the west. Travel southwest, cross the bridge and head through the tunnel. On the west side of the Raven's Wood you will find them.$B$B$N, I want you to wipe out the Bladespire ogres of Boulder'mok.
english.progress: I dare say that you are the most capable ogre hunter that I have ever known.$B$BI trust then that you will deal with the Boulder'mok ogres soon?
english.completion: Ah, I wish that I could have been there with you.  Let me tell you something, $n: never accept any duty that keeps you from the glory of the battlefield! Hah!  After all of the ogre killing that you've done, are there any still left in these mountains for me?!
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Fairweather at Evergrove in then Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 友善
text.objectives: 影月谷灵翼平原的莫德奈要你喂养8只成熟的灵翼幼龙。
text.description: 不知道它们受到了什么惊吓，$R。$B$B<莫德奈指着盘旋在空中的虚空幼龙。>$B$B它们甚至不肯下来进食。已经有好几只虚空幼龙精疲力竭，直挺挺地坠落在地。$B$B我们必须挽救它们的性命！虚空幼龙以岩爪劫掠者为食。猎杀水晶附近的岩爪劫掠者，将岩爪劫掠者肉块放在地上等待虚空幼龙前来进食。只要你站立不动，别做任何进攻性的动作，它们是不会伤害你的。
text.progress: I cannot save them by myself, $N!
text.completion: You are a kind and compassionate $r, friend.
text.completed: Return to Mordenai at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Kindness
english.objectives: Mordenai at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to feed 8 Mature Netherwing Drakes.
english.description: Something has them spooked, $r.$B$B<Mordenai points to the nether drakes flying overhead.>$B$BThey won't even come down to feed. I have seen several fall to the earth, dead from exhaustion before their bodies hit the ground.$B$BWe must save them! The Rocknail flayers that are found near the crystals are their natural prey. Kill flayers and take their carcasses. Place a carcass in the field and stand extremely still. As long as you do not make any aggressive motions, they will not attack you.
english.progress: I cannot save them by myself, $N!
english.completion: You are a kind and compassionate $r, friend.
english.completed: Return to Mordenai at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 扫荡格鲁尔的巢穴
text.objectives: Slay 10 Bladespire Enforcers, 5 Bladespire Battlemages, 5 Bladespire Ravagers and their leader, Fingrom.
text.description: 你真是位足智多谋的勇士，现在我要派你去对付格鲁尔和他的儿子们，为我报仇雪恨。$B$B刀塔氏族备受戈隆的宠爱。你或许杀过不少刀塔食人魔，但是应该还没有跟他们中的强者较量过吧。$B$B格鲁尔安排了最强壮的食人魔驻守在巢穴外，你必须削弱他们的防御力量。往北穿越刃喉谷，格鲁尔的巢穴就在刃喉谷尽头。
text.progress: Have you managed yet to decimate the Bladespire ogres at Gruul's Lair?$B$BDo not come to me with excuses, $gboy:girl;! Get the job done!
text.completion: Very well, I chose wisely when I selected you to spearhead my fight.  Time to ramp things up to a whole new level, I think. You remember that little goodie that you stole for me out from underneath Grulloc's nose?  You're going to get a chance to put it to good use.
text.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Massacre at Gruul's Lair
english.objectives: Slay 10 Bladespire Enforcers, 5 Bladespire Battlemages, 5 Bladespire Ravagers and their leader, Fingrom.
english.description: You've proven yourself resourceful, and now I think I'm going to put you to personal use in my own fight against Gruul and his sons.$B$BThe Bladespire clan are the favored of the gronn, and while you may have thinned out their numbers elsewhere, you haven't yet dealt with their strongest.$B$BGruul protects the exterior of his lair with only the toughest of ogres, and it is those that you must kill.  Head north through the Daggermaw Canyon and you will find Gruul's Lair at the end.
english.progress: Have you managed yet to decimate the Bladespire ogres at Gruul's Lair?$B$BDo not come to me with excuses, $gboy:girl;! Get the job done!
english.completion: Very well, I chose wisely when I selected you to spearhead my fight.  Time to ramp things up to a whole new level, I think. You remember that little goodie that you stole for me out from underneath Grulloc's nose?  You're going to get a chance to put it to good use.
english.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 摊牌
text.objectives: Use Sablemane's Signet at the Altar of Goc, then kill Goc.
text.description: 与刀塔食人魔的统治者——苟克决战的时刻即将来临。我要亲临现场，见证戈隆的死亡。$B$B在苟克的祭坛处使用我的徽记，我会与你并肩作战。$B$B让我们共同击败苟克吧。
text.progress: In time, all the sons of Gruul will be destroyed.
text.completion: You fought surprisingly well for a $r, and it was an honor to have you at my side.  My transformation must have been quite a surprise for you.  I trust it was not too startling? Let us keep my true identity between the two of us for now, shall we?  In return, and for your adept service, I grant you your choice of any of these baubles.
text.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Showdown
english.objectives: Use Sablemane's Signet at the Altar of Goc, then kill Goc.
english.description: The time has come for us to face Goc, the master of the Bladespire ogres. It is also time that I take a hand in events, to see the last of the gronn's life.$b$bTake my signet ring. When you come to the Altar of Goc, use it, and I will come to join you.$b$bTogether we will destroy Goc.
english.progress: In time, all the sons of Gruul will be destroyed.
english.completion: You fought surprisingly well for a $r, and it was an honor to have you at my side.  My transformation must have been quite a surprise for you.  I trust it was not too startling? Let us keep my true identity between the two of us for now, shall we?  In return, and for your adept service, I grant you your choice of any of these baubles.
english.completed: Return to Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 灰舌破碎者
text.objectives: 劝诫者瓦伦要你进入巴尔里废墟，杀死3名灰舌驯兽者、4名灰舌战士和6名灰舌萨满祭司。$B$B为占星者完成任务将降低你在奥尔多阵营中的声望等级。
text.description: 灰舌氏族是所有破碎者中最可怕的存在，这个氏族的成员都经过阿卡玛的精挑细选，个个生性邪恶、嗜血成瘾。即使是与伊利丹麾下的其他纳迦部队、恶魔部队或是血精灵部队相比，他们的残忍与无情也毫不逊色。眼下，有大批灰舌破碎者盘踞在北方的巴尔里废墟一带。我们要先下手为强，在这帮家伙有机会攻击我们之前削弱他们的势力。
text.progress: Have you completed the task I requested of you, $N?
text.completion: Glory to the Scryers, $n.  You've done the Seer's bidding by defeating those who follow Illidan.
text.completed: Return to Varen the Reclaimer at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Ashtongue Broken
english.objectives: Varen the Reclaimer wants you to go to the Ruins of Baa'ri and slay 3 Ashtongue Handlers, 4 Ashtongue Warriors and 6 Ashtongue Shaman.$B$BCompleting quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.
english.description: The Ashtongue tribe is feared among all Broken.  It consists of the most vicious and bloodthirsty individuals, handpicked by Akama himself.  They are as fierce and ruthless as any naga, demon or blood elf in Illidan's army and they have been deployed in large numbers at the Ruins of Baa'ri, to the north.  Go there and put a dent in their numbers before they get a chance to mount an attack on us.
english.progress: Have you completed the task I requested of you, $N?
english.completion: Glory to the Scryers, $n.  You've done the Seer's bidding by defeating those who follow Illidan.
english.completed: Return to Varen the Reclaimer at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 阻止黑暗教团
text.objectives: 杀死黑暗教团仪祭者，然后使用帕沙恩的法杖破坏黑暗教团的召唤仪式。完成任务之后向熔岩平原的帕沙恩复命。
text.description: 黑暗教团目前正在斯克瑟隆营地以南的熔岩坑举行仪式，企图召唤强大的上古邪灵。$B$B他们汲取了古尔丹残存的魔法，强化了自身的力量，想要帮助邪灵来到我们的世界！$N，我们绝不能让这种事发生。一旦黑暗教团的奸计得逞，上古邪灵引发的毁灭性后果简直难以想象！$B$B带上法杖前往熔岩坑，彻底破坏黑暗教团的召唤仪式！
text.progress: Is it done, $n? Have you stopped the dark conclave from completing their ritual?
text.completion: I have sought a way to stop the dark conclave for years, and you have succeeded where I failed. The conclave's dark rituals will threaten us no more. I often feel guilty for abandoning my fellows all those years ago, but now I finally know that I made the right decision. If not for my wavering conscience then, I might have ended up as a shade among them.
text.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Thwart the Dark Conclave
english.objectives: Slay the Dark Conclave Ritualists and use the Staff of Parshah to end the Dark Conclave's summoning ritual, then return to Parshah in the Magma Fields.
english.description: The spirits of the dark conclave seek to summon an ancient and powerful evil through a ritual conducted at the lava pits to the south of the Sketh'lon Base Camp.$B$BGul'dan's magic mingled with their own, empowering them to aid this creature in manifesting in our world! We must not allow this to happen, $N. The death and destruction it would bring are unimaginable!$B$BCarry the staff with you to the site of the summoning and use its magics to stop the dark conclave once and for all!
english.progress: Is it done, $n? Have you stopped the dark conclave from completing their ritual?
english.completion: I have sought a way to stop the dark conclave for years, and you have succeeded where I failed. The conclave's dark rituals will threaten us no more. I often feel guilty for abandoning my fellows all those years ago, but now I finally know that I made the right decision. If not for my wavering conscience then, I might have ended up as a shade among them.
english.completed: Return to Parshah at Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 通缉：座狼主宰卡鲁什
text.objectives: 杀死座狼主宰卡鲁什，将他的徽记交给断背岗哨的达克霍尔上尉。
text.description: 通缉令：$B$B“悬赏击杀座狼主宰卡鲁什的勇士。卡鲁什是血环氏族狼骑兵的首领，他曾多次率兵袭击断背岗哨的补给车队。”$B$B“据斥候回报，他目前藏匿在塞斯高内。任何能取得他徽记的英雄将受到部落的感激，以及大笔赏金。”$B$B“- 达克霍尔上尉”
text.progress: Report, $n.  Is that Bleeding Hollow blood I see on your sleeve?  I hope so!
text.completion: Ah, so you slew that villain, Kruush!  Well done, $n!  Well done!  His death will defang those cursed worg riders.  In fact, I hope you took a few of them out during your foray into Zeth'Gor! Here's your reward.  You earned every piece of it!
text.completed: Return to Captain Darkhowl at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Wanted: Worg Master Kruush
english.objectives: Kill Worg Master Kruush and bring his head to Captain Darkhowl in Spinebreaker Post.
english.description: The poster reads:$B$B"Worg Master Kruush leads the worg riders of the Bleeding Hollow clan.  A price has been placed on his head, for his riders exact heavy tolls on supply trains to Spinebreaker Post."$B$B"Scouts report him within Zeth'Gor, and the hero able to bring the severed head of this villain to me will earn the thanks of the Horde, and a large bounty."$B$B"-Captain Darkhowl"
english.progress: Report, $n.  Is that Bleeding Hollow blood I see on your sleeve?  I hope so!
english.completion: Ah, so you slew that villain, Kruush!  Well done, $n!  Well done!  His death will defang those cursed worg riders.  In fact, I hope you took a few of them out during your foray into Zeth'Gor! Here's your reward.  You earned every piece of it!
english.completed: Return to Captain Darkhowl at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 损坏的面具
text.objectives: Deliver the Damaged Mask to O'Mally Zapnabber at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: 当你检查着这个破碎的面具时，似乎听到其中传出了某种奇怪的声音。如果这个面具没有损坏，或许声音还会更清晰一些。$B$B卢安荒野的塔利·萨普纳波或许能修好这个面具。
text.progress: Don't be bothering me! Can't you see I'm trying to unlock mysterious powers?
text.completion: Ah, what's that you have? Let me take a closer look, $c. Yes, yes... it's just what I thought it was. Here, let me fix this mask for you.

english.title: Damaged Mask
english.objectives: Deliver the Damaged Mask to O'Mally Zapnabber at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: As you examine the damaged mask, you hear strange sounds coming from within. If the mask wasn't damaged you might be able to hear the sounds more clearly.$B$BO'Mally Zapnabber in Ruuan Weald might be able to fix the mask.
english.progress: Don't be bothering me! Can't you see I'm trying to unlock mysterious powers?
english.completion: Ah, what's that you have? Let me take a closer look, $c. Yes, yes... it's just what I thought it was. Here, let me fix this mask for you.

text.title: 寻找奈尔萨拉库
text.objectives: 寻找奈尔萨拉库，虚空龙族的领袖。
text.description: $N，虚空龙族的守护神在高空翱翔。看来你对龙族子嗣的关爱感动了他。向奈尔萨拉库寻求帮助。这样或许能解除虚空幼龙的困境。$B$B<莫德奈指向天空。>$B$B朋友，飞吧。
text.completion: My children have told me of your heroic deeds, $r. There is more that you can do.

english.title: Seek Out Neltharaku
english.objectives: Seek out Neltharaku, patron of the Netherwing Dragonflight.
english.description: Their patron soars high above, $N. Perhaps the kindness that you showed his children has moved his heart. Seek Neltharaku out and enlist his aid. Together, you may be able to solve the plight of the Netherwing drakes.$B$B<Mordenai points to the sky.>$B$BFly high, friend...
english.completion: My children have told me of your heroic deeds, $r. There is more that you can do.

text.title: 神秘的面具
text.objectives: Deliver the Mystery Mask to Wildlord Antelarion at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: 好了，现在应该没问题了。啊？你问这是什么？怎么说呢，它是个联络工具，有了这个，那些傻瓜就可以互相联络了。谁是傻瓜？就是燃烧军团呀！我建议你把这个面具带去给荒野之王安塔里恩看看，他就在那边踱着方步呢。他老是走来走去的，静不下来。$B$B好了，快去吧，他最近一直想搞到一个这种面具。
text.progress: I cannot believe my eyes.
text.completion: That mask you hold in your hands is a Felsworn gas mask and by the appearance, it's not damaged. The trouble we can cause Forge Camp: Anger is boundless. Are you interested in helping us out, $n?

english.title: Mystery Mask
english.objectives: Deliver the Mystery Mask to Wildlord Antelarion at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: Ok, it should work now. What is it, you ask? Why, it's a communication device - it allows those blockheads to communicate with each other. You know, the Burning Legion! I would suggest that you hand this mask to Wildlord Antelarion. He's over there pacing around. Always moving, he is.$B$BWell get moving, he's been trying to get his hands on one of these for sometime now.
english.progress: I cannot believe my eyes.
english.completion: That mask you hold in your hands is a Felsworn gas mask and by the appearance, it's not damaged. The trouble we can cause Forge Camp: Anger is boundless. Are you interested in helping us out, $n?

text.title: 格里洛克之眼
text.objectives: 使用塞萨克的碎片捕获格里洛克之眼，然后利用塞萨克的熔锅使格里洛克之眼与你分离。完成任务后将塞萨克的碎片还给塞萨克。
text.description: $N，你勇敢地进入血环兽人的老巢——可怕的塞斯高，并毫发无伤地回来了！既然你这么强，一定有能力帮助我窥探血环氏族最强的巫师格里洛克的思想！$B$B使用这块碎片捕获格里洛克之眼，让眼球与你连接在一起，然后回到我这儿来，走近我的锅……它会令格里洛克之眼与你分离。$B$B去吧，$N。小心一点。只要稍不留神，格里洛克之眼就可能把你暴露给我们的敌人。
text.progress: The orcs of the Bleeding Hollow Clan were dark allies long ago... and even darker enemies now.
text.completion: I am indebted to you, $n.  You have again braved Zeth'Gor and held its darkness close to your heart.  I will study the eye and perhaps pierce the secrets of its master, Grillok. Let us hope that he can no longer use its magic!
text.completed: Return to Zezzak at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Eyes of Grillok
english.objectives: Use Zezzak's Shard to capture an Eye of Grillok, then approach Zezzak's cauldron to extract it.  After it is removed, return Zezzak's Shard to him.
english.description: $n, you have braved the lair of the Bleeding Hollow orcs, dreaded Zeth'Gor, and survived!  Perhaps you have the strength to aid me, for I aim to gaze into the mind of its darkest witch, Grillok!$B$BTake this shard.  Use it to ensorcel an Eye of Grillok and bind it to yourself.  Return here and approach my cauldron... and it will pull the eye from you.$B$BGo, $N.  And use care -- An Eye of Grillok will betray you to our enemies if given the slightest opening!
english.progress: The orcs of the Bleeding Hollow Clan were dark allies long ago... and even darker enemies now.
english.completion: I am indebted to you, $n.  You have again braved Zeth'Gor and held its darkness close to your heart.  I will study the eye and perhaps pierce the secrets of its master, Grillok. Let us hope that he can no longer use its magic!
english.completed: Return to Zezzak at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 奈尔萨拉库的故事
text.objectives: 与奈尔萨拉库谈一谈，听听他的故事。
text.description: 这些信息可能对你有用。请仔细听我说，$R。
text.progress: Allow me to finish telling you my tale.
text.completion: So you will help us?
text.completed: Return to Neltharaku at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Neltharaku's Tale
english.objectives: Speak with Neltharaku and listen to his story.
english.description: I have information that you may find useful. Please listen to what I have to tell you, $r.
english.progress: Allow me to finish telling you my tale.
english.completion: So you will help us?
english.completed: Return to Neltharaku at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 瓦萨雷克的日记：战争的前奏
text.objectives: 前往火红岗哨寻找玛库斯·奥拉林，他是沙塔尔的高级将领。
text.description: 日志中记载了伊利丹军队近期的动向，还提到了瓦萨雷克率兵驻守征服之路的原因。原来这家伙亲手俘虏了一名沙塔尔高级将领。$B$B目前，这位将军被关押在位于征服之路南端的火红岗哨。一个名叫火色魔印的神秘组织负责看守囚犯。你若是想要调查此事，最好叫上你的朋友一同前往。

english.title: The Journal of Val'zareq: Portends of War
english.objectives: Locate Marcus Auralion, High General of the Sha'tar, at Crimson Watch.
english.description: This journal documents the recent activities of Illidan's armies. It also explains why Val'zareq was parading around the Path of Conquest. He was personally responsible for the capture of a high general of the Sha'tar.$B$BThis general is being held at a post known as Crimson Watch, located at the southern end of the Path of Conquest. A mysterious faction, calling itself the Crimson Sigil, is charged with his incarceration. If you choose to investigate, it would be wise to bring allies.

text.title: 夺回圣地
text.objectives: 杀死8名影月斩杀者、8名影月天选者和4名影月暗法师，然后向守备官奥鲁门复命。$B$B为奥尔多完成任务会使你在占星者阵营中的声望等级降低。
text.description: $N，你狠狠地打击了盘踞在巴尔里废墟的灰舌破碎者。现在，让我们再来看看你如何对付伊利丹麾下的其他恐怖军队。$B$B影月氏族的邪兽人占领了阿塔玛平台，那儿曾是我的族人们使用阿塔玛水晶举行神圣仪式的圣地。$B$B我们确信这帮家伙将那块阿塔玛水晶藏在了阿塔玛平台附近，可惜我占卜不到它的下落。无论如何，邪兽人侵占了德莱尼人的圣地，他们就得死。
text.progress: Hail, $N. What news do you bring?
text.completion: Excellent work, $c.  May the Light continue to protect you.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aluumen at Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Reclaiming Holy Grounds
english.objectives: Vindicator Aluumen wants you to slay 8 Shadowmoon Slayers, 8 Shadowmoon Chosen and 4 Shadowmoon Darkweavers.$B$BCompleting quests for the Aldor will cause your Scryers reputation level to decrease.
english.description: You did well against the Broken in Baa'ri, $N.  Let's see how well you do against Illidan's most feared army.$B$BThe fel orcs of the Shadowmoon Clan occupy the Ata'mal Terrace, once a very holy site where ata'mal crystals were used in spiritual ceremonies.$B$BWe had reason to believe they were hiding an actual ata'mal crystal in the vicinity, but our scrying has revealed nothing.  Nevertheless, the fel orcs are on draenei holy ground and their presence must be dealt with.
english.progress: Hail, $N. What news do you bring?
english.completion: Excellent work, $c.  May the Light continue to protect you.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aluumen at Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 严厉的报复
text.objectives: 劝诫者瓦伦要求你杀死8名影月斩杀者、8名影月天选者和4名影月暗法师。$B$B为占星者完成任务会使你在奥尔多阵营中的声望等级降低。
text.description: 你狠狠地打击了灰舌破碎者的嚣张气焰，$N。如果你对自己有信心的话，我就再交给你一项任务。$B$B不久前，伊利丹手下的邪兽人曾大举侵犯群星圣殿。$B$B我们断定滋扰生事的是阿塔玛平台的影月谷兽人。$B$B让这帮家伙尝尝占星者的厉害。
text.progress: Hail, $N. What news do you bring?
text.completion: You've gained my utmost respect today, $n. Slaying one fel orc is not an easy task.  Massacring a score of them is, well... heroic.
text.completed: Return to Varen the Reclaimer at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Great Retribution
english.objectives: Varen the Reclaimer wants you to slay 8 Shadowmoon Slayers, 8 Shadowmoon Chosen and 4 Shadowmoon Darkweavers.$B$BCompleting quests for the Scryers will cause your Aldor reputation level to decrease.
english.description: You did well against the Ashtongue Broken, $N.  I have another challenge for you, should you be up to it.$B$BNot too long ago, the Sanctum of the Stars suffered a tremendous attack by Illidan's fel orcs.$B$BWe've determined it was perpetrated by the Shadowmoon orcs who occupy the Ata'mal Terrace.$B$BShow them that the Scryers are not to be trifled with.
english.progress: Hail, $N. What news do you bring?
english.completion: You've gained my utmost respect today, $n. Slaying one fel orc is not an easy task.  Massacring a score of them is, well... heroic.
english.completed: Return to Varen the Reclaimer at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 萨博迈恩男爵的邀请
text.objectives: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: $N，在你外出执行任务时，萨博迈恩男爵派了他的宠物龙送来消息。$B$B他想见见你。看来男爵想让你帮他对付戈隆。$B$B说起萨博迈恩男爵与戈隆的仇恨，我倒觉得你是整个外域最适合帮助他的人选。不过如果我是你的话，我就先叫上几个伙伴，去鲜血之环打几场。
text.completion: Ah, I see that you decided to take your sweet time answering my summons. No matter, I have plenty of time to exact my revenge, and I intend for you to be my proxy in the coming battle!

english.title: Baron Sablemane Has Requested Your Presence
english.objectives: Speak with Baron Sablemane at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: $N, while you were out being one hell of a $c, Baron Sablemane sent his pet dragon up here with a message.$B$BHe's asked for you personally.  From what I understand, he wants you to head up his own fight against the gronn.$B$BI guess you're the most qualified person in all of Outland to help him, but if I were you, I'd get in contact with a couple of friends first and ask them to join you at the Circle of Blood.
english.completion: Ah, I see that you decided to take your sweet time answering my summons. No matter, I have plenty of time to exact my revenge, and I intend for you to be my proxy in the coming battle!

text.title: 魔誓防毒面具
text.objectives: Wear the Felsworn Gas Mask and use the Legion Communicator at Forge Camp: Anger in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
text.description: I have a very special mission for you, $N. I need you to infiltrate Forge Camp: Anger east of here. When you enter the camp you will need to wear the Felsworn gas mask and locate the Legion communicator. Once you have located the communication device speak with whomever is on the other side of the device.$B$BIf all works out you can trick the demon into something devious! Try telling the demon that Camp Anger has revolted.$B$BGood luck to you $C.
text.completion: What's the meaning of this! No one summons me! Speak, or I will silence you forever!

english.title: Felsworn Gas Mask
english.objectives: Wear the Felsworn Gas Mask and use the Legion Communicator at Forge Camp: Anger in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
english.description: I have a very special mission for you, $N. I need you to infiltrate Forge Camp: Anger east of here. When you enter the camp you will need to wear the Felsworn gas mask and locate the Legion communicator. Once you have located the communication device speak with whomever is on the other side of the device.$B$BIf all works out you can trick the demon into something devious! Try telling the demon that Camp Anger has revolted.$B$BGood luck to you $C.
english.completion: What's the meaning of this! No one summons me! Speak, or I will silence you forever!

text.title: 欺骗敌人
text.objectives: Slay 4 Doomforge Attendants and 4 Doomforge Engineers.
text.description: 你要是再一声也不吭，你就死定了！说话！说话呀！$B$B什么？营地里有叛乱？绝对不可能！我的仆从从来不会有胆子反抗我的权威。$B$B什么，是真的？好吧，背叛的代价，可是会越来越沉重的，直到他们根本无法负担。让他们都永远闭上嘴吧！完成了命令再来向我报告。
text.progress: My patience is tiring, why have you not finished them?
text.completion: That will surely teach those that don't do as I say... By the way... where is Doomcryer? Why have you reported this revolt to me and not she?
text.completed: Return to the Legion Communicator at Forge Camp: Anger in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Deceive thy Enemy
english.objectives: Slay 4 Doomforge Attendants and 4 Doomforge Engineers.
english.description: For every moment I hear silence, you draw closer to your death! SPEAK!$B$BWhat? The camp has revolted? This cannot possibly be true! My minions would not dare undermine my authority.$B$BWell then, every last one of them will pay for this treachery, they will pay dearly. Silence them all and be done with it! Report back to me once you have carried out my order or you shall be dealt with.
english.progress: My patience is tiring, why have you not finished them?
english.completion: That will surely teach those that don't do as I say... By the way... where is Doomcryer? Why have you reported this revolt to me and not she?
english.completed: Return to the Legion Communicator at Forge Camp: Anger in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 你被解雇了！
text.objectives: Slay Doomcryer.
text.description: 什么？厄运传令者对这次的叛乱袖手旁观？她也敢！她以前好几次都想取代我的地位，不过失败了。这是最后一次了，我不会再给她机会了。这个位子是我的，我不给，她不能抢！你必须立刻把她召唤出来，干掉她。$B$B召唤她到铸魔营地：怒火的钥匙是由她手下最精锐的怒火守卫拿着的。把那五支钥匙抢来，启动营地里的五块军团方尖塔。方尖塔的作用时间很短，所以你要尽量同时启动它们。记住，怒火守卫不是只会看守钥匙的简单人物。
text.progress: Are you looking to join my list of those expendable? Get those keys and silence Doomcryer!
text.completion: That is great news, great news indeed, $N. I could not have asked for a better outcome. Your service to our people is most greatly appreciated; choose one of the following heroic items.$B$BYour name will forever be remembered in our peoples' hearts.
text.completed: Return to Wildlord Antelarion at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: You're Fired!
english.objectives: Slay Doomcryer.
english.description: Doomcryer did nothing to stop the revolt? How dare she! She has been trying to undermine my authority for some time. However, this time will be her last. You must summon her and deal with her personally.$B$BHer anger guards hold the keys that summon her to Forge Camp: Anger. Retrieve the five keys and activate the five Legion obelisks. The obelisks have a short duration, so make sure they are all activated at the same time. Remember, the anger guards carry more keys.
english.progress: Are you looking to join my list of those expendable? Get those keys and silence Doomcryer!
english.completion: That is great news, great news indeed, $N. I could not have asked for a better outcome. Your service to our people is most greatly appreciated; choose one of the following heroic items.$B$BYour name will forever be remembered in our peoples' hearts.
english.completed: Return to Wildlord Antelarion at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 单枚日怒徽记
text.completion: Victory to the Scryers! Kael's forces will soon crumble.
text.completed: Return to Battlemage Vyara in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 更多日怒徽记
text.completion: You're making a name for yourself, $n. Keep it up.

english.completion: You're making a name for yourself, $n. Keep it up.
