I'm afraid, $n, that the time has come for me to let you go. I feel that your potential has been reached here, if not far exceeded. Don't feel bad, though. After all, it takes an exceptional type of individual to participate in such extraordinary events and not lose their wits. And look here, I have a little something for you to remember me by.
english.completed: Return to Budd Nedreck in Ghostlands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 坠毁的飞艇
text.objectives: 跟比吉尔的飞艇残骸的莫希·斯蒂格里谈一谈。
text.description: Not long ago, a goblin zeppelin crashed to the east. A representative of the Steamwheedle Cartel passed through here a few days ago.$B$BShe was looking for information about the zeppelin's cargo and it's pilot, Beezil, but none of us really got a good look at the crash. I doubt she'll be able to clean up after the wreck by herself, much less recover whatever cargo the vessel might have carried.$B$BIf you have time, you may want to check up on her out at Beezil's Wreck, due east of here, near the mountains.
text.completion: So those hermit mages sent you? How can I be sure that I can trust you?$B$BI suppose I can use the help. There's not much here a mage would be interested in, anyway.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]The Zeppelin Crash
english.objectives: Speak with Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck.
english.description: Not long ago, a goblin zeppelin crashed to the east. A representative of the Steamwheedle Cartel passed through here a few days ago.$B$BShe was looking for information about the zeppelin's cargo and it's pilot, Beezil, but none of us really got a good look at the crash. I doubt she'll be able to clean up after the wreck by herself, much less recover whatever cargo the vessel might have carried.$B$BIf you have time, you may want to check up on her out at Beezil's Wreck, due east of here, near the mountains.
english.completion: So those hermit mages sent you? How can I be sure that I can trust you?$B$BI suppose I can use the help. There's not much here a mage would be interested in, anyway.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 沼泽中的毒药
text.objectives: Bring 6 vials of Marsh Venom to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm.
text.description: 如果你指望学徒莫兰恩去做些什么的话，我想他所能做的也只有对着材料发牢骚了。$B$B我通常都是无视他，但根本不起作用。这次，我要试些不同的方法。$B$B如果我在他发现之前把缺少的材料补上，也许他就能让我安静一会。我们最常用的材料是沼泽毒药，那东西可以从农场北面沼泽的暗牙爬行者和毒性切割者身上得到。如果你能帮我弄来毒药，我就可以在莫兰恩发现前把它放回去。
text.progress: Did you get that venom? Morlann's going to discover that it's gone any moment now...
text.completion: <Apprentice Garion inspects the venom.>$B$BThis is absolutely perfect! He'll never know the difference.
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]The Reagent Thief
english.objectives: Bring 6 vials of Marsh Venom to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm.
english.description: If there's one thing you can count on Apprentice Morlann to do, it's whine about reagents.$B$BNormally, I just ignore him, and it never works. This time, I'm going to try something different.$B$BMaybe if I replace the missing reagents before he notices, he'll leave me alone. The most common reagent we both use is marsh venom, which comes from the darkfang creepers and noxious shredders in the marsh north of the farm. If you bring me the venom, I'll replace it before Morlann notices it's gone.
english.progress: Did you get that venom? Morlann's going to discover that it's gone any moment now...
english.completion: <Apprentice Garion inspects the venom.>$B$BThis is absolutely perfect! He'll never know the difference.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 阻止腐蚀
text.objectives: 莫希·斯蒂格里希望你去溶解10只软泥怪，然后回到比吉尔的飞艇残骸旁向她复命。
text.description: 看看这个地方！到处都是软泥怪，要是我不想点什么办法控制它们的话，它们就会腐蚀掉残骸和飞艇的货物！$B$B我不能空手回去，$C！在这些软泥怪消化掉所有东西之前，帮我消灭它们吧！$B$B这台设备充电后可以将能量集中到这些泥浆怪身上，让它们爆炸。飞艇的能量核心碎片应该可以给这台设备提供能量，靠近主坠毁点的那个始终可以正常工作，不过其它的时好时坏。
text.progress: Did you make any progress against those oozes?
text.completion: Well, it does look a little cleaner out there...$B$BI suppose it's time to get down to the business of salvaging this wreckage.
text.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Corrosion Prevention
english.objectives: Moxie Steelgrille wants you to dissolve 10 oozes and report back to her at Beezil's Wreck.
english.description: Just look at this area! It's swarming with oozes. If I don't find some way to keep them under control, they'll corrode the wreckage and the zeppelin's cargo!$B$BI can't go back empty-handed, $c! Help me dissolve these oozes before they've digested everything!$B$BThis device, when powered, will concentrate energy on the slimes, causing them to explode. The zeppelin's fragmented power core should power the device. The one near the main crash works all the time, but the others flicker on and off.
english.progress: Did you make any progress against those oozes?
english.completion: Well, it does look a little cleaner out there...$B$BI suppose it's time to get down to the business of salvaging this wreckage.
english.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 我的女儿
text.objectives: 前往钢铁之门找到石衣老爹的女儿，工头伊蕾娜·石衣。
text.description: 是真的吗？进入低语峡谷的探险者真的都发疯了吗？$B$B几天前，我的女儿伊蕾娜带领一队探险者协会的成员去了北边的钢铁之门。发生了这样可怕的事，我很担心她。$B$B$C，像我这样的老头子恐怕经不起旅途的颠簸。你能帮我跑一趟，确认她是否安全吗？
text.completion: Grrr. I knew it! He's sooooo over-protective! This is just embarassing. Not that I'm not happy to see you... I am! We all are. We can use your help!

english.title: My Daughter
english.objectives: Old Man Stonemantle has asked you to find his daughter, Overseer Irena Stonemantle, at Steel Gate.
english.description: Tell me, is it true? Did the explorers that went into Whisper Gulch go mad?$B$BMy daughter is the overseer of the Explorers' League that went north to some place called Steel Gate. With the horrible events that have befallen us, I fear for her safety.$B$BPlease, $c, I am too old to make the journey. Her name is Irena. Will you go make certain that she is alright?
english.completion: Grrr. I knew it! He's sooooo over-protective! This is just embarassing. Not that I'm not happy to see you... I am! We all are. We can use your help!

text.title: 工程的进展
text.objectives: 伊蕾娜·石衣要你和钢铁之门的钢铁之门首席考古学家谈一谈。
text.description: 研究工作才刚刚开始。不过我们从西部卫戍要塞带来了一批飞行器，有望提高工作效率。$B$B问题是……我们缺少熟练的飞行员。北边裂木森林的局势持续恶化，我决定尽快搞定这里的事情，然后启程返回家园。$B$B如果你愿意帮忙的话，就和探险队的考古学家谈一谈。他们就在遗址北面和南面的飞行器旁。
text.completion: Irena sent you over, did she? Good, we've got work for you then!

english.title: See to the Operations
english.objectives: Explorer Irena Stonemantle has asked you to speak with a Steel Gate Chief Archaeologist at Steel Gate.
english.description: Our work out here is really just beginning. But now that we've brought these flying machines in from Westguard Keep, it should really pick up.$B$BThe problem is that we're lacking enough qualified pilots. And with things getting worse in the Rivenwood to the north, I'd like to get things wrapped up here quickly and then head back home.$B$BIf you can lend a hand, go have a chat with one of my chief archaeologists. You'll find them next to the flying machines on the north and south sides of the site.
english.completion: Irena sent you over, did she? Good, we've got work for you then!

enders.name: 钢铁之门首席考古学家

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 水光庄园的隐士
text.objectives: 跟水光庄园的“沼泽之眼”加尔谈一谈。
text.description: 有这么一个家伙，他独自住在沼泽里，当地人叫他“沼泽之眼”加尔。前段时间水光庄园的前任主人神秘失踪了，他就“接管”了那里。$B$B我想时不时地找人查看一下他的状况。你知道吗？他让我想起了我的祖父。有人说他脑子不太正常。$B$B如果你朝西北走，沿着塞拉摩外的大路，就能在道路转向西边之前在女巫岭地区找到水光庄园。
text.completion: Get off my lawn... unless, that is, you want to help old "Swamp Eye" with a little bit of cooking. Whad'ya say?

english.title: [DEPRECATED]The Hermit of Swamplight Manor
english.objectives: Speak to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
english.description: There's a fellow the locals know as "Swamp Eye" Jarl, who lives alone out in the swamp. Sometime ago he "took over" Swamplight Manor after the previous owners disappeared under mysterious circumstances.$B$BI like to send someone to check up on him every once in a while. He kind of reminds me of my grandfather, you know? Some say he's not quite right in the head.$B$BIf you're headed northwest on the road out of Theramore, you'll find Swamplight Manor in the Witch Hill area, before the road turns west.
english.completion: Get off my lawn... unless, that is, you want to help old "Swamp Eye" with a little bit of cooking. Whad'ya say?

text.title: 督军之血
text.objectives: 把祖尔金之血交给祖阿曼外面幽魂之地的巴德。
text.description: 当你观察这只瓶子时，你突然想起了祖阿曼外面那个狂妄的家伙。$B$B你迫不及待地想要看到巴德的表情！
text.progress: You again.... I don't know how else to say it - I'm simply too busy with my preparations to hold your hand any longer. Trust me, $n, it's all for the best. Perhaps, by some miracle, you might eventually build a name for yourself. If so, you'll be able to say that you got your start from the incomparable Budd Nedreck!
text.completion: Th-the Blood of Zul'jin himself you say? Well, I appreciate the gesture, $c, but I could've taken him down with ease. There's no way he was as fearsome as the legends say. These things have a way of being utterly overstated, as you'll learn in time. More likely, the pitiful old cretin was overcome with arthritis! Anyway, I suppose it was the least you could do as payment for the kindness I've shown you here. Now off with you - I must dispose of this vial!
text.completed: Return to Budd Nedreck in Ghostlands.

english.title: Blood of the Warlord
english.objectives: Bring the Blood of Zul'jin to Budd at his camp in the Ghostlands, outside Zul'Aman.
english.description: As you examine the pulsating vial, your thoughts turn to the petulant little man outside Zul'Aman.$b$bYou can't wait to see Budd's expression when he sees this!
english.progress: You again.... I don't know how else to say it - I'm simply too busy with my preparations to hold your hand any longer. Trust me, $n, it's all for the best. Perhaps, by some miracle, you might eventually build a name for yourself. If so, you'll be able to say that you got your start from the incomparable Budd Nedreck!
english.completion: Th-the Blood of Zul'jin himself you say? Well, I appreciate the gesture, $c, but I could've taken him down with ease. There's no way he was as fearsome as the legends say. These things have a way of being utterly overstated, as you'll learn in time. More likely, the pitiful old cretin was overcome with arthritis! Anyway, I suppose it was the least you could do as payment for the kindness I've shown you here. Now off with you - I must dispose of this vial!
english.completed: Return to Budd Nedreck in Ghostlands.

text.title: [Temporarily Deprecated Awaiting a New Mob]Finlay Is Gutless
text.objectives: 将7根Pristine Mistsaber Catgut交给嚎风峡湾Westguard Keep的Finlay Fletcher。
text.description: 是谁负责维修弩手们的武器？是我，Finlay Fletcher！$B$B我们的部队计划转移到Fort Wildervaar，指挥官指派我协助处理所有准备事宜，搞得我没时间外出收集制作弓弦所需的肠线了！$B$B好心的$C，帮我个忙好吗？猎杀嚎风峡湾的雾刃豹，从它们身上弄到完整的肠线！那些弄断的肠子就算啦。
text.completed: Return to Finlay Fletcher at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: [Temporarily Deprecated Awaiting a New Mob]Finlay Is Gutless
english.objectives: Collect 7 Pristine Mistsaber Catgut for Finlay Fletcher and return to him at Westguard Keep.
english.description: All these crossbowmen, and who is it that has to maintain all of their weapons? Me, Finlay Fletcher!$B$BThe commander commandeered my assistant to get ready for the move up to Fort Wildervaar, and I haven't the time to go out and get all of the catgut that I need for their strings!$B$B$C, be a good $g lad : lass; and gather me up some catgut. The mistsabers prowling about the fjord will do, but mind that you only bring back the most pristine of intestines from them! Severed gut won't do us any good.
english.completed: Return to Finlay Fletcher at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 女巫岭的幽灵
text.objectives: 水光庄园的摩丹特·格雷斯比希望你能从10个复活的躯壳或复活的游魂身上收集到信息。
text.description: 我长途跋涉来到这里拜访加尔的新家，但无尽的恐惧一直在笼罩着我！这里肯定有什么东西有问题，并不是只有我的感觉有问题而已……$B$B你看到那些在女巫岭附近游荡的鬼魂和尸体了吗？如果说有人会知道这里曾经发生过了什么，我想也只有他们了。在这附近寻找复活的躯壳和复活的游魂，打败他们，让他们安静下来，在这些恶魔吞噬掉加尔之前，看看你能从他们身上了解到什么！
text.progress: What have you learned from the spirits haunting this place?
text.completion: From your findings, the spirits in this place must amount to everyone who ever lived on this land, not just the previous occupants. Something has been corrupting and killing them. Those who follow don't learn the truth until it's too late. We have to put an end to this, $n!
text.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: What's Haunting Witch Hill?
english.objectives: Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor wants you to gather information from 10 Risen Husks or Risen Spirits.
english.description: I traveled out here to pay Jarl a visit at his new home and it's been a nonstop horror show ever since! There's something seriously wrong here and I can't be the only one who sees it...$B$BHave you seen the ghosts and corpses shambling about Witch Hill? I've a feeling that if anyone knows what happened here, it is them. Seek out these risen husks and risen spirits in the surrounding area, grant them rest through combat, and see what you can learn from them before this evil consumes Jarl!
english.progress: What have you learned from the spirits haunting this place?
english.completion: From your findings, the spirits in this place must amount to everyone who ever lived on this land, not just the previous occupants. Something has been corrupting and killing them. Those who follow don't learn the truth until it's too late. We have to put an end to this, $n!
english.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 除巫草
text.objectives: Bring 9 sprigs of Witchbane to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor.
text.description: 在我身为草药师的这么多年里，我观察到大自然可以为大部分烦人的问题提供完美的解决方案。我曾经读到流浪法师和巫医经常使用一种被称为“除巫草”的草药，它的烟能将恶魔从隐藏的暗处驱赶出来。$B$BI如果这是真的，那么除巫草应该就生长在女巫岭的浅水附近。它有着阔叶和红色茎秆，你应该很容易就能分辨出来。把你能找到的药草都带回来给我吧，$N。它可能是我们唯一的希望了。
text.progress: Were you able to gather any of the herb? We must work quickly, before whatever evil is behind this infestation consolidates its hold on this area.
text.completion: These match the description exactly! I prepared the torch while you were out. All that remains is to fasten the herbs to the end here.
text.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Witch's Bane
english.objectives: Bring 9 sprigs of Witchbane to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor.
english.description: In my years as an herbalist, I've often observed that nature will provide subtle cures to the most vexing of problems. I've read that hedge mages and witch doctors often use the smoke of an herb known as witchbane to draw evil from its hiding places.$B$BIf true, this would mean witchbane should be growing near the shallow waters of Witch Hill. You should be able to identify it by its broad leaves and reddish central stalk. Bring me any of the herb you can find, $N. It may be our only hope.
english.progress: Were you able to gather any of the herb? We must work quickly, before whatever evil is behind this infestation consolidates its hold on this area.
english.completion: These match the description exactly! I prepared the torch while you were out. All that remains is to fasten the herbs to the end here.
english.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 问题的根源
text.objectives: 杀死斯克尔德·达拉克森和5名掠龙训练者，完成任务后向灰烬龙巢中的灰烬龙巢古树复命。
text.description: 平衡是自然界的主旋律。只有剔除那些不和谐的音符，才能实现真正的平衡。$B$B这么说吧，杀死幼龙抑或是摧毁龙蛋的做法是治标不治本的。新近崛起的维库人以及他们的主人——斯克尔德·达拉克森才是这场森林火灾的罪魁祸首。$B$B去击败他们吧，他们的巢穴就在灰烬龙巢南部。
text.progress: How fare your efforts against the meddlesome handlers, little one?
text.completion: Unfortunate that one predator must be used to put down another, but that is the natural order of things. Perhaps now the proto-drakes and their whelps can go back to living peacefully. Somehow I doubt it with the reawakening of the vrykul.
text.completed: Return to Ember Clutch Ancient at Ember Clutch in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Root Causes
english.objectives: Slay 5 Dragonflayer Handlers and Skeld Drakeson.  If you manage to do so, return to an Ember Clutch Ancient in the Ember Clutch.
english.description: All things in nature seek a balance. It is only through the interference of those not in tune with that harmony that the balance is shifted.$B$BYou waste your efforts when you kill the whelps and drakes. The real culprits behind the expansion of these magically burning woods are the newly awakened vrykul and their master, Skeld Drakeson.$B$BIf it's blood on your hands that you seek, start with them. You will find their lair on the south side of the Ember Clutch.
english.progress: How fare your efforts against the meddlesome handlers, little one?
english.completion: Unfortunate that one predator must be used to put down another, but that is the natural order of things. Perhaps now the proto-drakes and their whelps can go back to living peacefully. Somehow I doubt it with the reawakening of the vrykul.
english.completed: Return to Ember Clutch Ancient at Ember Clutch in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 净化女巫岭
text.objectives: Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor wants you to plant the torch at the end of the dock and defeat anything that appears.
text.description: 火把已经准备好了。把它插在码头的尽头，对可能出现的一切情况做好准备吧。$B$B我不知道火把的浓烟会带来什么……如果真的有东西出现的话。我必须说，我对这种民间魔法是有所怀疑的，但现在我们也没有时间来想其它办法了。看在你和加尔的份上，祝你好运。
text.progress: Is it over?
text.completion: It worked?$B$B<Mordant clears his throat.>$B$BI mean... it worked! Jarl and I are in your debt, $N. Now the only remaining problem is my friend's taste in furniture, and I'm afraid that won't be solved as easily.
text.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Cleansing Witch Hill
english.objectives: Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor wants you to plant the torch at the end of the dock and defeat anything that appears.
english.description: The torch is ready. Plant it at the end of the dock and be prepared to face whatever comes forth.$B$BI have no idea what the torch's smoke may reveal... if anything emerges at all. I must say, I have my doubts about this kind of folk magic, but we haven't time for anything else. For your sake and Jarl's, I wish you luck.
english.progress: Is it over?
english.completion: It worked?$B$B<Mordant clears his throat.>$B$BI mean... it worked! Jarl and I are in your debt, $N. Now the only remaining problem is my friend's taste in furniture, and I'm afraid that won't be solved as easily.
english.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 悬赏：贪婪的血爪
text.objectives: 杀死贪婪的血爪，然后向泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔复命。
text.description: 旅行者以及从事野外作业的热砂港雇员请注意，不要靠近城镇西边的鲜血沼泽墓穴。$B$B大群迅猛龙盘踞在那片区域，它们的首领“贪婪的血爪”既残忍又狡猾，至少有两名热砂港工程师惨死于这只野兽的利爪之下。$B$B如果谁能替泥链镇解除威胁，德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔愿意慷慨解囊，奖赏这位勇士。
text.progress: You look pretty satisfied with yourself. Come to claim the bounty on that monstrous raptor?
text.completion: Thank goodness someone's finally taken me up on that offer. I was just thinking that I might need to triple the reward to get that stupid raptor killed, and our budget couldn't afford that!
text.completed: Return to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]WANTED: Goreclaw the Ravenous
english.objectives: Kill Goreclaw the Ravenous and report to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
english.description: Travelers and Steamwheedle personnel working in the field are advised to avoid the Bloodfen Burrow to the west of town.$B$BThe area is overrun with raptors lead by the cruel and cunning Goreclaw the Ravenous, who has already killed at least two Steamwheedle engineers.$B$BDrazzit Dripvalve has authorized a generous reward to be paid to the individual who rids Mudsprocket of this menace.
english.progress: You look pretty satisfied with yourself. Come to claim the bounty on that monstrous raptor?
english.completion: Thank goodness someone's finally taken me up on that offer. I was just thinking that I might need to triple the reward to get that stupid raptor killed, and our budget couldn't afford that!
english.completed: Return to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 药剂师的信
text.objectives: Bring the Sealed Letter to Andello Porter at Tabetha's Farm.
text.description: Recovered from the body of a Forsaken apothecary, this letter contains alarming evidence of a close alliance between the Grimtotems and the new masters of Lordaeron.$B$B"As a demonstration of good faith and a symbol of our newfound trust, we have dispatched Apothecary Cylla to aid you in battling our mutual enemy in the land of Kalimdor. None will stand before our combined might and determination."$B$BThis letter should be brought to the attention of the SI:7 agent at Tabetha's Farm, Andello Porter.
text.progress: What is that you're carrying, $C?
text.completion: <Andello reads the letter, shocked at its contents.>$B$BWe've long had misgivings about the cooperation between the Horde and the Forsaken, and this only confirms those suspicions. With the backing for Forsaken magic and arms, the Grimtotems would become an even more fearsome enemy. The balance of power in Kalimdor could shift considerably.
text.completed: Return to Andello Porter at The Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Signs of Treachery?
text.objectives: Bring the Sealed Letter to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
text.description: Recovered from the body of a Forsaken apothecary, this letter hints at an underground correspondence between Undercity and the Grimtotem leadership.$B$B"As a demonstration of good faith and a symbol of our newfound trust, we have dispatched Apothecary Cylla to aid you in battling our mutual enemy in the land of Kalimdor. None will stand before our combined might and determination."$B$BPerhaps Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village will know how to handle this information.
text.progress: What is that you're carrying, $C?
text.completion: If this is what it appears to be, the Forsaken have some explaining to do!$B$BThe antics of the Grimtotems have long tried the Warchief's patience. We have traditionally treated it as a matter to be settled among the tauren people, but this letter may change it.$B$BIt will take time to investigate these suspicions, but do not speak to anyone of what you have seen this day.

text.title: 法师中尉玛利斯特
text.objectives: 亚当斯上尉要你与法师中尉玛利斯特谈一谈，他就在西部卫戍要塞中。
text.description: 可恶！！！始祖龙正在攻击要塞！$B$B按理说你摧毁了龙蛋，杀掉了幼龙，它们应该吓得逃跑才对。$B$B你确实那样做了对吧？$B$B$N，恐怕这反而招来了它们的报复。去跟我的顾问法师中尉玛利斯特谈一谈，他会告诉你如何对付这些凶猛的野兽。
text.completion: I was worried that something like this might happen. I tried to dissuade the captain from this course of action, but he is a dwarf of action with a definite outlook on how things should proceed. Let us speak of the options left to us.

english.title: Mage-Lieutenant Malister
english.objectives: Captain Adams has asked you to speak with his advisor, Mage-Lieutenant Malister, at Westguard Keep.
english.description: THIS IS OUTRAGEOUS! Those proto-drakes are attacking the keep!$B$BBeasts such as that should have been scared off when you took care of their clutches and whelps.$B$BYou did take care of them, right?$B$B$N, this calls for more direct action. Speak with my advisor, Mage-Lieutenant Malister. He'll provide you with the means to get at those infernal creatures.
english.completion: I was worried that something like this might happen. I tried to dissuade the captain from this course of action, but he is a dwarf of action with a definite outlook on how things should proceed. Let us speak of the options left to us.

text.title: 一错再错……
text.objectives: 西部卫戍要塞的法师中尉玛利斯特要你杀死3只始祖幼龙。
text.description: 我们激怒了灰烬龙巢的始祖龙，它们很可能会持续攻击要塞……这可不行。$B$B我讨厌做挖肉补疮的蠢事，但是目前看来只能杀掉这些生物了。虽然这样做令我于心不忍，可我们别无选择。$B$B喏，这是我的魔杖。我已经设法延长了它的射程，可惜威力很一般。不过没关系，它能吸引始祖龙的注意就行啦。
text.progress: It is unfortunate that the captain had to have you go rile up the proto-drakes. Though they seem to lack the intelligence of some of the dragons we know, they still seem to be noble creatures. Not to mention the situation it places us in.$B$BDare I ask if you have dealt with the situation?
text.completion: Unfortunate business to be certain. Well, what's done is done. With any luck the new whelps that grow to be drakes at Ember Clutch will not retain a memory of our shameful actions therein. And with a bit more luck, the boundaries of that magical forest will not continue to spread. Here, $n, please take this pittance from the treasury for all of your troubles. It's the least that we can do.
text.completed: Return to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Two Wrongs...
english.objectives: Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep has tasked you with the destruction of 3 Proto-Drakes.
english.description: Now that we've riled up these Ember Clutch proto-drakes, they may be inclined to continue their attacks upon the keep. This will not do.$B$BI hate to compound one wrong with another, but in this case it would appear that we will have to destroy the creatures. A regrettable course of action, but one that we need to undertake regardless.$B$BTake my wand. I've been experimenting with increasing its range, but it doesn't pack much of a punch. However, what it will do is get a proto-drake's attention.
english.progress: It is unfortunate that the captain had to have you go rile up the proto-drakes. Though they seem to lack the intelligence of some of the dragons we know, they still seem to be noble creatures. Not to mention the situation it places us in.$B$BDare I ask if you have dealt with the situation?

With any luck the new whelps that grow to be drakes at Ember Clutch will not retain a memory of our shameful actions therein. And with a bit more luck, the boundaries of that magical forest will not continue to spread. Here, $n, please take this pittance from the treasury for all of your troubles. It's the least that we can do.
english.completed: Return to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: One Last Time
text.objectives: Escort the Ghost of Explorer Jaren safely to Explorer Irena Stonemantle at Steel Gate in the Howling Fjord.
text.description: 你好。我死了吗？我想我是因为我徘徊在我的身体上！这是多么不幸的事情。当灾祸降临在我们身上的时候，我正准备向伊蕾娜求婚，她知道她还活着，我可以感觉到她在我的心里，$B$B $C
text.end: The Ghost of Explorer Jaren safely escorted to Irena Stonemantle
text.completed: Return to Overseer Irena Stonemantle at Whisper Gulch in Howling Fjord.

english.title: One Last Time
english.objectives: Escort the Ghost of Explorer Jaren safely to Explorer Irena Stonemantle at Steel Gate in the Howling Fjord.
english.description: Hello there. Am I dead? I think I am, because I'm hovering over my body!$B$BOh, what an unfortunate turn of events. I was about to propose to Irena when the Scourge descended on us.$B$BI know that she's still alive... I can feel her in my heart.$B$B$C, do you think you might safely get me to her? The Scourge can still see my ghost, and no doubt can do horrible things to me.$B$BI'd like to look upon her beautiful face one last time. You can tell her that I love her for me.
english.end: The Ghost of Explorer Jaren safely escorted to Irena Stonemantle
english.completed: Return to Overseer Irena Stonemantle at Whisper Gulch in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 非标准炮弹
text.objectives: 收集10颗西部卫戍要塞炮弹，将它们交给西部卫戍要塞的炮兵伊莱。
text.description: $G Lad : Lass;, who's the genius that made our cannons a non-standard size? Now we have ta make special cannonballs ta shoot out o' the infernal contraptions!$B$BI would look kindly on ye if ye would go out and find the balls we've already shot. No doubt with the way these louts shoot they be all o'er the place ta the south and east.$B$B<The cannoneer spaces his hands apart to give you an idea of how big the cannonballs are.>$B$BThat would be faster than us making 'em from scratch fer a certainty.
text.progress: We're runnin' dangerously low on rounds 'round here, $c. Our enemies need poundin', especially Skorn! Ya got more balls fer us?
text.completion: Oh, bless ya, $n, bless ya! Just set 'em down right where yer standin'. I'll have one o' the boys come load 'em up soon enough and we can stop worryin' 'bout runnin' out o' balls ta shoot at Skorn.
text.completed: Return to Cannoneer Ely at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: One Size Does Not Fit All
english.objectives: Cannoneer Ely has tasked you with rounding up 10 Westguard Cannonballs and returning them to him at Westguard Keep.

english.completed: Return to Cannoneer Ely at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 破旧的灯塔
text.objectives: 跟塞拉摩东边岛屿上灯塔的巴布·菲兹托克谈一谈。
text.description: 东边的旧灯塔已经坏了很久了，可巴布·菲兹托克不知道哪根筋不对非要修好它。$B$B我不知道她打算怎么做，但她声称这样船只和货物就能更为迅速地泊进码头，那么我也不好反对。和上前线比起来，在码头上抽税也没什么好抱怨的，你说是吧？
text.completion: Good. I can use all the help you can offer. My first priority is to get that lamp re-lit.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]This Old Lighthouse
english.objectives: Speak to Babs Fizzletorque at the lighthouse on the island east of Theramore.
english.description: The old lighthouse out to the east hasn't worked for some time, but Babs Fizzletorque has gotten it into her head to get it working again.$B$BI don't know how she plans to do it by herself, but she claims that it'll make the movement of ships and goods into the docks smoother, so I can't really object. Drawing duty on the docks is really nothing to complain about when you could be on the front lines, you know?
english.completion: Good. I can use all the help you can offer. My first priority is to get that lamp re-lit.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Thresher Oil
text.objectives: Bring 4 containers of Thresher Oil to Babs Fizzletorque at the lighthouse near Theramore.
text.description: 灯塔里古老的日志上记载着，油灯的燃料用的是生活在附近海岸的蛇颈龙的油。$B$B<巴布在提起这种过时的技术时，皱了一下鼻子。>$B$B我想这会有用的，虽然只能算是个土办法。日志上还写着，最年幼的黑色蛇颈龙是最好的选择，而那些家伙就生活在塞拉摩的码头下面。$B$B如果你有意的话，是否能帮我弄点灯塔所需的燃料？
text.progress: Were you able to get any of that thresher oil?
text.completion: Well, I have my doubts, but this is the only solution available right now. Once we have it up and running, I'm sure there will be time to look at other ways to fuel the lamp.
text.completed: Return to Babs Fizzletorque at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Thresher Oil
english.objectives: Bring 4 containers of Thresher Oil to Babs Fizzletorque at the lighthouse near Theramore.
english.description: The old log in the lighthouse indicates that the lamp was fueled with oil from the threshers that live along the coast here.$B$B<Babs wrinkles her nose at the mention of such outdated technology.>$B$BI suppose it's a practical, if inelegant solution. The log says that the oil taken from the youngest murk threshers works the best, and those live right underneath the docks of Theramore.$B$BIf you're up for it, would you help resupply the lighthouse with fuel?
english.progress: Were you able to get any of that thresher oil?
english.completion: Well, I have my doubts, but this is the only solution available right now. Once we have it up and running, I'm sure there will be time to look at other ways to fuel the lamp.
english.completed: Return to Babs Fizzletorque at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Dastardly Denizens of the Deep
text.objectives: 把《深海中的卑劣生物》交给塞拉摩码头上的“脏鬼”迈克尔·克罗维。
text.description: 要知道，能在这座古老的灯塔里面找到这东西实在是太棒了。在我点亮了灯以后，我发现某个旧箱子里有本书。$B$B<巴布拿起书，激动地读着书名。>$B$B《深海中的卑劣生物》！$B$B啊，我想若是看到里面所说的生物之一，我可能吓昏过去！我肯定这本书很好笑，不过现在我完全没时间去读它。$B$B然而，你知道谁会感兴趣吗……就是码头上的那个鱼商，“脏鬼”迈克尔·克罗维。他收藏旧书。
text.progress: What'll it be today? The snook is quite good.
text.completion: Well, now, that was thoughtful o' Babs to send that over. I don't know if you've leafed through it or not, but there's a lot of truth to the tales in that book. Sailors didn't just make it all up, you know.
text.completed: Speak to "Dirty" Michael Crowe at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Dastardly Denizens of the Deep
english.objectives: Bring Dastardly Denizens of the Deep to "Dirty" Michael Crowe on the Theramore docks.
english.description: You know, it's amazing what you can find in that old lighthouse. After I lit the lamp, I noticed this book in one of the old trunks up there.$B$B<Babs holds up the book and reads the title dramatically.>$B$B"Dastardly Denizens of the Deep!"$B$BWhy, I think I might swoon if I ever saw one of these! I'm sure it's good for a laugh or two, but I simply don't have time for reading right now.$B$BYou know who might enjoy it, though... that fishmonger on the docks, "Dirty" Michael Crowe. He collects old books.
english.progress: What'll it be today? The snook is quite good.
english.completion: Well, now, that was thoughtful o' Babs to send that over. I don't know if you've leafed through it or not, but there's a lot of truth to the tales in that book. Sailors didn't just make it all up, you know.
english.completed: Speak to "Dirty" Michael Crowe at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Is it Real?
text.objectives: 跟尘泥沼泽纳特的码头的纳特·帕格谈一谈。
text.description: 哦，我相信你和巴布肯定觉得这本书中的奇异描述和草图很可笑，但是你有没有想过，那可能是一些传说的真相？$B$B如果仔细听，我想你仍然可以听到水手们谈论泰瑟尔，书上说这只海洋生物就住在这里！当然，如果你想加以确信，可以去问问老纳特·帕格。$B$B他在尘泥海湾西南边狂潮湾对面的小岛上有个不大的钓鱼营地。
text.completion: So you want to know about sea monsters? Hmm... well, I'll make you a deal, but it's going to involve a lot of alcohol and some embarrassment on your part.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Is it Real?
english.objectives: Talk to Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: Oh, I'm sure you and Babs had a good laugh over the outlandish descriptions and sketches in the book, but have you stopped to consider there might be some truth to the legends?$B$BIf you listen closely enough, I bet you can still hear sailors talk about Tethyr, the sea creature the book says lives right here! Of course, if you wanted to know for sure, you could always ask old Nat Pagle.$B$BHe's got a small fishing camp on a little island in Tidefury Cove, which is southwest across Dustwallow Bay.
english.completion: So you want to know about sea monsters? Hmm... well, I'll make you a deal, but it's going to involve a lot of alcohol and some embarrassment on your part.

text.title: 破烂的巫毒人偶
text.objectives: 将破烂的巫毒人偶交给沙塔斯城的格里伏塔。
text.description: 我太感动了，$N，居然是真的。我都不记得上一次有$R帮助苏加姆走出困境是什么时候了。$B$B这个是我从一个忙着锁住我的野蛮人身上弄来的，看上去并不值多少钱，但是如果说有人可以确定它的价值，我想就只有我的好朋友格里伏塔了！$B$B如果你能成功活着离开这里，不如把这个交给他看看。
text.progress: Hey, $n! I hear ya been workin' yer way into Budd's crew. Ya won't live to regret that move, friend, I can promise ya that. Whatcha got there, mon?
text.completion: Hey now, where ya be gettin' this? No, no, don't tell me - this be comin' from the Hex-Lord himself! It all be clear now. Strong mojo! The bearer of this relic, no matter how many disgraces he be sufferin', be always honored by his peers. Incredible! I gots no coins right now, mon, but ya be welcome to this here...
text.completed: Return to Griftah in Shattrath City.

english.title: Playin' With Dolls
english.objectives: Take the Tattered Voodoo Doll to Griftah in Shattrath City.
english.description: I'm touched, $n, an' dat be da truth. I'm not rememberin' the last time a $r helped Zungam outta trouble.$b$bI snatched this from one of them savages when he was busy chainin' me up. It don't look like much, but if anyone can determine its worth, it be my good friend, Griftah!$b$bIf ya be makin' it outta here alive, it might be worth takin' this to him out in Shattrath City.
english.progress: Hey, $n! I hear ya been workin' yer way into Budd's crew. Ya won't live to regret that move, friend, I can promise ya that. Whatcha got there, mon?
english.completion: Hey now, where ya be gettin' this? No, no, don't tell me - this be comin' from the Hex-Lord himself! It all be clear now. Strong mojo! The bearer of this relic, no matter how many disgraces he be sufferin', be always honored by his peers. Incredible! I gots no coins right now, mon, but ya be welcome to this here...
english.completed: Return to Griftah in Shattrath City.

text.title: 阿曼尼督军
text.objectives: Defeat the new Amani warlord, Daakara.
text.description: Da Amani been rebuildin' their forces and dey raised up a new warlord to lead dem, $N. He be called Daakara da Invincible, but we be seein' whether he lives up to the name or not.$B$BYa must first defeat all his lieutenants to clear da way before ya can face this Daakara. Defeat him and put an end to da ambitions of da Zandalari and da Amani!$B$B$B$B$B$B
text.progress: Dis new warlord must fall before da Zandalari foothold here becomes permanent.
text.completion: Victory be ours, $n. Da Zandalari be fleein' and without da warlord's leadership, da Amani will soon be reduced to fighting among demselves.
text.completed: Return to Vol'jin inside Zul'Aman.

english.title: ZZOLD Upper Deck Promo - Ghost Wolf Mount OLD

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Take Down Tethyr!
text.objectives: Major Mills at the Theramore docks wants you to defeat Tethyr.
text.description: 不管海怪是不是真的存在，我们都不准备让船只去冒险。我已经命令最棒的神射手做好与泰瑟尔交战的准备了。炮兵已经在码头增加了三门迫击炮。$B$B我将下令点亮灯塔。如果泰瑟尔进攻的话，你的任务就是在那个怪兽杀害所有神射手之前，用迫击炮打倒它。它多半不会老是呆在一个地方，用迫击炮吸引它的注意。
text.progress: Make your report.
text.completion: Well done, $N! I'll admit, when I caught my first glimpse of that beast, I had doubts about our ability to defend the docks, but you held together the defenders brilliantly!
text.completed: Return to Major Mills at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Take Down Tethyr!
english.objectives: Major Mills at the Theramore docks wants you to defeat Tethyr.
english.description: Sea monster or no, we're not going to risk the safety of our shipping. I've ordered our best marksmen to prepare for a confrontation with this Tethyr. The artillerymen have augmented the dock's defenses with three mortars.$B$BI'm going to order the lighthouse's lamp illuminated. If Tethyr does attack, it will be your job to operate the mortars and take down the beast before it can kill all of the marksmen. I wouldn't stand in one place too long, though. Using the mortars is likely to draw its attention.
english.progress: Make your report.
english.completion: Well done, $N! I'll admit, when I caught my first glimpse of that beast, I had doubts about our ability to defend the docks, but you held together the defenders brilliantly!
english.completed: Return to Major Mills at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 向斥候诺勒斯报到
text.objectives: 亚当斯上尉要你前往灰烬长矛塔楼，向斥候诺勒斯报到。
text.description: $N，谢谢你帮我们解决了该死的始祖龙，我还有另一项任务要交给你。$B$B根据侦察兵汇报，南边的村落有被遗忘者出没，行动非常可疑。他们聚集在那座名叫哈尔格林德的维库人村子里，显然是在策划什么阴谋。$B$B你最好去调查清楚。与斥候诺勒斯谈一谈，看看他有什么新发现。$B$B你可以在哈尔格林德以西的灰烬长矛塔楼找到他。
text.completion: Oh good, help, and just in time!

english.title: Report to Scout Knowles
english.objectives: Captain Adams has asked you to report to Scout Knowles at the Ember Spear Tower.
english.description: $N, now that those damnable proto-creatures have been dealt with, I've another task for you.$B$BOne of my scouts has reported back some suspicious activity by the Forsaken to the south. It looks like they're up to no good at the vrykul village known as Halgrind.$B$BI want you to personally take over the investigation down there. Speak with Scout Knowles to find out what he's uncovered and proceed from there.$B$BHis last reported position is at the Ember Spear Tower, just to the west of Halgrind.
english.completion: Oh good, help, and just in time!

text.title: [DEPRECATED]More than Coincidence
text.objectives: Krog at Brackenwall Village wants you to bring him 7 Blackhoof Armaments.
text.description: We've gleaned as much as we can from the ruins of the inn. I'm concerned about where the investigation will lead us from here, but we must know the truth.$B$BBetween the hoofprints and the shield with Mosarn's mark, I'm lead to believe that the Grimtotems may have been involved. They've recently established a settlement in the swamp, Blackhoof Village to the northeast. Travel to Blackhoof Village and search for more arms of Mosarn's manufacture.
text.progress: What did your search of Blackhoof Village reveal?
text.completion: <Krog inspects the weapons and armor you've brought from Blackhoof Village.>$B$BThis is unmistakably the work of Mosarn. Questioning him further may draw too much attention, but we have a bit more freedom in dealing with the Grimtotems.
text.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.completed: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Grimtotem Plot
text.objectives: Bring the Grimtotem Battle Plan to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
text.description: With the activities of the Grimtotems in Thousand Needles brought to light, many tauren now regard them with suspicion.  We've seen high-ranking Grimtotems engage in murder and kidnapping to advance their interests and I fear we may become their next target.$B$BBlackhoof Village, to the northeast, near Bluefen, is a large new Grimtotem settlement. Their leaders, the elders, will all have orders from Thunder Bluff. See if you can capture the orders and piece them together to learn the Grimtotems' plans.
text.progress: Were you able to find any trace of the orders?
text.completion: <Krog reads over the battle plan.>$B$BThere's no doubt in my mind that the Grimtotems are moving against the humans. What I don't understand is what their intentions are toward us. The actions of the Grimtotems have caused tension within the Horde in the past, but the Warchief has always diffused it.
text.completed: Return to Krog in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 任务：永恒的烈焰
text.objectives: 灰烬长矛塔楼的斥候诺勒斯要你利用永燃火炬摧毁哈尔格林德附近的4只药剂罐。
text.description: 被遗忘者可没安什么好心，你瞧，他们显然是想利用那些药剂罐做坏事。$B$B我觉得吧，我们应该尽快摧毁这些罐子，省得日后麻烦。我从灰烬龙巢搞来了一些火把，它们燃烧了好几天都没有熄灭！$B$B给，我相信你比我更擅长于火焰净化，去摧毁那些药剂罐吧。
text.progress: It's hard to tell from all the way over here exactly what's happening down there. Did you manage to put those plague tanks to the torch?
text.completion: Nice! But what's this about the stuff you found inside those tanks? Are you saying that the Forsaken are spraying a plague upon the vrykul down there?
text.completed: Return to Scout Knowles at Ember Spear Tower in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Mission: Eternal Flame
english.objectives: Scout Knowles at the Ember Spear Tower has recommended that you use the Ever-burning Torches to destroy the four Plague Tanks surrounding Halgrind.
english.description: The Forsaken are up to no good and from what I can tell, those plague tanks of sludge are a big part of it.$B$BIf I may suggest, $g sir : ma'am;, we should probably destroy them before they can get any more use out of the things. I took the liberty of preparing a bundle of torches from the Ember Clutch. These things have been burning for days!$B$BHere, I'm sure you can put them to better use than I in destroying those tanks.
english.progress: It's hard to tell from all the way over here exactly what's happening down there. Did you manage to put those plague tanks to the torch?
english.completion: Nice! But what's this about the stuff you found inside those tanks? Are you saying that the Forsaken are spraying a plague upon the vrykul down there?
english.completed: Return to Scout Knowles at Ember Spear Tower in Howling Fjord.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Seek Out Tabetha
text.objectives: 与泥潭沼泽中的一处小农庄里的塔贝萨谈一谈。
text.description: The arms you captured in Blackhoof Village have not seen any combat beyond mere training exercises, which means the Grimtotems who destroyed the Shady Rest are still at large.$B$BTo the south, in the heart of the Quagmire, lives the witch Tabetha. Though she is a human, she has dealt honorably with us and trained some of our mages.$B$BAsk her for assistance in tracking down the band of Grimtotem responsible for burning the inn. The Alliance must not be allowed to think we were complicit in the attack.
text.completion: <Tabetha smiles slightly.>$B$BKrog wishes me to scry for the Grimtotems, eh? Well, I have no need of magic in this case.$B$BIt seems we have a mutual enemy. The Grimtotems have built an outpost nearby and are a constant thorn in the side of me and my students.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Return to Krog
text.objectives: Speak with Krog at Brackenwall Village.
text.description: I hope I've been helpful to you and I'm sorry I can't offer more information. My apprentices and I produce such a large volume of arms and armor that it's almost impossible to recall details about any individual piece.$B$BNot only do we outfit the braves defending tauren lands, but the Grimtotems have a particular fondness for my work. A seasoned warrior knows good work when he sees it.
text.completion: He actually said that the Grimtotems are his biggest customers? Mosarn gave us more help than he knows. With this much pointing toward the Grimtotems, I think we just found our first suspects.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Raze Direhorn Post!
text.objectives: Burn the North Tent, East Tent, and the Northeast Tent at Direhorn Post, then return to Tabetha at her farm.
text.description: 根本没有必要用水晶球来看看我们的新“邻居”在干些什么。如果你所言非虚，这就是焚毁树荫旅店的那支部队，那么我们也没有理由再容忍他们的存在。$B$B拿上这根火把，将他们的营地夷为平地吧！你可以在我的农场略北一些的地方找到恐角岗哨。你不可能看不到，真的，因为恐怖图腾在那里竖着许多非常华丽的图腾，以此表明他们对图腾的喜爱。
text.progress: Have you put that torch to good use?
text.completion: The Grimtotems should have no trouble understanding our latest message.$B$BAs for you, your contact at Brackenwall Village will want to know of your success. I know the destruction of the Shady Rest Inn could be a source of tensions between the Horde and Alliance. If I encounter any investigators from Theramore, I will gladly tell them the Grimtotems acted on their own.
text.completed: Return to Tabetha at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.objectives: Burn the North Tent, East Tent, and the Northeast Tent at Direhorn Post, then return to Tabetha at her farm.
english.description: There's no scrying necessary to see the trouble my new "neighbors" are creating. And if this is the band that burnt down the Shady Rest Inn, as you claim, there's no reason to tolerate their presence any longer.$B$BTake this torch and raze their camp to the ground! You'll find Direhorn just to the north of my farm, near the road. You can't miss it, really, as the Grimtotems have done a splendid job of announcing their presence with those totems they favor.
english.progress: Have you put that torch to good use?
english.completion: The Grimtotems should have no trouble understanding our latest message.$B$BAs for you, your contact at Brackenwall Village will want to know of your success. I know the destruction of the Shady Rest Inn could be a source of tensions between the Horde and Alliance. If I encounter any investigators from Theramore, I will gladly tell them the Grimtotems acted on their own.
english.completed: Return to Tabetha at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Justice Dispensed
text.objectives: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
text.description: I doubt the Grimtotems will give up their campaign to drive humans from the marsh, though I get the impression you probably don't mind that. At least we have dealt with the perpetrators of the crimes at the Shady Rest Inn.$B$BGo tell your leader that his vengeance has been sated.
text.completion: <Krog listens to your report.>$B$BI'm impressed, $N. I would've thought that the Grimtotem criminals would've been more difficult to locate. $B$BTabetha's warnings have not fallen on deaf ears, but it is not my place to chastise the Grimtotems. I will, of course, mention it in my report to the Warchief. Do not speak of it to anyone until Thrall has dealt with the Grimtotems. You have done well in solving the mystery of the Shady Rest and sparing us from the suspicion of Theramore.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 回收货物！
text.objectives: 比吉尔的飞艇残骸处的莫希·斯蒂格里要你找回8件飞艇上的货物。
text.description: 这艘飞艇运送了足足6个月的补给品给我们的泥链镇！当然，他们可以靠这些撑上一会儿，但没法坚持太久。$B$B我被派到这里来寻找任何我能找到的货物，但飞船的残骸支离破碎地散落在这块区域。我确信有很多货物没能在坠毁中保住，但你能不能尽可能地帮我把货物找来？
text.progress: <Moxie looks frantic with worry.>$B$BDid the cargo survive? Did you find any of it?
text.completion: Wow! You certainly found a lot more than I expected would be out there. I'm not sure how much Drazzit thought we were going to find out here, but he's going to have to be happy with this for now.
text.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Secure the Cargo!
english.objectives: Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck wants you to recover 8 pieces of Zeppelin Cargo.
english.description: This zeppelin was carrying six months' worth of supplies to us at Mudsprocket! Sure, they've been able to barter for some of what they need, but they won't hold out forever.$B$BI've been sent out here to recover what I can of the cargo, but the wreckage is scattered all over the marsh in this area. I'm sure a lot of the cargo didn't survive the crash, but are you willing to help me recover what we can?
english.progress: <Moxie looks frantic with worry.>$B$BDid the cargo survive? Did you find any of it?
english.completion: Wow! You certainly found a lot more than I expected would be out there. I'm not sure how much Drazzit thought we were going to find out here, but he's going to have to be happy with this for now.
english.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: Delivery for Drazzit
text.objectives: Take the Zeppelin Cargo to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
text.description: Drazzit will expect to hear something from me soon, but I don't think the site is secure enough for me to leave. If you have time, would you be willing to take some of the salvaged cargo down to him at Mudsprocket?$B$BIf you haven't been there yet, it's a small settlement to the southwest of here, beyond the Stonemaul Ruins. You can take the road there from Tabetha's Farm, too. When you get to Mudsprocket, the guy you're looking for is Drazzit Dripvalve.
text.progress: 有事吗?
text.completion: I'm so hungry, I could eat a dragon! Thank goodness Moxie finally got some of that cargo down here. We've been reduced to playing dice against the ogre for whatever he's managed to kill on his hunting trips!
text.completed: Return to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Nat's Bargain
text.objectives: Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing wants you to test his new fish bait.
text.description: So you found a copy of Dastardly Denizens of the Deep, did you? Well, I can tell you from experience, it's all true. I've even seen a few of 'em with my own eyes.$B$BBut you want to know about Tethyr.  I said I'd make you a deal, so here's what I want you to do. I'm working on a new line of baits, but I haven't tested this one yet.$B$BJust take this paste -- yeah, it smells a little foul -- smear it on yourself, and swim over to that wrecked ship to the southwest. If you survive, let me know how it works!
text.progress: Remember, the deal is "don't come back until something bites you."
text.completion: Not bad at all, but you know, I think I'd get a bath in as soon as possible, if I was you.$B$BNow, about your sea monster...$B$BHelp yourself to a brew or two in the meantime.
text.completed: Return to Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Nat's Bargain
english.objectives: Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing wants you to test his new fish bait.
english.description: So you found a copy of Dastardly Denizens of the Deep, did you? Well, I can tell you from experience, it's all true. I've even seen a few of 'em with my own eyes.$B$BBut you want to know about Tethyr.  I said I'd make you a deal, so here's what I want you to do. I'm working on a new line of baits, but I haven't tested this one yet.$B$BJust take this paste -- yeah, it smells a little foul -- smear it on yourself, and swim over to that wrecked ship to the southwest. If you survive, let me know how it works!
english.progress: Remember, the deal is "don't come back until something bites you."
english.completion: Not bad at all, but you know, I think I'd get a bath in as soon as possible, if I was you.$B$BNow, about your sea monster...$B$BHelp yourself to a brew or two in the meantime.
english.completed: Return to Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Oh, It's Real
text.objectives: 跟塞拉摩码头的米尔斯少校谈一谈。
text.description: 是的，泰瑟尔真的存在，而且他就在塞拉摩附近的水域里。$B$B他对亮光有着特别的爱好，这就是他们关闭灯塔的原因……$B$B如果你再次点亮灯塔的话，他马上就会游回来。不过一个神智正常的人是不会这么做的。$B$B啊哈！那肯定就是你的计划了！很高兴能和你喝两杯，不过如果泰瑟尔真的把你变成了鱼饵，不要抱怨老纳特没有提醒过你。如果你确定要这么做的话，先去和塞拉摩港口的米尔斯少校商量一下吧。
text.completion: <You recount your experiences with Nat Pagle, carefully omitting the portion about the 'bait test.'>$B$BWell, it sounds like we've got our work cut out for us. I'll make the preparations.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Oh, It's Real
english.objectives: Speak with Major Mills at the docks in Theramore.
english.description: Yes, Tethyr is certainly real, and he lives in the waters off Theramore.$B$BHas a thing for bright lights. He's the reason they shut down the lighthouse in the first place, you know...$B$BAnd if you light it up again, he'll come right back. But no one in their right mind would do that.$B$BSo that must be your plan! It's been good sharing a drink with you, but don't blame ol' Nat if Tethyr REALLY turns you into fish bait. If you're going to do this, make sure you consult Major Mills at the Theramore docks.
english.completion: <You recount your experiences with Nat Pagle, carefully omitting the portion about the 'bait test.'>$B$BWell, it sounds like we've got our work cut out for us. I'll make the preparations.

text.title: 帮助泥链镇
text.objectives: 跟泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔谈一谈。
text.description: 在那个地精……她叫什么名字来着……对了，莫希·斯蒂格里！总之，在她经过这里前往飞艇废墟的时候，她说泥链镇遇到了一些麻烦。$B$B那艘坠毁的飞艇本来是要把新鲜的补给带给他们的。如果你沿着这条路往南走，越过石槌废墟，泥链镇就在你眼前了。$B$B你为什么不去找那里的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔，看看他是否有什么事情需要你的帮助？
text.completion: It's good of Tabetha to send you down here. I'd prevail upon her for some food until the wreckage from the zeppelin is taken care of, but I know she's got none to spare at the moment. If you're feeling adventurous, I've posted a bounty for the death of a particularly nasty raptor.

english.title: Help for Mudsprocket
english.objectives: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
english.description: When that goblin... what's her name... Boxie, Foxy... Moxie, that's it! Anyway, when she came through here on her way to the zeppelin wreck, she said the town of Mudsprocket was having some problems.$B$BThat crashed zeppelin was bringing them fresh supplies. If you follow the road south from here, past the Stonemaul Ruins, you'll eventually come to Mudsprocket.$B$BWhy don't you check in with Drazzit Dripvalve down there and see if there's anything you can do to help?
english.completion: It's good of Tabetha to send you down here. I'd prevail upon her for some food until the wreckage from the zeppelin is taken care of, but I know she's got none to spare at the moment. If you're feeling adventurous, I've posted a bounty for the death of a particularly nasty raptor.

text.title: 塔贝萨的农场
text.objectives: 与泥潭沼泽中的一处小农庄里的塔贝萨谈一谈。
text.description: 有一位老巫女塔贝萨居住在沼泽的深处。我们对她的了解也不多，只是她会偶尔出现在这里，然后留下很长一串货物订单而已。她还经常帮助我们，并且在我们的军队与部落剑拔弩张时，她数次平息了可能发生的战事。$B$B她过去一直和我们定期联络，最近却一直没有她的消息了。$B$B如果你有空，是否能去看看她？你只需要一直沿着北点哨塔一侧的道路前进就可以了，路会折向南方，然后进入泥潭沼泽。她的小农庄就在路旁。
text.completion: It's good of Theramore to send someone. Your guard friend's suspicions were correct. We've got some new neighbors, and they aren't the kind you'd bring a casserole.

english.title: Tabetha's Farm
english.objectives: Speak with Tabetha at her farm in the Quagmire.
english.description: Deep in the heart of the swamp lives an old woman named Tabetha. We've never really known much about her, save that she's a good deal older than she appears. She's helped us from time to time and helped keep the peace here between the Horde and our forces.$B$BShe used to keep in regular contact, but we haven't received one lately.$B$BCould you check in with her when you have time? Just follow the road beyond North Point Tower, where it turns south and into the Quagmire. You can see her farm from the road.
english.completion: It's good of Theramore to send someone. Your guard friend's suspicions were correct. We've got some new neighbors, and they aren't the kind you'd bring a casserole.

text.title: 寻找塔贝萨
text.objectives: 与泥潭沼泽农场里的塔贝萨谈一谈。
text.description: 一个名叫塔贝萨的人类女性居住在靠近沼泽中央的小农场里。一般情况下，我是不会和一个人类交往的，不过她的帮助确实对我们很有裨益。$B$B不幸的是，我们很久都没有联系她了，而我正想找个人去她的农场看看是否一切都安然无恙。$B$B沿着南面的那条路离开村庄，在进入沼泽深处后，靠近泥潭沼泽中央的地方就是她的农场。
text.completion: It's fortunate Nazeer thought to send someone. We've got some new neighbors and they've been nothing but pests since they set up camp.

english.title: Check Up on Tabetha
english.objectives: Speak to Tabetha at her farm in the Quagmire.
english.description: A human woman named Tabetha lives on a small farm near the middle of the marsh. Ordinarily, I wouldn't associate with a human, but her help has proven useful at times.$B$BUnfortunately, she's been out of touch for quite some time now and I'm looking for someone to travel down to her farm to see if everything's all right.$B$BIf you follow the road south out of the village, then into the swamp's interior, you'll find her farm near the middle of the Quagmire.
english.completion: It's fortunate Nazeer thought to send someone. We've got some new neighbors and they've been nothing but pests since they set up camp.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 前往泥链镇
text.objectives: 跟泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔谈一谈。
text.description: 热砂财阀最近在尘泥沼泽的南部建立起了一处新的前哨。据我所知，它叫做泥链镇，就在塔贝萨的农场和石槌废墟往南的主路上。$B$B这是我们签订新贸易合同的大好机会，吉安娜女士要我派一个代表去谈协议。你愿意去吗？
text.completion: So Theramore is interested in doing business? Well, that's not an offer I'd turn down. Supplies are pretty scarce here right now, so we need all the business contacts we can get!

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Mission to Mudsprocket
english.objectives: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
english.description: The Steamwheedle Cartel has recently established a new outpost in the southern part of Dustwallow Marsh. It's called Mudsprocket, if I recall, and it's located on the main road south out of Tabetha's Farm and the Stonemaul Ruins.$B$BThis is an excellent opportunity for us to establish new trade contacts and Lady Jaina wants me to send a representative down there to establish contact. Would you be willing to go?
english.completion: So Theramore is interested in doing business? Well, that's not an offer I'd turn down. Supplies are pretty scarce here right now, so we need all the business contacts we can get!

text.title: Help Mudsprocket
text.objectives: 跟泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔谈一谈。
text.description: The Steamwheedle Cartel's new outpost in the southern part of the marsh isn't faring so well. The zeppelin carrying supplies to Mudsprocket crashed, leaving them without vital tools, food, and medical supplies.$B$BFollow the road down south and into the marsh's interior. You'll pass by Tabetha's Farm and the Stonemaul Ruins before the road brings you to Mudsprocket. Offer any help you can provide to the town's leadership.
text.completion: I won't turn down any help! We're in the process of setting up here and trying to make the most of what we've got, until those supplies from the zeppelin arrive.

english.objectives: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.

text.title: 大法师奥图鲁斯
text.objectives: 与逆风小径卡拉赞外的大法师奥图鲁斯谈一谈。
text.description: I was sent here by my mentor to look for assistance, but unfortunately I'm not allowed outside of Lower City and the individuals that frequent this establishment tend to be less than helpful.$B$BYou do seem different, more like the adventurous type.  If you're interested in aiding our cause, speak to Archmage Alturus outside of Medivh's old dwelling, Karazhan.$B$BIn the meantime, I'm going to see about gaining access to the rest of the city.  One of our old associates is rumored to be here.
text.completion: I thank you for taking the time to come to our aid.  We've important work ahead of us.

english.title: Archmage Alturus
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Alturus outside of Karazhan in Deadwind Pass.
english.description: I was sent here by my mentor to look for assistance, but unfortunately I'm not allowed outside of Lower City and the individuals that frequent this establishment tend to be less than helpful.$B$BYou do seem different, more like the adventurous type.  If you're interested in aiding our cause, speak to Archmage Alturus outside of Medivh's old dwelling, Karazhan.$B$BIn the meantime, I'm going to see about gaining access to the rest of the city.  One of our old associates is rumored to be here.
english.completion: I thank you for taking the time to come to our aid.  We've important work ahead of us.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 龙尾草
text.objectives: Gizzix Grimegurgle at Mudsprocket wants you to bring him 8 Wyrmtail stalks.
text.description: 飞艇的坠毁延缓了补给品的到达，我们的药品和绷带都用完了。$B$B我们正在利用一切可以获得的资源，不过这些虫子、伤者和一切与我们为敌的家伙都让我们焦头烂额，我快要坚持不下去了！我找到了一种草药，可以治疗伤口和缓解疼痛，但它也快要用完了。$B$B这种草药被称为龙尾草，它遍布在村子东面的黑龙谷和巨龙沼泽地区。那种植物的茎杆是卷曲的，而且你看着它们的时候似乎会微微地跳动。
text.progress: Did you find any of the wyrmtail?
text.completion: Thank you! This will help keep our guys going out in the field until Moxie returns with the rest of the supplies from the zeppelin crash.
text.completed: Return to Gizzix Grimegurgle at Murksprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Catch a Dragon by the Tail
english.objectives: Gizzix Grimegurgle at Mudsprocket wants you to bring him 8 Wyrmtail stalks.
english.description: With the zeppelin crash delaying supplies, we've run out of medicines and bandages.$B$BWe're making use of what we can, but between all the insects, the injuries, and the enemies we're encountering here, I can barely keep up! I've found one herb that seems to help heal wounds and dull pain, but it, too, is in short supply.$B$BIt's called wyrmtail, and it's abundant in the Dragonmurk and Wyrmbog areas east of town. The plants themselves are made of coiled stalks, and seem to pulsate when you look at them.
english.progress: Did you find any of the wyrmtail?
english.completion: Thank you! This will help keep our guys going out in the field until Moxie returns with the rest of the supplies from the zeppelin crash.
english.completed: Return to Gizzix Grimegurgle at Murksprocket in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 危险！爆炸品！
text.objectives: 利用斯迪尔林的安全雷管收集6份低语峡谷矿石碎块和18颗低语峡谷宝石，将它们交给西部卫戍要塞的斯迪尔林。
text.description: $N，亚当斯上尉交给我一项棘手的任务，而我需要你的帮助。$B$B我在探险者协会的一群同事进入北边的低语峡谷从事挖掘工事，但他们突然全都疯掉了。你能想象吗？他们会攻击所有企图接近峡谷的人。$B$B亚当斯上尉的脑子里却只有矿石供给这一件事情。好在我有办法解决眼前的难题。$B$B我要你进入低语峡谷，炸开矿脉，然后把矿石碎片和宝石给我带回来。维持要塞的运作可不便宜！$B$B不过我要警告你，那里的矿石很奇怪！
text.progress: Construction on this place seems to be a never-ending task. I just hope that you're able to get us what we need to continue.
text.completion: The ore gave you a strange feeling? Maybe we won't use that stuff after all. Those gems look really nice! I wonder what I can get for them? Of course, there are always repairs, and new stuff to be made. You know, I've really found working with you to be profitable. Take this... it's the least that I can do!
text.completed: Return to Sapper Steelring at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Danger! Explosives!
english.objectives: Use Steelring's Foolproof Dynamite to collect 6 Whisper Gulch Ore Fragments and 18 Whisper Gulch Gems. Then return them to Sapper Steelring at Westguard Keep.
english.description: $N, the captain's tasked me with a mission. I'd like you to help.$B$BA bunch of my fellow Explorers' League people went nuts digging up stuff in the Whisper Gulch just to the north. They're attacking anyone trying to get in!$B$BThe captain is only concerned with the ore for the keep. Lucky for us, I have just the thing to do the trick.$B$BGet in there, blow up the ore, and bring it back along with any gems you find. Running this place isn't cheap you know!$B$BI gotta warn you though, that ore is strange!
english.progress: Construction on this place seems to be a never-ending task. I just hope that you're able to get us what we need to continue.
english.completion: The ore gave you a strange feeling? Maybe we won't use that stuff after all. Those gems look really nice! I wonder what I can get for them? Of course, there are always repairs, and new stuff to be made. You know, I've really found working with you to be profitable. Take this... it's the least that I can do!
english.completed: Return to Sapper Steelring at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 赶快灭火！
text.objectives: 戴面具的孤儿院长希望你能帮忙扑灭村子里的所有火焰。在扑灭了所有火焰之后，回去向戴面具的孤儿院长汇报。
text.description: 部落的孩子需要你，$N。无头骑士曾经是一位人类圣骑士，然而现在却变成了一个疯狂的恶魔，在我们的村子里面纵火！你必须去扑灭那些火焰！提上一桶水去扑灭熊熊燃烧的火焰，要么就把它交给离火焰更近的伙伴们。熄灭所有的火焰，挫败无头骑士的阴谋吧！
text.progress: The Horde's children need you! Do not abandon them!
text.completion: The fires are out! You and your fire brigade were victorious! Hah! The Headless Horseman's attack has failed, but until he and his head are destroyed together, He will return. Until then, however, let's take comfort in the safety you brought our children. I am honored to have watched your brave work today.
text.completed: Return to Masked Orphan Matron.

english.title: Stop the Fires!
english.objectives: The Masked Orphan Matron wants you to help put out all the village fires.  When they are out, speak again to the Masked Orphan Matron in town.
english.description: The Horde's children need you, $n.  The Headless Horseman, once a human paladin and now an insane fiend, has set fire to our village!  You must put out those fires!$B$BGrab a bucket and throw it onto the blaze, or toss it to an ally who is closer to the flames.  Extinguish all the fires and thwart the Headless Horseman!
english.progress: The Horde's children need you! Do not abandon them!
english.completion: The fires are out! You and your fire brigade were victorious! Hah! The Headless Horseman's attack has failed, but until he and his head are destroyed together, He will return. Until then, however, let's take comfort in the safety you brought our children. I am honored to have watched your brave work today.
english.completed: Return to Masked Orphan Matron.

text.title: 无头骑士
text.objectives: 找到无头骑士的南瓜神龛。
text.description: Until the head of the Headless Horseman is destroyed, his rampage will not end.$B$BThe Horseman rests within the Forlorn Cloister of the Scarlet Monastery, in Tirisfal Glades.  Go to his pumpkin shrine and speak these words:$B$B  Horseman, rise$B  Your time is nigh$B  You felt death once$B  Now, know demise!$B$BThis will rouse the fiend.  Destroy the head of the Horseman and he will plague us no longer.
text.completion: The origin of this shrine is unknown, but there is no doubt to whom it pays homage...

text.title: Reports from the Field
text.objectives: Speak to Dark Ranger Lyana and Deathstalker Razael in the battlefield at the Bleeding Vale south of Vengeance Landing.  Return to High Executor Anselm when you've completed this task.
text.description: Our mission in Northrend is to destroy Arthas.  The Alliance are but an obstacle that we'll crush wherever we find them.$B$BWe've managed to destroy their easternmost fleet; but the survivors have barricaded themselves on the Derelict Strand, south of here.$B$BOur forces should've overwhelmed their make-shift defenses long ago, but we underestimated their will to live.  Seek my officers in the field, Dark Ranger Lyana and Deathstalker Razael and get them to report on the situation.
text.progress: Are you back with your report, $n?
text.completion: Cannons are holding us back?  I'll show them cannons.
text.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Proof of Treachery
text.objectives: Speak to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
text.description: Although Onyxia has been exposed and removed from the court, the Defias who carried out her plan must be punished. Carry word to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind castle that the Defias are the ones who carried out his kidnapping. I have little doubt that the king will mete out swift and terrible justice to those involved.$B$BI can use my magic to expedite your trip to Stormwind. Just speak to me when you're prepared to go, $N.
text.completion: <Highlord Bolvar listens while you deliver Jaina's message.>$B$BAre you certain? This is a very serious charge...

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Return to Jaina
text.objectives: Speak to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
text.description: 我得制定一个剿灭迪菲亚兄弟会余孽的计划。请你回到塞拉摩，转达我对吉安娜女士的谢意。一直以来，她都是我们忠诚的伙伴和坚定的盟友。$B$B你可以去城西法师区的法师塔下寻找大法师马林，他可以用法术迅速将你送回塞拉摩。
text.completion: That is excellent news, $N! I was worried the highlord might question the veracity of our information, but I see now my concern was misplaced.$B$BYou are to be well rewarded for your efforts on behalf of Theramore and the Alliance.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Return to Jaina
english.objectives: Speak to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
english.description: I must make plans to destroy the remnants of the Defias. Please convey my thanks to Lady Jaina, back in Theramore. She has ever been a loyal friend and steadfast ally.$B$BGo to the Mage Quarter at the western end of the city and speak with Archmage Malin at the foot of the tower there. He will speed your return to Theramore.
