text.title: 骡子和货物
text.objectives: 探险者亚比盖尔要你吓唬10头被遗弃的骡子（使用/raise命令），然后返回西部卫戍要塞向她复命。
text.description: 谣传北面的低语峡谷发生了可怕的事。数日前，探险者协会的一批勘查员进入了峡谷，据说他们发现了某种能令人发疯的东西。$B$B最要命的是，他们带走了绝大多数的骡子和装备。我可不想失去那些骡子！$B$B如果你碰巧要去那里，又碰巧遇见我的骡子的话，就悄悄地靠近，然后挥舞手臂吓唬它们。这样。它们肯定会害怕得跑回来。
text.progress: This is quite a blow to our efforts. I don't even want to know what they discovered down there.$B$BIt's enough to keep me awake at night just trying to imagine what it could be.
text.completion: I'm indebted to you, $c. At least with most of the mules and equipment recovered, we can hope to rebuild our numbers soon. Please, take this.
text.completed: Return to Explorer Abigail at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Send Them Packing
english.objectives: Explorer Abigail has asked you to /raise your hand at 10 Abandoned Pack Mules and then return to her at Westguard Keep.
english.description: I've heard rumors of bad happenings in the Whisper Gulch to the north. Most of the Explorers' League went down into that place, and some say they went mad with what they discovered.$B$BThat doesn't change the fact that they took most of our mules and equipment with them, though. I won't lose those mules!$B$BIf you find yourself in there, and happen across any of my mules, just get up close on them and threaten them with a raised hand. They'll spook and come home for sure.
english.progress: This is quite a blow to our efforts. I don't even want to know what they discovered down there.$B$BIt's enough to keep me awake at night just trying to imagine what it could be.
english.completion: I'm indebted to you, $c. At least with most of the mules and equipment recovered, we can hope to rebuild our numbers soon. Please, take this.
english.completed: Return to Explorer Abigail at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 女巫岭的隐士
text.objectives: 跟水光庄园的“沼泽之眼”加尔谈一谈。
text.description: 沼泽似乎对人类似乎有某种奇怪的效果。有人只是因为住在这里就发疯了。$B$B任何居住在水光庄园的人都不知怎么变得疯狂起来，它最新的主人“沼泽之眼”加尔已经表现出了一定的迹象。$B$B我不是很清楚那里到底有些什么，如果你去查看一下的话，我会对你表示真挚的感谢。$B$B庄园就在沼泽的东部边界，向东穿过蓝色沼泽和北点哨塔，庄园就在那座闹鬼的女巫岭上。
text.completion: Have you come here to spy on me? No?$B$BPerhaps you have an appreciation for fine cuisine, then? Good, you can help!

english.title: The Hermit of Witch Hill
english.objectives: Speak with "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
english.description: The marsh seems to have a strange effect on humans. Some grow mad simply by living here.$B$BAnyone who has ever settled at Swamplight Manor has gone mad in a spectacular way. The latest owner, one "Swamp Eye" Jarl, is already showing signs.$B$BI don't completely understand what's happening there, you'd have my thanks for looking into it.$B$BThe manor is at the eastern edge of the swamp. Trek east across Bluefen and past North Point Tower. The manor is in a haunted patch of land called Witch Hill.
english.completion: Have you come here to spy on me? No?$B$BPerhaps you have an appreciation for fine cuisine, then? Good, you can help!

english.title: Upper Deck Promo - Spectral Tiger Mount

text.title: 让它们吃乌鸦
text.objectives: 复仇港的猎犬管理员伯提乌斯要求你使用瘟疫犬笼召唤一只饥饿的瘟疫犬，并用复仇港西边那些峡湾乌鸦的肉将它喂饱。
text.description: 高级执行官要我派猎犬把那些敌人的斥候探子还有间谍都给挖出来，但这帮死狗……你看，是瘟疫犬……的确是死狗……不把它们喂饱就不肯干活。$B$B我们的军人一点都没有意识到这群死狗有多么挑食，军队配给的那些垃圾狗食它们闻都不要闻，还怎么能指望靠狗抓斥候呢？$B$B如果……我是说如果，你有时间的话，不如帮我们喂饱它们。你看，西边有许多乌鸦，那些乌鸦的肉是这些死狗最爱吃的，虽然我们不觉得美味。怎么样，帮我带着一条狗去打一些乌鸦牙祭吧？
text.progress: Did you feed this little rascal here yet?
text.completion: Did you hunt down some crows, boy?  Good boy, good boy! Ah, these hounds remind me of my days raising purebreds in Tirisfal... those were good times!
text.completed: Return to Pontius at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Let Them Eat Crow
english.objectives: Pontius, the kennel keeper at Vengeance Landing, wants you to use the Plaguehound Cage to summon a Hungry Plaguehound and feed it Crow Meat from Fjord Crows west of Vengeance Landing.
english.description: The high executor wants me to use my dogs to sniff out enemy scouts, but I can tell you right now these plaguehounds aren't going anywhere until they're properly fed.$B$BIf our military doesn't understand that these beasts are picky enough to not eat the rubbish they've given me, then they can't expect them to be of any use in the field.$B$BYou seem to have some time on your hands, why don't you take one of these dogs out hunting for crows out west?  Their meat isn't very tasty to us, but my boys love it!
english.progress: Did you feed this little rascal here yet?
english.completion: Did you hunt down some crows, boy?  Good boy, good boy! Ah, these hounds remind me of my days raising purebreds in Tirisfal... those were good times!
english.completed: Return to Pontius at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 冰冻的地狱……
text.objectives: 与瓦加德港口的凯勒中将谈一谈。
text.description: 瞧瞧弗塔根公爵派来驻守瓦加德港口的军队，如果他认为这帮毫无经验的小杂兵能成功地牵制敌人的攻势，那就大错特错了。$B$B<玛卡洛伊扬起眉毛，打量着你的装备。>$B$B啧啧，你似乎混得不错嘛。$B$B瓦加德港口在战略上的重要性是不言而喻的，但是盘踞在空中的这些怪兽对目前的战况来说无疑是雪上加霜啊。$B$B向西北边的凯勒中将报到吧，告诉他你是个有能耐的强者。
text.completion: The dwarf speaks the truth. We can't afford to lose this port. It's one of two safe harbors that the Alliance has on this chunk of frozen hell - the other being a few hundred miles west of here on the coast of the Borean Tundra.

english.title: Hell Has Frozen Over...
english.objectives: Speak with Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port.
english.description: Fordragon's got another thing coming if he thinks the group of green-gilled scrubs he sent to defend this port can hold out much longer.$B$B<Macalroy raises an eyebrow as he examines your equipment.>$B$BYou, however, might fare a bit better.$B$BThe importance of holding this port cannot be stated enough; and with those monsters flying overhead, the situation around here has gone from bad to worse.$B$BReport to Vice Admiral Keller just northwest of here and let him know that you're all out of bubble gum.
english.completion: The dwarf speaks the truth. We can't afford to lose this port. It's one of two safe harbors that the Alliance has on this chunk of frozen hell - the other being a few hundred miles west of here on the coast of the Borean Tundra.

text.title: The Windrunner Fleet
text.objectives: Speak to Bat Handler Camille at Vengeance Landing and obtain passage to the Windrunner.  Report to Captain Harker aboard the ship.
text.description: We have the Windrunner, the Queen's Reprisal and the Oblivion stationed just east of the Derelict Strand.  Send orders to the fleet's commander, Captain Harker, that they're to destroy the Alliance's cannons.$B$BSpeak to our bat handler, Camille, and ask for passage to the fleet's location.  Be quick, $N, every minute we spend fighting the Alliance is a minute we could've spent fighting Arthas.
text.completion: I hope you're ready to fight, $n.  The Queen's fleet needs you!

english.title: The Windrunner Fleet
english.objectives: Speak to Bat Handler Camille at Vengeance Landing and obtain passage to the Windrunner.  Report to Captain Harker aboard the ship.
english.description: We have the Windrunner, the Queen's Reprisal and the Oblivion stationed just east of the Derelict Strand.  Send orders to the fleet's commander, Captain Harker, that they're to destroy the Alliance's cannons.$B$BSpeak to our bat handler, Camille, and ask for passage to the fleet's location.  Be quick, $N, every minute we spend fighting the Alliance is a minute we could've spent fighting Arthas.
english.completion: I hope you're ready to fight, $n.  The Queen's fleet needs you!

text.title: 有埋伏！
text.objectives: Captain Harker aboard the Windrunner wants you to kill 15 North Fleet Marines.
text.description: This should have been a walk in the park.  Their forces are hungry, injured and ill equipped.  Yet somehow, we walked right into their trap.$B$BWe approached these reefs from the south to gain cover and were immediately boarded by the Alliance dogs.$B$BI'm sorry to say, if you want our cannons to fire at anything, you're going to have to help us take our ships back.
text.completion: Nice work paring those mongrels down to size.  My men will be able to clean up the rest.
text.completed: Return to Captain Harker abaord the Windrunner in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Ambushed!
english.objectives: Captain Harker aboard the Windrunner wants you to kill 15 North Fleet Marines.
english.description: This should have been a walk in the park.  Their forces are hungry, injured and ill equipped.  Yet somehow, we walked right into their trap.$B$BWe approached these reefs from the south to gain cover and were immediately boarded by the Alliance dogs.$B$BI'm sorry to say, if you want our cannons to fire at anything, you're going to have to help us take our ships back.
english.completion: Nice work paring those mongrels down to size.  My men will be able to clean up the rest.
english.completed: Return to Captain Harker abaord the Windrunner in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 钥匙和牢笼
text.objectives: 莱瓦里安神父要你去搜集足够的亚勒伯龙牢笼钥匙，用它们解救10个亚勒伯龙囚犯。完成任务后，返回西部卫戍要塞向他复命。
text.description: 上校可能并没有注意到，但据我们所知，维库人正在亚勒伯龙的北部进行一种残忍的“觉醒”仪式。$B$B他们在那种邪恶的仪式上进行活祭！$B$B$C，你必须去阻止他们！无论那些牢笼里关着什么人或生物，我们都得把他们放走。我估计那些维库人身上会有钥匙。$B$B如果再不处理的话，天知道我们是会遇见更多诡异的维库人，还是他们会唤醒某些更邪恶的东西！
text.progress: With the prisoners at Gjalerbron freed, the vrykul will be unable to continue their unholy rites.$B$BYou're our only hope of stopping them.
text.completion: Bless you child! With your help, the Light shines even in the darkest of places. Please, take this as just compensation for your good deeds. I shall see to the salvation of those you freed; at least, those truly within the Light, and the Alliance, who returned here to the keep.
text.completed: Return to Father Levariol at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Of Keys and Cages
english.objectives: Father Levariol has asked you to collect enough Gjalerbron Cage Keys to free 10 Gjalerbron Prisoners. Return to him at Westguard Keep when you manage to do so.
english.description: The captain may not care, but from the little we know, the vrykul are conducting heinous rites in some sort of 'awakening' ritual up north in Gjalerbron.$B$BThey're using living sacrifices to fuel their unholy rituals!$B$B$C, you must put a stop to this! It matters not who or what is in those cages, they must be freed. I'd bet that the vrykul hold the keys.$B$BThe Light knows the last thing we need is more of those strange vrykul walking about, or worse yet, them wakening something even more evil!
english.progress: With the prisoners at Gjalerbron freed, the vrykul will be unable to continue their unholy rites.$B$BYou're our only hope of stopping them.
english.completion: Bless you child! With your help, the Light shines even in the darkest of places. Please, take this as just compensation for your good deeds. I shall see to the salvation of those you freed; at least, those truly within the Light, and the Alliance, who returned here to the keep.
english.completed: Return to Father Levariol at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 指引方位
text.objectives: 使用烟雾信号弹标记出荒弃海岸北墙外的联盟火炮位置。完成任务后向鲜血谷的黑暗游侠莉安娜复命。
text.description: 现在我们可以发动反击了。但是现在的能见度比预期的要差一些，我们需要你到岸上去标记出打击目标。$B$B联盟的军队死守着西边的荒弃海岸，我要你带上这些烟雾弹，利用它们标记出荒弃海岸北墙外的炮位。$B$B标记了所有火炮的位置之后，你就立刻去向莉安娜报告。我们会照顾好自己的。
text.progress: The cannons, $n. Is someone going to take care of them?
text.completion: Excellent.  I will signal our ground troops to make their move.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Lyana at Bleeding Vale in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Guide Our Sights
english.objectives: Use the Smoke Flares at the location of the Alliance Cannons on the northern wall of the Derelict Strand.  Report to Dark Ranger Lyana at the Bleeding Vale after you've completed this task.
english.description: We should be able to kill our way back to our guns.  Unfortunately, visibility is less than desirable so you will have to mark our targets from the ground.$B$BTake these smoke flares with you and use them to mark the locations of the cannons along the northern wall in the Derelict Strand, west of here, where the Alliance are holding out.$B$BLet Lyana know as soon as the way is clear for the ground troops.  We can take care of ourselves over here.
english.progress: The cannons, $n. Is someone going to take care of them?
english.completion: Excellent.  I will signal our ground troops to make their move.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Lyana at Bleeding Vale in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Landing the Killing Blow
text.objectives: Dark Ranger Lyana south of the Vengeance Landing wants you to kill Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne, and Sergeant Lorric at the Derelict Strand.
text.description: You've proven yourself in the field of battle, $N.  You might very well have changed the tides in our favor.$B$BI've an important assignment for you now.  I'm not sure how much longer the weakness we've exposed is going to last, so we must use the element of surprise to our advantage.$B$BI want you to use the confusion created by our attack and go behind enemy lines to assassinate their leaders.  In order of rank, they are: Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne and Sergeant Lorric.  Good luck, $c.
text.progress: Are the Alliance leaders dead, $N? Do not return until they are.
text.completion: This marks undisputable victory for our forces.  Anselm will be most glad to hear about this.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Lyana at Bleeding Vale in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Landing the Killing Blow
english.objectives: Dark Ranger Lyana south of the Vengeance Landing wants you to kill Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne, and Sergeant Lorric at the Derelict Strand.
english.description: You've proven yourself in the field of battle, $N.  You might very well have changed the tides in our favor.$B$BI've an important assignment for you now.  I'm not sure how much longer the weakness we've exposed is going to last, so we must use the element of surprise to our advantage.$B$BI want you to use the confusion created by our attack and go behind enemy lines to assassinate their leaders.  In order of rank, they are: Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne and Sergeant Lorric.  Good luck, $c.
english.progress: Are the Alliance leaders dead, $N? Do not return until they are.
english.completion: This marks undisputable victory for our forces.  Anselm will be most glad to hear about this.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Lyana at Bleeding Vale in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Report to Anselm
text.objectives: Report back to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
text.description: Let's send word back to old Anselm then.  Victory has come later than expected, but better late than never.  Tell him it will take our forces a few hours at most to finish off the stragglers here.$B$BGlory to the Banshee Queen!
text.completion: It was about time.  The Alliance has been a thorn in our side for a long time now. There's no time to celebrate, however.  Look to the west, it appears we have visitors.

english.title: Report to Anselm
english.objectives: Report back to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
english.description: Let's send word back to old Anselm then.  Victory has come later than expected, but better late than never.  Tell him it will take our forces a few hours at most to finish off the stragglers here.$B$BGlory to the Banshee Queen!
english.completion: It was about time.  The Alliance has been a thorn in our side for a long time now. There's no time to celebrate, however.  Look to the west, it appears we have visitors.

text.title: 亚勒伯龙的麻烦
text.objectives: 亚当斯上尉要你去杀死15个亚勒伯龙战士、8个亚勒伯龙符文法师和8个亚勒伯龙沉睡卫士，然后返回西部卫戍要塞向他复命。
text.description: 现在我们又有新麻烦了。活着回来的探子告诉我，那些维库人正在他们北面的堡垒进行某种阴谋，他们把那个地方称做亚勒伯龙。$B$B那么，我要你到那里去尽可能多干掉一点维库人，并搞清楚他们到底在干什么。$B$B我信得过你，$N。
text.completion: Good work, $n, and good riddance. But, what you say about that place troubles me still, and I think our culling is not quite at an end!
text.completed: Return to Captain Adams at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Dealing With Gjalerbron
english.objectives: Captain Adams has asked you to kill 15 Gjalerbron Warriors, 8 Gjalerbron Rune-casters, and 8 Gjalerbron Sleep-watchers. Afterward, return to him at Westguard Keep.
english.description: And now we have a different problem. My scouts that have lived to return have informed me that the vrykul are up to no good at their main fortress to the north.$B$BThey call the place Gjalerbron, though you'd pronounce the 'Gj' as if it were an 'Sh'. Odd creatures.$B$BBut that's not important; what is, is that you get up there and put an end to the lives of as many of those creatures as you can while trying to figure out what they're up to.$B$BI know that I can count on you, $N.
english.completion: Good work, $n, and good riddance. But, what you say about that place troubles me still, and I think our culling is not quite at an end!
english.completed: Return to Captain Adams at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 通灵主宰麦森
text.objectives: 杀死通灵主宰麦森，然后返回西部卫戍要塞向亚当斯上尉复命。
text.description: 天灾军团正在亚勒伯龙出没，其中还有通灵师！他们肯定是想把维库人拉到阿尔萨斯的阵营里去。$B$B我要你去杀死这些通灵师的头目！$B$B$N，你要不惜一切代价完成这个任务。只要杀死通灵主宰麦森，那么无论他想要干什么，都会落空。$B$B我不想看见维库人和天灾军团结成同盟！$B$B麦森就在亚勒伯龙右后区的平台上。
text.progress: Are you sure that you killed Mezhen and his necrolords, $c?
text.completion: Well, that should take some of the pressure off of us. $n, time and again you have proven yourself invaluable to Westguard Keep and the Alliance at large. Pick something from the treasury, boy! It's the least we can do!
text.completed: Return to Captain Adams at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Necro Overlord Mezhen
english.objectives: Kill Necro Overlord Mezhen. Then, return to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep.
english.description: The Scourge are at Gjalerbron and they have necromancers with them! They must be working to bring the vrykul into Arthas' fold.$B$BI want the leader of these necrolords eliminated!$B$BDo whatever it takes, $N, but see to it that Necro Overlord Mezhen, and whatever he's attempting to accomplish, is neutralized.$B$BI will not see the vrykul successfully allied with the Scourge!$B$BLook for Mezhen on the platform in the rear right section of Gjalerbron.
english.progress: Are you sure that you killed Mezhen and his necrolords, $c?
english.completion: Well, that should take some of the pressure off of us. $n, time and again you have proven yourself invaluable to Westguard Keep and the Alliance at large. Pick something from the treasury, boy! It's the least we can do!
english.completed: Return to Captain Adams at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 亚勒伯龙攻击计划
text.objectives: 前往西部卫戍要塞，将亚勒伯龙攻击计划交给法师中尉玛利斯特。
text.description: 这些计划清晰地表明了一场即将对西部卫戍要塞发动的进攻。看来盘旋在空中的冰霜巨龙格拉希恩将会被用作进攻的手段。$B$B法师中尉玛利斯特应该可以提供一些建议，将计划交给他，他就在南方的要塞中。
text.progress: What?! Plans for an attack upon the keep? A FROST WYRM?!!!
text.completion: $n, we can't let this come to pass!
text.completed: Return to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Gjalerbron Attack Plans
english.objectives: Deliver the Gjalerbron Attack Plans to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep.
english.description: These plans detail an imminent attack upon Westguard Keep. It would appear that the frost wyrm, Glacion, who circles overhead is to be used for the offensive.$B$BSurely Mage-Lieutenant Malister would be of some assistance in this matter. Deliver the plans to him at the keep to the south.
english.progress: What?! Plans for an attack upon the keep? A FROST WYRM?!!!
english.completion: $n, we can't let this come to pass!
english.completed: Return to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 冰霜巨龙和它的主人
text.objectives: 杀死唤龙者维尔，使用唤龙者的号角召唤并杀死格拉希恩。然后返回西部卫戍要塞，将号角交给法师中尉玛利斯特。
text.description: You were right to bring this to me, $N. You must take help back north with you to Gjalerbron and slay that wyrm and its master, Wyrmcaller Vile!$B$BEven now, as we speak here, the frost wyrm may be on its way.$B$BHowever, if I'm reading these plans correctly, blowing the wyrmcaller's horn on his platform, outside in the rear left area of Gjalerbron, will call Glacion back. When the creature lands, destroy it!$B$BAnd $N, please bring me the horn. We wouldn't want it falling back into the wrong hands.
text.progress: Is the attack averted? Are the frost wyrm and its master destroyed? Did you retrieve the horn?
text.completion: Wow, that horn is cold! Once again you've saved Westguard Keep from certain doom. What a curious man you are, $n. If only there were more of you. Well, this certainly calls for a reward. Which do you prefer?
text.completed: Return to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: The Frost Wyrm and its Master
english.objectives: Slay Wyrmcaller Vile and use the Wyrmcaller's Horn to call down and slay Glacion. Then, return with the horn to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep.
english.description: You were right to bring this to me, $N. You must take help back north with you to Gjalerbron and slay that wyrm and its master, Wyrmcaller Vile!$B$BEven now, as we speak here, the frost wyrm may be on its way.$B$BHowever, if I'm reading these plans correctly, blowing the wyrmcaller's horn on his platform, outside in the rear left area of Gjalerbron, will call Glacion back. When the creature lands, destroy it!$B$BAnd $N, please bring me the horn. We wouldn't want it falling back into the wrong hands.
english.progress: Is the attack averted? Are the frost wyrm and its master destroyed? Did you retrieve the horn?
english.completion: Wow, that horn is cold! Once again you've saved Westguard Keep from certain doom. What a curious man you are, $n. If only there were more of you. Well, this certainly calls for a reward. Which do you prefer?
english.completed: Return to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 为圣光效力
text.objectives: 消灭10个不死的看守者、4个可怕的丧尸和2个腐烂的畸形妖，然后返回西部卫戍要塞向莱瓦里安神父复命。
text.description: 你已经成为了我们的榜样，$N，但有些东西依然让我感到不安，那就是：天灾军团。$B$B圣光无法容忍他们的存在，我们也不能。我不知道这个要求是不是太过分了，但我希望你能回到北边的亚勒伯龙，杀死那些邪恶的天灾军团成员！别忘了顺便检查一下亚勒伯龙下面的苏醒之厅！$B$B净化是救赎的关键，我的孩子。我们为你感到骄傲！
text.progress: The Holy Light moves through your actions and in all things.$B$BNo creature, no place, no matter how wicked, can escape its wrath!
text.completion: Bless you, $n, you have answered my prayers. Stand proudly in the Light, chin held high with the knowledge that your actions were most holy! I'm certain that the church's coffers can yield up something of use to you.
text.completed: Return to Father Levariol at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: In Service to the Light
english.objectives: Slay 10 Deathless Watchers, 4 Fearsome Horrors, and 2 Putrid Wights. Afterward, inform Father Levariol at Westguard Keep of your success.
english.description: Your service has been exemplary, $N, but there is something that is troubling me: the Scourge.$B$BThe Light cannot abide their presence, and neither shall we. I hope that it is not asking you too much, but I would have you return north to Gjalerbron and crush the unholy Scourge in that vile lair! Be sure to check for them in the Waking Halls beneath Gjalerbron as well.$B$BPurification is the key to salvation, my child. Make us proud!
english.progress: The Holy Light moves through your actions and in all things.$B$BNo creature, no place, no matter how wicked, can escape its wrath!
english.completion: Bless you, $n, you have answered my prayers. Stand proudly in the Light, chin held high with the knowledge that your actions were most holy! I'm certain that the church's coffers can yield up something of use to you.
english.completed: Return to Father Levariol at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 疯人的头领
text.objectives: 杀死斯奎格·埃德亨特，然后返回西部卫戍要塞向工兵斯迪尔林复命。
text.description: 朋友，有件事我不得不告诉你。在你外出执行任务时，亚当斯上尉对低语峡谷表现出极大的兴趣。$B$B他打算除掉探险者协会的老领队。我猜测军队很快就会对峡谷中剩余的勘察员发动攻击，以彻底解决问题。$B$B帮我个忙吧？返回低语峡谷，杀死斯奎格·埃德亨特。我记得他在西北角的洞穴中。
text.completion: The captain will be pleased to hear of your success. You know, since you've been such a good sport in dealing with this Whisper Gulch business, why don't you take your pick of one of these?
text.completed: Return to Sapper Steelring at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Leader of the Deranged
english.objectives: Slay Squeeg Idolhunter and then report back to Sapper Steelring at Westguard Keep.
english.description: So, I hate to say it, pal, but while you were out, the captain took a keener interest in that place.$B$BLooks like he wants my old Explorers' League boss in there dead. My guess would be that we're gearing up for an offensive to clear out the rest of them, and the captain wants their head lopped off, as it were.$B$BDo me a favor? Head back into Whisper Gulch and put an end to Squeeg Idolhunter. From what I remember, my guess would be that he's in the cave in the northwest corner.
english.completion: The captain will be pleased to hear of your success. You know, since you've been such a good sport in dealing with this Whisper Gulch business, why don't you take your pick of one of these?
english.completed: Return to Sapper Steelring at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Trail of Fire
text.objectives: Escort Apothecary Hanes out of the Derelict Strand.  Report to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord when you've completed this task.
text.description: Thanks for bailing me out of this mess, $N.  I was not looking forward to what these Alliance scumbags had in store for me.$B$BLet's get out of here and see if we can get back at them somehow.  Is that a campfire over there?
text.completion: Apothecary Hanes is alive?  You burned the Alliance supplies to the ground?  He must've gotten a real kick out of that. At any rate, the Royal Apothecary Society is in your debt, $n.  We thank you from the bottom of our black, black hearts.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

english.objectives: Escort Apothecary Hanes out of the Derelict Strand.  Report to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord when you've completed this task.

english.completion: Apothecary Hanes is alive?  You burned the Alliance supplies to the ground?  He must've gotten a real kick out of that. At any rate, the Royal Apothecary Society is in your debt, $n.  We thank you from the bottom of our black, black hearts.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 终于自由了！
text.objectives: Take the Tome of Thomas Thomson to the Costumed Orphan Matron in Goldshire, Kharanos or Azure Watch.
text.description: Rage was my prison, $N, and you have freed me.  Though I thought I did right, my soul now weeps for the terror and the death I have caused the good people of Azeroth.$B$BThank you for leading me back to the Light.  May I never again lose my way.$B$BTake this torn prayer book to an orphan matron, so the children may know that I will haunt them no more.
text.progress: You have something for me, good $n?
text.completion: What is this?  The tome of Thomas Thomson?  But that is the name of the Horseman before he was cursed!  Does this mean that he is finally free?  Does this mean he will no longer torment the good people of Azeroth? What a joyous day!  $n, your feat will live long with us.  The children, and their children, will sing your name!
text.completed: Return to Costumed Orphan Matron.

english.title: Free at Last!
english.objectives: Take the Tome of Thomas Thomson to the Costumed Orphan Matron in Goldshire, Kharanos or Azure Watch.
english.description: Rage was my prison, $N, and you have freed me.  Though I thought I did right, my soul now weeps for the terror and the death I have caused the good people of Azeroth.$B$BThank you for leading me back to the Light.  May I never again lose my way.$B$BTake this torn prayer book to an orphan matron, so the children may know that I will haunt them no more.
english.progress: You have something for me, good $n?
english.completion: What is this?  The tome of Thomas Thomson?  But that is the name of the Horseman before he was cursed!  Does this mean that he is finally free?  Does this mean he will no longer torment the good people of Azeroth? What a joyous day!  $n, your feat will live long with us.  The children, and their children, will sing your name!
english.completed: Return to Costumed Orphan Matron.

text.title: 如果瓦加德失守……
text.objectives: Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port in the Howling Fjord wants you to slay 12 Dragonflayer Invaders or Dragonflayer Worgs.$B$B
text.description: 一旦瓦加德港口失守，连接诺森德的主要供给线就会被切断。那样的话，我们沦为巫妖王的奴隶便是迟早的事了。我不清楚你的情况，但是我的妻子和三个孩子还在艾尔文森林等我回家，说什么我都要奋力一搏。$B$B眼下战况危急，我们必须调用所有能派上用场的人手。去前门帮助卫兵抵御那些怪物的入侵吧！
text.progress: The fate of the world may very well rest with us.
text.completion: You gave our defenders the extra support they needed, $n. Morale is higher than ever now, thanks to you. I think they'll be able to handle the remaining onslaught on their own. I've got bigger plans for you...
text.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

english.title: If Valgarde Falls...
english.objectives: Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port in the Howling Fjord wants you to slay 12 Dragonflayer Invaders or Dragonflayer Worgs.$B$B
english.description: If Valgarde falls, our primary supply line into Northrend will cease to exist. From there it'll only be a matter of time before we're all servants of the Lich King. Now I don't know about you, but I've got a wife and three kids back in Elwynn and I'll be damned if I'll go down without a fight.$B$BThe situation here is critical and we can use all the manpower you're able to muster. Get to the front gate and help the guards defend the city against the invading monsters!
english.progress: The fate of the world may very well rest with us.
english.completion: You gave our defenders the extra support they needed, $n. Morale is higher than ever now, thanks to you. I think they'll be able to handle the remaining onslaught on their own. I've got bigger plans for you...
english.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 营救行动
text.objectives: 嚎风峡湾瓦加德港口的凯勒中将要你解救8名奄奄一息的瓦加德斥候。
text.description: We'd been here for a month when those malformed giants appeared out of thin air. We were ill-prepared for any sort of attack and paid dearly for our complacency. An entire archaeology team was lost and several townsfolk were abducted and taken to the ruins. We've been on the defensive ever since.$B$BTo make matters worse, the scouts we sent to rescue our people have been harpooned by the vrykul and left for dead in the forest directly north of Valgarde. Dislodge those harpoons and free our scouts!$B$B
text.progress: Find those scouts!
text.completion: What the vrykul did to our scouts was a gruesome display of savagery. It was a scare tactic, meant to weaken our resolve... to send us running in fear for our lives. It failed. We are going to show those monsters what it means to wage war against the Alliance!
text.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Rescuing the Rescuers
english.objectives: Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port in the Howling Fjord wants you to rescue 8 Valgarde Scouts that have been impaled and left for dead.
english.description: We'd been here for a month when those malformed giants appeared out of thin air. We were ill-prepared for any sort of attack and paid dearly for our complacency. An entire archaeology team was lost and several townsfolk were abducted and taken to the ruins. We've been on the defensive ever since.$B$BTo make matters worse, the scouts we sent to rescue our people have been harpooned by the vrykul and left for dead in the forest directly north of Valgarde. Dislodge those harpoons and free our scouts!$B$B
english.progress: Find those scouts!
english.completion: What the vrykul did to our scouts was a gruesome display of savagery. It was a scare tactic, meant to weaken our resolve... to send us running in fear for our lives. It failed. We are going to show those monsters what it means to wage war against the Alliance!
english.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 危险的塔楼
text.objectives: 西部卫戍军士要你前往斯克恩，利用军士的烟幕弹标记四座塔楼的位置，供炮击定位用。
text.description: $G Sir : Ma'am;, as we move through Skorn, we have to bring down those towers!$B$BIf you have a look at them, you'll notice that their tops are lined with casters. Getting too close to them would mean certain doom for us!$B$BHowever, we do have it within our means to call in cannon volleys from Westguard Keep. To do so, we need to get close enough so that you can lob a smoke flare atop of them.$B$BJust don't get too close!
text.progress: Getting too close to those towers is certain death as long as those casters are up there.
text.completion: Excellent targeting, sir! I'll have to remember to buy a round for the cannoneers back at the keep.
text.completed: Speak to the Westguard Sergeant accompanying you. Use your Westguard Command Insignia if the Westguard Sergeant is not nearby.

english.title: Towers of Certain Doom
english.objectives: The Westguard Sergeant has informed you that using the Sergeant's Flare to target all four of the towers at Skorn for cannon volleys would be advisable.
english.description: $G Sir : Ma'am;, as we move through Skorn, we have to bring down those towers!$B$BIf you have a look at them, you'll notice that their tops are lined with casters. Getting too close to them would mean certain doom for us!$B$BHowever, we do have it within our means to call in cannon volleys from Westguard Keep. To do so, we need to get close enough so that you can lob a smoke flare atop of them.$B$BJust don't get too close!
english.progress: Getting too close to those towers is certain death as long as those casters are up there.
english.completion: Excellent targeting, sir! I'll have to remember to buy a round for the cannoneers back at the keep.
english.completed: Speak to the Westguard Sergeant accompanying you. Use your Westguard Command Insignia if the Westguard Sergeant is not nearby.

text.title: 可怕而必要的手段
text.objectives: 西部卫戍军士要你前往斯克恩，利用军士的弯刀确保20个斯克恩部族的维库人无法复活。
text.description: 我们得到报告说，这些维库人会死而复生。他们和天灾军团不一样，是另一种形式的不死生物。$B$B我们不能冒这个险。$B$B来，拿着我的刀。当我们穿过这个地区的时候，你要用它确保那些被我们打倒的维库人不会再突然跳起来。这本该是我的工作，可惜我的胃比较脆弱。$B$B<中士幸灾乐祸地笑了笑。>$B$B这把刀我已经磨了一上午了，肯定非常好用。
text.progress: One thing that I know for certain is that I don't want to see any of these bigguns standing back up after we've knocked 'em down!
text.completion: Well, sir, I have to say that you went about that particular business with a bit of zeal. Anyway, if you don't mind, I'll be taking my machete back now. It looks dull and we wouldn't want you to accidentally slip and carve me up, too.
text.completed: Speak to the Westguard Sergeant accompanying you. Use your Westguard Command Insignia if the Westguard Sergeant is not nearby.

english.title: Gruesome, But Necessary
english.objectives: The Westguard Sergeant has asked you to use The Sergeant's Machete to dismember 20 Vrykul of the Winterskorn tribe at Skorn.
english.description: We've had reports that these vrykul can rise from the dead; not unlike the Scourge, but a different kind of undeath.$B$BLet's not take any chances.$B$BHere, take my machete. As we move through this place, you'll need to carve up the remains of the vrykul that we take down. I'd do it, but I have a sensitive stomach.$B$B<The sergeant smirks.>$B$BI spent all morning sharpening it, so it should do the job.
english.progress: One thing that I know for certain is that I don't want to see any of these bigguns standing back up after we've knocked 'em down!
english.completion: Well, sir, I have to say that you went about that particular business with a bit of zeal. Anyway, if you don't mind, I'll be taking my machete back now. It looks dull and we wouldn't want you to accidentally slip and carve me up, too.
english.completed: Speak to the Westguard Sergeant accompanying you. Use your Westguard Command Insignia if the Westguard Sergeant is not nearby.

text.title: 燃烧吧，斯克恩，燃烧吧！
text.objectives: 西部卫戍军士要你前往斯克恩，利用军士的火炬烧毁东北方的长屋、西北方的长屋以及兵营。
text.description: 亚当斯上尉曾经严令我必须重点打击此地的基础设施。$B$B但既然现在这里由您负责，那您可以酌情处理。$B$B我建议我们是否可以去烧毁斯克恩洼地里的那两座长屋和兵营？我们只需要进入这些建筑内部，然后把这根火炬扔进去就行了。
text.progress: May I suggest that when we set the buildings ablaze, we not tarry too long inside of them?
text.completion: Very good, sir. That couldn't have been done without your help. I'm sure that the captain will be pleased with my report on the matter once we're done here.
text.completed: Speak to the Westguard Sergeant accompanying you. Use your Westguard Command Insignia if the Westguard Sergeant is not nearby.

english.title: Burn Skorn, Burn!
english.objectives: The Westguard Sergeant has orders that you should use the Sergeant's Torch to set fire to the Northeast and Northwest Longhouses and the Barracks at Skorn.
english.description: Captain Adams gave me strict instructions to make sure that a good deal of infrastructure damage was inflicted on this site.$B$BHowever, since you're in charge out here, that's at your discretion, $g sir : ma'am;.$B$BMay I suggest that we burn down the two longhouses and the barracks that are in the lower area of Skorn? All we have to do is get inside each and throw this torch.
english.progress: May I suggest that when we set the buildings ablaze, we not tarry too long inside of them?
english.completion: Very good, sir. That couldn't have been done without your help. I'm sure that the captain will be pleased with my report on the matter once we're done here.
english.completed: Speak to the Westguard Sergeant accompanying you. Use your Westguard Command Insignia if the Westguard Sergeant is not nearby.

text.title: 行动代号：斯克恩之怒
text.objectives: Captain Adams has asked you to use the Westguard Command Insignia at Skorn, and then to speak with the Westguard Sergeant.
text.description: $N，我不得不把这个极其危险的任务交给你，也只有你才能完成它。$B$B维库人的堡垒斯克恩就坐落在我们的东方。我的探子回报说，那些“巨人”打算攻击我们。我的部队分散在海湾各地，所以我没有足够的人手去攻占那里。$B$B因此，你是最佳的人选。我已经派了一名军士先行潜入那里。在斯克恩出示这枚令牌，他就会现身并听从你的指挥。
text.completion: A pleasure to meet you, sir! I look forward to working with you. Speaking of which, we have a great deal to do.

english.title: Operation: Skornful Wrath
english.objectives: Captain Adams has asked you to use the Westguard Command Insignia at Skorn, and then to speak with the Westguard Sergeant.
english.description: $N, I must now ask you to undertake an operation so hazardous, so deadly, that only you can see it through.$B$BThe vrykul fortress, Skorn, sits on our eastern border. My scouts inform me that those 'giants' are poised to strike us, and with my forces scattered all over the fjord, I don't have the men to take the place by force.$B$BInstead, you're going to use your cunning. I've sent a sergeant ahead with the details. Show this command insignia at Skorn and he'll reveal himself and follow your orders.
english.completion: A pleasure to meet you, sir! I look forward to working with you. Speaking of which, we have a great deal to do.

text.title: 阻止升华！
text.objectives: 在领主的火堆附近展开维库升华卷轴，召唤出维库领主并杀死他。完成以后，鉴于这种仪式的性质，你确信西部卫戍要塞里的莱瓦里安神父会对这张卷轴感兴趣。
text.description: 这张巨大的卷轴是用龙皮制作的。展开这张长达十尺的卷轴之后，你看到覆盖着鳞片的卷轴上画着一副维库人的神秘仪式的场景。$B$B一个维库领主，在一群天使形象的生物的环绕中，正缓缓升入天堂。而这副图的背景，则是一个神秘而巨大的黑影。$B$B你突然意识到，这就是斯克恩的领主正要去做的事。你必须阻止他！在斯克恩的顶层，领主的房间外已经堆好了一大捆木柴。
text.progress: Yes? How may I help you, my child?
text.completion: Yes, my son, that is ominous-looking, and you obviously had the right of it. Thank you for bringing this scroll to me. I am very keen to study its implications. If I were to hazard a guess, I would say that these vrykul have a way to transcend death; at least those that are worthy. By defeating the Winterskorn thane, you proved him unworthy. The Light only knows what he would have become, and what terror he might have rained down upon us, had you not slain him.
text.completed: Return to Father Levariol at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Stop the Ascension!
english.objectives: Present the Vrykul Scroll of Ascension near the Thane's Pyre to call him out and slay him. Afterward, due to the nature of the ritual, you're sure that Father Levariol at Westguard Keep will be interested in seeing the scroll.
english.description: This huge scroll is made from dragon skin. Unfurling its more-than-ten-foot length, you can see that the images painted upon its scaly surface depict a mysterious vrykul ritual.$B$BA vrykul thane, surrounded by angelic-looking beings, ascends into the heavens. A mysterious, darkened figure looms large in the picture's background.$B$BA tingling in your gut tells you that the thane of Skorn is about to do this. You must stop it! A large pyre sits at the top of Skorn in front of the thane's lodge.
english.progress: Yes? How may I help you, my child?
english.completion: Yes, my son, that is ominous-looking, and you obviously had the right of it. Thank you for bringing this scroll to me. I am very keen to study its implications. If I were to hazard a guess, I would say that these vrykul have a way to transcend death; at least those that are worthy. By defeating the Winterskorn thane, you proved him unworthy. The Light only knows what he would have become, and what terror he might have rained down upon us, had you not slain him.
english.completed: Return to Father Levariol at Westgarde Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 向斯克恩的征服者致敬！
text.objectives: 将西部卫戍令牌交给西部卫戍要塞的亚当斯上尉。
text.description: 我们——好吧，是您——已经完成了我们在这里的所有任务。我必须承认，能够听从您这样一个出色的年轻$C的指挥，让我感到非常荣幸。$B$B上尉一定在等待您凯旋的消息，但是如果您打算再逗留一段时间，我也非常乐意为您效劳。
text.progress: I gather that since you're here, Skorn is no more?
text.completion: That's unbelievably good news! I knew that you could pull it off, $n! At least someone around here can produce results! Well, this calls for a reward. Go ahead, take your pick; the treasury is open to you.
text.completed: Return to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

english.title: All Hail the Conqueror of Skorn!
english.objectives: Return the Westguard Command Insignia to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep.
english.description: We -- well, you -- have done everything that we were sent here to accomplish $g sir : ma'am;. I must say that it's been a pleasure taking orders from such a fine, young $r.$B$BThe captain is sure to want to hear of your success, but if you decide to stay out here for whatever reason, I am at your disposal.
english.progress: I gather that since you're here, Skorn is no more?
english.completion: That's unbelievably good news! I knew that you could pull it off, $n! At least someone around here can produce results! Well, this calls for a reward. Go ahead, take your pick; the treasury is open to you.
english.completed: Return to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 跑腿侦查
text.objectives: 斥候瓦罗瑞要你前往龙颅村的东北方调查情况。
text.description: 我们费了很大的劲，总算完成了对挖掘场的调查。$B$B情况并不乐观。那里的人要么被杀要么被虏走，只有极少数的老兵幸免于难。$B$B侦察兵能做的只有这些啦，接下来就要靠你了。$B$B东北方的小山坡传来阵阵激烈的交战声。$C，去那里瞧瞧吧。或许我们能从幸存者口中得到敌人的情报。
text.completion: Late though ye may be, it's good to see a friendly face. Now stop standin' around with yer thumb up yer nose. there's work to be done!

english.title: Fresh Legs
english.objectives: Scout Valory wants you to investigate the sounds of battle coming from the northeast of Wyrmskull Village.
english.description: It's come at great cost, but we've completed our inspection of the site.$b$bThe news isn't good. Nearly everyone has been slain or captured. Only a few veteran guards remain unaccounted for.$b$bThe scouts have done all we can here. You must pick up where we've left off.$b$bSounds of a skirmish are coming from up the hill to the northeast. Have a look, $c. We can only hope there are some who have survived, and that they may have some intel we can use against this enemy.
english.completion: Late though ye may be, it's good to see a friendly face. Now stop standin' around with yer thumb up yer nose. there's work to be done!

text.title: 杀入乌特加德！
text.objectives: 防御者墨尔顿指派你去消灭乌特加德城堡的劫掠者因格瓦尔。$B$B将因格瓦尔的徽记交给凯勒中将。
text.description: 听着，年轻人。我已经把我对于这群生物的了解记录下来了——还有你了解到的其它信息。这些是你必须知道的……$B$B维库人对战斗无所畏惧。确切地说，他们似乎很渴望战死在沙场上。他们的数量和凶残让我们毫无还手之力。$B$B不过他们非常敬重叫做一个因格瓦尔的家伙。我不知道为什么他们一直在寻求他的赞扬，不过如果能够打倒他的话，就一定可以重创他们的士气。$B$B然后，也许，我们会有机会……
text.progress: Good to see you're well, $n. We've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
text.completion: Outstanding! This could be the turn of luck we've all been hoping for. Well done, $n!
text.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Into Utgarde!
english.objectives: Defender Mordun has tasked you with the execution of Ingvar the Plunderer who resides deep in Utgarde.$b$bYou are then to bring his head to Vice Admiral Keller.
english.description: Listen up, youngster. I've put down me share of these creatures - and your share too fer that matter. Here be what ya need to know....$b$bThe vrykul are fearless in a fight. Seems they actually yearn fer a death in battle. With their numbers and that ferocity, we're doomed - plain and simple.$b$bThere's one they esteem though, goes by the name of Ingvar. I dunno why they be seekin' his praise, but bring him down and you'll deal a mighty blow to their spirit.$b$bThen, perhaps, we'll have a chance....
english.progress: Good to see you're well, $n. We've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
english.completion: Outstanding! This could be the turn of luck we've all been hoping for. Well done, $n!
english.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Sniff Out the Enemy
text.objectives: Use the Plaguehound Leash near the plaguehound cages at Vengeance Landing and look for clues at the location you're led to by the Plaguehound Tracker.
text.description: Now that this rascal's belly's full, maybe he will be more willing to cooperate.  Here's his leash, just come get him from his cage whenever you're ready to take him.$B$BI don't know what Anselm expects you to find, but look for clues wherever it is that the dog takes you.
text.completion: This scaly scroll is covered in stark painted images.  You've a feeling this is the sort of thing the kennel keeper had in mind when he asked you to look for clues.

text.title: The Dragonskin Map
text.objectives: Bring the Dragonskin Map to High Executor Anselm in Vengeance Landing.
text.description: Upon closer inspection, the scroll appears to be a heavily-illustrated map of the fjord.  The location of various villages are depicted in what seem to be tribal symbols.$B$BThe location of Vengeance Landing is marked with a disproportionately large skull.$B$BThis map will almost certainly be of military value to High Executor Anselm.
text.progress: You've something to show me, $c?
text.completion: Here's the eastern coastline over here.  The Dragonflayer and Winterskorn villages are here and here... and this must be us over here, marked for death.
text.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 龙颅村的囚犯
text.objectives: 嚎风峡湾瓦加德港口的凯勒中将要你营救3名被俘虏的瓦加德囚犯。
text.description: $N，战争远远没有结束。我们必须搭救村子中的幸存者。$B$B<凯勒中将对你点了点头。>$B$B前往北方的龙颅村寻找幸存者的下落吧。如果他们被囚禁起来了，你要设法打开牢笼。$B$B或许他们能提供更为详细的关于畸形巨人的情报。
text.progress: Put some backbone into it, $n! People's lives are at stake here!
text.completion: Those soldiers you rescued had a good bit of information for us. These monsters call themselves 'vrykul.' The tribe that's taken up residence in Wyrmskull Village is led by a mystic named Yanis who himself is an underling of another vrykul known as Ingvar the Plunderer.
text.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Prisoners of Wyrmskull
english.objectives: Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port in the Howling Fjord wants you to rescue 3 Captured Valgarde Prisoners.
english.description: This battle is far from over, $N. If our people are still alive inside that village, someone has to go and get 'em.$B$B<Vice Admiral Keller nods at you.>$B$BHead north and enter Wyrmskull Village. Once there, look for our people. If they are imprisoned you'll need to find a way to break them out.$B$BMaybe they'll have some more information about what it is that we're actually fighting.
english.progress: Put some backbone into it, $n! People's lives are at stake here!
english.completion: Those soldiers you rescued had a good bit of information for us. These monsters call themselves 'vrykul.' The tribe that's taken up residence in Wyrmskull Village is led by a mystic named Yanis who himself is an underling of another vrykul known as Ingvar the Plunderer.
english.completed: Return to Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Skorn Must Fall!
text.objectives: Chieftain Ashtotem has asked you to use the Winterhoof Emblem at Skorn, and then to speak with the Winterhoof Brave.
text.description: $N, the vrykul fortress, Skorn, sits to the south. Its strange giants have recently awakened and have begun to spread, attacking us wherever they can.$B$BMy scouts inform me that they are poised to strike at us here, but I do not have the strength to repel such a force. Instead, we will prepare to leave north to less dangerous lands.$B$BI ask that you use your cunning to buy us time. I've sent a brave ahead with the details. Show this emblem at Skorn and he'll reveal himself and do all he can to aid you.
text.completion: It will be interesting to learn about your people, $c, while fighting alongside you. Shall we proceed?

text.title: 可怕而必要的手段
text.objectives: The Winterhoof Brave has asked you to use The Brave's Machete to dismember 20 Vrykul of the Winterskorn tribe at Skorn.
text.description: Our elders say that these vrykul may be able to rise from the dead; not unlike the walking dead you call the Scourge, but a different kind of undeath.$B$BWe should not take any chances.$B$BHere, take my machete. As we move through this place, carve up the remains of the vrykul that we slay.$B$BI spent the morning sharpening it, so it should cleave even through their thick bones.
text.progress: These vrykul have strange customs, would you not agree, $n?
text.completion: Have you done that before? Your skill with my machete seemed practiced. I'll take it back from you now, $c.
text.completed: Speak to your Winterhoof Brave companion. If he is not nearby, use your Winterhoof Emblem to beckon him.

text.title: 燃烧吧，斯克恩，燃烧吧！
text.objectives: The Winterhoof Brave suggests that you use the Brave's Torch to set fire to the Northeast and Northwest Longhouses and the Barracks at Skorn.
text.description: Chieftain Ashtotem ordered me to destroy many buildings here.$B$BHowever, you are in charge, so it falls to your hands, $N.$B$BI suggest that we burn down the two longhouses and the barracks that are in the lower area of Skorn. All we have to do is get inside each and set them ablaze with this torch.
text.progress: I suggest that when we set the buildings ablaze, we not stay inside of them. The fire spirit will not spare us in its thirst to destroy.
text.completion: Let these vrykul feel the heat of the land. Let them know the fear they would instill in others!
text.completed: Speak to your Winterhoof Brave companion. If he is not nearby, use your Winterhoof Emblem to beckon him.

english.title: Burn Skorn, Burn!
english.objectives: The Winterhoof Brave suggests that you use the Brave's Torch to set fire to the Northeast and Northwest Longhouses and the Barracks at Skorn.

text.title: 危险的塔楼
text.objectives: The Winterhoof Brave has informed you that using the Brave's Flare to target all four of the towers at Skorn for air strikes would be advisable.
text.description: As we move through Skorn, we must destroy the towers.$B$BIf you have a look at them, you'll notice that their tops are lined with casters. Getting too close to them would mean certain doom.$B$BHowever, we can call in wind rider air strikes from Camp Winterhoof. To do so, we need to get close enough so that you can lob a smoke flare atop of them.$B$BJust don't get too close.
text.progress: Getting too close to those towers is certain death as long as those casters are up there.
text.completion: You have a strong arm, $n. It looks as if those wind riders finally made themselves useful instead of just standing around and drinking all day.
text.completed: Speak to your Winterhoof Brave companion. If he is not nearby, use your Winterhoof Emblem to beckon him.

english.objectives: The Winterhoof Brave has informed you that using the Brave's Flare to target all four of the towers at Skorn for air strikes would be advisable.

text.title: 阻止升华！
text.objectives: Present the Vrykul Scroll of Ascension near the Thane's Pyre to call him out and slay him. Afterward, due to the nature of the ritual, you're sure that Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof will be interested in seeing the scroll.
text.description: 这张巨大的卷轴是用龙皮制作的。展开这张长达十尺的卷轴之后，你看到覆盖着鳞片的卷轴上画着一副维库人的神秘仪式的场景。$B$B一个维库领主，在一群天使形象的生物的环绕中，正缓缓升入天堂。而这副图的背景，则是一个神秘而巨大的黑影。$B$B你突然意识到，这就是斯克恩的领主正要去做的事。你必须阻止他！在斯克恩的顶层，领主的房间外已经堆好了一大捆木柴。
text.progress: Yes? How may I help you, child?
text.completion: Yes, that is ominous-looking, and you obviously had the right of it. Thank you for bringing this scroll to me. I will study its implications. If I were to hazard a guess, I would say that these vrykul have a way to transcend death; at least those that are worthy. By defeating the Winterskorn thane, you proved him unworthy. Who knows what he would have become, and what terror he might have rained down upon us, had you not slain him?
text.completed: Return to Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Stop the Ascension!
english.objectives: Present the Vrykul Scroll of Ascension near the Thane's Pyre to call him out and slay him. Afterward, due to the nature of the ritual, you're sure that Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof will be interested in seeing the scroll.
english.description: This huge scroll is made from dragon skin. Unfurling its more-than-ten-foot length, you can see that the images painted upon its scaly surface depict a mysterious vrykul ritual.$B$BA vrykul thane, surrounded by angelic-looking beings, ascends into the heavens. A mysterious, darkened figure looms large in the picture's background.$B$BA tingling in your gut tells you that the thane of Skorn is about to do this. You must stop it! A large pyre sits at the top of Skorn in front of the thane's lodge.
english.progress: Yes? How may I help you, child?
english.completion: Yes, that is ominous-looking, and you obviously had the right of it. Thank you for bringing this scroll to me. I will study its implications. If I were to hazard a guess, I would say that these vrykul have a way to transcend death; at least those that are worthy. By defeating the Winterskorn thane, you proved him unworthy. Who knows what he would have become, and what terror he might have rained down upon us, had you not slain him?
english.completed: Return to Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: The Conqueror of Skorn!
text.objectives: Return the Winterhoof Token to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
text.description: You have done everything that we were sent here to do, $c. I must admit that you fight well. Your people are not as strange as I first thought.$B$BChieftain Ashtotem is certain to want to hear of your success, but if you decide to stay out here for whatever reason, I will continue to fight at your side.
text.progress: What news do you bring of Skorn, $n?
text.completion: That is good news indeed! You have given us some breathing room to further our preparations for leaving. Please, take one of these as a sign of our appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Ingvar Must Die!
text.objectives: Dark Ranger Marrah has asked you to kill Ingvar the Plunderer in Utgarde Keep, then bring his head to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing.
text.description: Finally, someone's come. I've been here far too long and my wits are beginning to fail me. Of our entire recon party, only I remain.$b$bI shall give you my report and it will be up to you to act upon the information. Know this, $c; it did not come cheaply.$b$bThese vrykul are relentless fighters. Given their numbers and their savage tactics, our only hope is to bring down their leader and pray it brings chaos to their ranks.$b$bIngvar is his name. Bring his head to Anselm when your duty is done.
text.progress: This is just the tip of the iceberg, so to speak.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. With their leader removed, our efforts against these vrykul should be more successful. Service such as this cannot go unrewarded!
text.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 亚勒伯龙的麻烦
text.objectives: 灰烬图腾酋长要你杀死15个亚勒伯龙战士、8个亚勒伯龙符文法师和8个亚勒伯龙沉睡卫士，然后返回冬蹄营地向他复命。
text.description: 幸存的远行者回来告诉我说，维库人在西面的要塞里苏醒了过来。$B$B那块禁地被称为亚勒伯龙，维库人正在那里进行着什么奇怪的仪式。$B$B我们不能坐视不管。$B$B你准备继续帮助我们吗？你能在亚勒伯龙的维库人完成他们的仪式、向这里发动进攻之前消灭他们吗？
text.progress: How is the fight at Gjalerbron coming?
text.completion: You have my thanks, $n. I know that you do not have any duty to me or my people. What you say about that place troubles me still, and I sense that our culling is not quite at an end.
text.completed: Return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Dealing With Gjalerbron
english.objectives: Chieftain Ashtotem has asked you to kill 15 Gjalerbron Warriors, 8 Gjalerbron Rune-casters, and 8 Gjalerbron Sleep-watchers. Afterward, return to him at Camp Winterhoof.
english.description: My longrunners that have lived to return have informed me that the vrykul have awakened at their main fortress to the west.$B$BIt is a forbidden place known as Gjalerbron. The longrunners tell me that the vrykul are performing strange rituals.$B$BWe cannot allow this to continue.$B$BAre you willing to continue to assist us? Will you kill the vrykul at Gjalerbron before they finish whatever they are doing and attack us here?
english.progress: How is the fight at Gjalerbron coming?
english.completion: You have my thanks, $n. I know that you do not have any duty to me or my people. What you say about that place troubles me still, and I sense that our culling is not quite at an end.
english.completed: Return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 通灵主宰麦森
text.objectives: Kill Necro Overlord Mezhen. Then, return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
text.description: The dead ones are at Gjalerbron and they have necromancers with them?$B$BWe must eliminate the leader of these necrolords.$B$BDo whatever it takes, $N, but see to it that Necro Overlord Mezhen, and whatever he's attempting to accomplish, is neutralized.$B$BWe cannot afford to see the vrykul successful in whatever they are doing with these undead creatures!$B$BLook for Mezhen on the platform in the rear right section of Gjalerbron.
text.completion: That should take some of the pressure off. $n, time and again you have proven your value to the taunka of Camp Winterhoof. Please, choose something from our bounty. I insist.
text.completed: Return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Necro Overlord Mezhen
english.objectives: Kill Necro Overlord Mezhen. Then, return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
english.description: The dead ones are at Gjalerbron and they have necromancers with them?$B$BWe must eliminate the leader of these necrolords.$B$BDo whatever it takes, $N, but see to it that Necro Overlord Mezhen, and whatever he's attempting to accomplish, is neutralized.$B$BWe cannot afford to see the vrykul successful in whatever they are doing with these undead creatures!$B$BLook for Mezhen on the platform in the rear right section of Gjalerbron.
english.completion: That should take some of the pressure off. $n, time and again you have proven your value to the taunka of Camp Winterhoof. Please, choose something from our bounty. I insist.
english.completed: Return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 钥匙和牢笼
text.objectives: 安卡祖母要你去搜集足够的亚勒伯龙牢笼钥匙，用它们解救10个亚勒伯龙囚犯。完成任务后返回冬蹄营地向她复命。
text.description: 根据现在所了解到的一小部分信息来看，维库人正在亚勒伯龙的北部进行一种残忍的“觉醒”仪式。$B$B他们在那种邪恶的仪式上进行活祭！$B$B$N，你必须去阻止这一切。不管笼子里面是谁，你都得解救他们。我猜想维库人一定会把钥匙带在身边。$B$B如果放任不管，那些奇怪的维库人就会给我们带来更多更严重的威胁，或者唤醒更加邪恶的东西……
text.progress: With the prisoners at Gjalerbron freed, the vrykul will be unable to continue their rituals.
text.completion: A great stone is lifted from my shoulders to hear of your success. And I smile to know that some you freed were taunka. Please, take this as a gift for what you have done. I shall see to the health of those you freed.
text.completed: Return to Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Of Keys and Cages
english.objectives: Greatmother Ankha has asked you to collect enough Gjalerbron Cage Keys to free 10 Gjalerbron Prisoners. Return to her at Camp Winterhoof when you manage to do so.
english.description: From the little we know, the vrykul are conducting unnatural rites in an 'awakening' ritual to the west in Gjalerbron.$B$BThey're using living sacrifices to fuel their rituals.$B$B$N, you must stop this. It matters not who or what is in those cages, they must be freed. I would guess that the vrykul hold the keys.$B$BThe last thing we need is more of those strange vrykul threatening us, or worse, them wakening something even more evil....
english.progress: With the prisoners at Gjalerbron freed, the vrykul will be unable to continue their rituals.
english.completion: A great stone is lifted from my shoulders to hear of your success. And I smile to know that some you freed were taunka. Please, take this as a gift for what you have done. I shall see to the health of those you freed.
english.completed: Return to Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 亚勒伯龙攻击计划
text.objectives: Deliver the Gjalerbron Attack Plans to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof.
text.description: These plans detail an imminent attack upon Camp Winterhoof. It would appear that the frost wyrm, Glacion, who circles overhead, is to be used for the offensive.$B$BSurely Celea Frozenmane would be of some assistance in this matter. Deliver the plans to her at the camp to the east.
text.progress: What?! Plans for an attack upon our camp? FROM A GREAT WYRM IN THE SKY?!!!
text.completion: $n, we cannot let this come to pass!
text.completed: Return to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Gjalerbron Attack Plans
english.objectives: Deliver the Gjalerbron Attack Plans to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof.
english.description: These plans detail an imminent attack upon Camp Winterhoof. It would appear that the frost wyrm, Glacion, who circles overhead, is to be used for the offensive.$B$BSurely Celea Frozenmane would be of some assistance in this matter. Deliver the plans to her at the camp to the east.
english.progress: What?! Plans for an attack upon our camp? FROM A GREAT WYRM IN THE SKY?!!!
english.completion: $n, we cannot let this come to pass!
english.completed: Return to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 冰霜巨龙和它的主人
text.objectives: Slay Wyrmcaller Vile and use the Wyrmcaller's Horn to call down and slay Glacion. Then, return with the horn to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof.
text.description: Your instincts were right to bring this to me, but my wind riders cannot fight a dragon. You must take help back west with you to Gjalerbron and slay the frost wyrm and its master, Wyrmcaller Vile!$B$BEven now it may be on its way!$B$BIf I'm reading these plans correctly, blowing the wyrmcaller's horn on his platform, outside in the rear left area of Gjalerbron, will  call Glacion back. When the creature lands, destroy it!$B$BAnd $N, bring me the horn. We wouldn't want it falling back into the wrong hands!
text.progress: Is the attack averted? Is the great death wyrm and its master destroyed? Did you retrieve the horn?
text.completion: This horn is as cold as the land... perhaps even colder! You have saved Camp Winterhoof from certain doom, not that we'll be staying here much longer. What a curious man you are, $n. Perhaps you $r-types from over the ocean are not so bad after all. This calls for a reward. Which do you prefer?
text.completed: Return to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.title: The Frost Wyrm and its Master
english.objectives: Slay Wyrmcaller Vile and use the Wyrmcaller's Horn to call down and slay Glacion. Then, return with the horn to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof.

When the creature lands, destroy it!$B$BAnd $N, bring me the horn. We wouldn't want it falling back into the wrong hands!

text.title: The Walking Dead
text.objectives: Slay 10 Deathless Watchers, 4 Fearsome Horrors, and 2 Putrid Wights. Afterward, inform Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof of your success.
text.description: Your assistance to us has been tremendous, $N, but there is something that is troubling me: these so-called Scourge.$B$BThe spirits of the land and air, the waters and the fire below the world, would not abide their presence, but seem to do nothing about them. We will see to it that they are dealt with!$B$BPerhaps it is asking too much, but I would have you return west to Gjalerbron and destroy the unnatural Scourge in that vile lair. Be sure to check in the Waking Halls below Gjalerbron as well!
text.progress: Have you destroyed the walking dead at Gjalerbron?
text.completion: Thank you, $n, you have done what is right and you have bought us a little more time to finish our preparations for leaving. We will soon make the journey north. I am too old; when we go, I will not be able to carry everything with me. Would you like to take one of these?
text.completed: Return to Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

english.completed: Return to Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 羽绒披风
text.objectives: 基尔·克利瑟要你去收集10根斑点角鹰兽的羽毛。
text.description: 再过几天，联盟的先锋部队就该抵达这里了。我们得提前为将士们准备好过冬的物资，眼下就差披风啦。$B$B斑点角鹰兽的羽毛是绝好的内层填充材料，不过存货已经不多了！$B$B$N，帮帮我吧。如果不能按期缝制好足够数量的披风，亚当斯上尉肯定会扒了我的皮！现在正是角鹰兽换毛的季节，要塞附近的荒野上随处可见它们散落的羽毛。把你找到的羽毛都带回来交给我。
text.progress: Have you brought any of that down? I could really use it...
text.completion: Thank goodness! This should be enough to finish the order in time. Of course, I won't sleep until the troops arrive, but that's far better than risking Captain Adams' wrath. I've heard the stories they tell about him!
text.completed: Return to Gil Grisert at Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.

english.title: Down to the Wire
english.objectives: Gil Grisert wants you to bring him 10 clumps of Spotted Hippogryph Down.
english.description: The vanguard of the Alliance force will be arriving within days. The soldiers will be expecting their winter gear to be prepared, but I've still got more cloaks to make.$B$BI've been using spotted hippogryph down for the cloaks' linings, but my stock won't last!$B$BYou've got to help me, $N. Captain Adams will have my hide if those cloaks aren't ready in time! Bring me all the down you can find out there. It's dropped to the ground by molting hippogryphs flying over the wilderness around the fort.
english.progress: Have you brought any of that down? I could really use it...
english.completion: Thank goodness! This should be enough to finish the order in time. Of course, I won't sleep until the troops arrive, but that's far better than risking Captain Adams' wrath. I've heard the stories they tell about him!
english.completed: Return to Gil Grisert at Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 地狱般的战争
text.objectives: 复仇港的高级执行官安希尔姆要求你到镇子的西边去，使用净化之炬净化10具尸体。
text.description: 我们正在慢慢消灭暴风城的北方舰队驻扎在这片海岸上的残余部队。漂往西方的尸体暗示着这场战斗是多么的残酷。$B$B这并不妨碍我优雅的审美趣味，但却说明我们正处在危险之中。$B$B在巫妖王的领地上，死者随时可能重新站起来攻击我们。带上这根火把——你要进行净化仪式，让逝者安息。
text.progress: I don't care how many giants, dragons or kobolds you've killed before. Get this job done and come back when you're finished.
text.completion: I'm glad you've proven you can follow orders.  If I had a copper piece for every arrogant fool in shiny armor to come here and think they're above the chain of command... well, I'd have a few gold. Now that you've demonstrated a measure of discipline, I have other tasks more suitable for someone of your caliber.
text.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

english.title: War is Hell
english.objectives: High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing wants you to take the Burning Torch and use it to burn 10 of the corpses littered to the west of town.
english.description: We're slowly finishing off the remnants of Stormwind's North Fleet stationed on this coast.  The bodies to the west are a testament to how brutal this confrontation has been.$B$BThis does not happen to bother my refined aesthetics, but it does present a danger to our lives.$B$BIn the lands of the Lich King, the dead are a weapon that can rise against us at any point in time.  Take this torch - you're going to make sure that doesn't happen.
english.progress: I don't care how many giants, dragons or kobolds you've killed before. Get this job done and come back when you're finished.
english.completion: I'm glad you've proven you can follow orders.  If I had a copper piece for every arrogant fool in shiny armor to come here and think they're above the chain of command... well, I'd have a few gold. Now that you've demonstrated a measure of discipline, I have other tasks more suitable for someone of your caliber.
english.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: Hasty Preparations
text.objectives: Ahota Whitefrost at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring him 10 clumps of Spotted Hippogryph Down.
text.description: The down of the spotted hippogryph is prized by my people and used for everything from fletching to ceremonial clothing. We're making preparations to leave the post, so this is the last chance I'll get to gather it this season.$B$BWith your help, I'll have enough to make sure everyone has the equipment they need for the long trek into the hills. Conditions worsen very quickly up there and a storm can blow in without warning.$B$BThe down can be found all over the ground in the area surrounding the post.
text.progress: Have you gathered any of the down?
text.completion: With your contribution, we'll be well prepared for the journey. I haven't much to offer you for your help, but I will give you a choice of some of my spare combat gear.
text.completed: Return to Ahota Whitefrost at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 旗开得胜
text.objectives: High Executor Anselm wants you to to go into Utgarde and slay Prince Keleseth.
text.description: This elf prince thinks he can come to my town, insult my queen, kill my men and get away with it?  He thinks we're going to stand by while the hordes of Utgarde build up to launch an attack?$B$BNot in a million years.$B$BYou're going to walk right into Utgarde and kill him in front of any of these vrykul gorillas that might be watching.  I want Arthas to know that we've arrived and we're playing for keeps.
text.completion: Revenge feels good.  To think that this is but a taste of what's to come. Arthas will get what he deserves soon enough.  Then and only then will I die a happy man.
text.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

english.title: A Score to Settle
english.objectives: High Executor Anselm wants you to to go into Utgarde and slay Prince Keleseth.
english.description: This elf prince thinks he can come to my town, insult my queen, kill my men and get away with it?  He thinks we're going to stand by while the hordes of Utgarde build up to launch an attack?$B$BNot in a million years.$B$BYou're going to walk right into Utgarde and kill him in front of any of these vrykul gorillas that might be watching.  I want Arthas to know that we've arrived and we're playing for keeps.
english.completion: Revenge feels good.  To think that this is but a taste of what's to come. Arthas will get what he deserves soon enough.  Then and only then will I die a happy man.
english.completed: Return to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 协会的发现
text.objectives: 在龙颅村内搜寻普罗伊。
text.description: 该死！见鬼！就在那群怪物发动突袭之前，我们刚刚取得了一个重大的考古发现！但现在，只有我一个人活着回到了瓦加德。目前我和所有其他队员们都失去了联系，连他们的生死都不清楚，但是，无论如何，必须找回我们发掘出来的文物！$B$B如果你要去龙颅村那边的话，能不能帮我去找找我的队伍？哪怕只剩下一丝希望，我们也绝对不能放弃那些挖掘出来的东西！$B$B你可以先去找普罗伊，他是我逃跑之前见到的最后一个活人。
text.completion: You've found Pulroy. A bit too late it seems. While looking over the corpse you see a journal clenched tightly in Pulroy's death grip. Upon examining the journal you read what appears to be the scribbling of a dying dwarf.

english.title: The Human League
english.objectives: Search Wyrmskull Village for Pulroy.
english.description: We were on the brink of an archaeological breakthrough when those monsters attacked! Sadly, I was the only one to make it back to Valgarde. Now I don't know if my crew is dead or alive, but the artifacts we uncovered on that dig must be found!$B$BIf you're heading into Wyrmskull Village, will you keep an eye out for my team? If there's any hope of recovering that information, we must pursue it!$B$BSearch for Pulroy first. He was the last one I saw before I made my escape.
english.completion: You've found Pulroy. A bit too late it seems. While looking over the corpse you see a journal clenched tightly in Pulroy's death grip. Upon examining the journal you read what appears to be the scribbling of a dying dwarf.

text.title: 塞德也许已经死了
text.objectives: 在龙颅村内搜寻塞德。
text.description: 致任何看到这篇日记的人：$B$B那群该死的怪物占领了龙颅村的遗迹。他们来这里找什么，或是说来这里的目的，这一切完全都是个谜。但无论如何，古物在这群野兽一般的人手中是绝对不安全的。$B$B塞德和我躲起来的时候，一不留神找到了一个新的线索：可以解读石板的密码表！可惜昨天晚上我俩也失散了。他手里拿着密码表，而石板在格罗菲尔德和戴加恩手里，具体在哪没人知道了……$B$B你一定要找到塞德。$B$B- 普罗伊
text.completion: You've found Zedd. You're no doctor but the prognosis for Zedd is most assuredly negative. It looks as if they were preparing to feed him to the worgs. Gruesome...

english.title: Zedd's Probably Dead
english.objectives: Search Wyrmskull Village for Zedd.
english.description: To whomever finds this journal:$B$BThese bloodthirsty monsters have taken up residence in the ruins of Wyrmskull. What they want or why they're here is a mystery. In any case, the artifacts are not safe with those beast-men around.$B$BZedd and I made a new discovery while hiding out: a cipher to decode the tablets! Unfortunately Zedd and I were separated late last night. He had the cipher. Tablets were with Glorenfeld and Daegarn. Location unknown...$B$BFind Zedd.$B$B-Pulroy
english.completion: You've found Zedd. You're no doctor but the prognosis for Zedd is most assuredly negative. It looks as if they were preparing to feed him to the worgs. Gruesome...

text.title: Making the Horn
text.objectives: Nokoma Snowseer at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring her 6 Undamaged Ram Horns.
text.description: My people have been hunting the giant yeti of these hills for generations and I will be participating for the first time this year. It will probably be the last before we leave the post forever.$B$BTo prepare for the hunt, I must fashion a loud horn from the horns of the dire rams that roam the snowy areas near our camp. The elders tell me the sound mimics the mating call of the female yeti, but I have my doubts.$B$BBring me the best dire ram horns you can find, $N, and I'll select one from among them.
text.progress: Have you brought any suitable horns?
text.completion: These are all fine horns, $n. Let me examine them and select the one I will use in the hunt. I'll give the rest to the craftsmen for use in their carvings.
text.completed: Return to Nokoma Snowseer at Camp Winterhoof in Howling Fjord.
